project.name: massa-ai
project.description: massa-ai is a local-first MCP server that indexes a codebase for semantic search, keyword search, and a dependency-ranked symbol graph. It also keeps a persistent, cross-session memory of decisions and facts, letting AI coding assistants retrieve only relevant context instead of loading whole files. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.

nodes.name: _bun-mock-guard.ts
nodes.summary: Shared test-infrastructure guard that detects when Bun's process-global mock.module() registry has been contaminated by sibling test files' stubs (config, symbol repository, ignore-patterns) and exposes describeEtl to skip ETL-driving integration suites with a clear reason instead of crashing on missing mocked methods.
nodes.languageNotes: Bun 1.3.x has no per-file test isolation flag and mock.restore() only undoes mock() spies, not mock.module() registry mutations, so contamination from earlier test files in the same process cannot be cleared at runtime — this guard is a probe-and-skip workaround rather than a real fix.

nodes.name: describeEtl

nodes.name: boundedInt

nodes.name: with-deadlock-retry.ts

nodes.name: withDeadlockRetry

nodes.name: precisionAtK
nodes.summary: Computes precision@k, the fraction of the top-k retrieved ids that are in the relevant set, returning NaN for k<=0.

nodes.name: recallAtK
nodes.summary: Computes recall@k, the fraction of the relevant set found within the top-k retrieved ids, returning NaN when the relevant set is empty.

nodes.name: mrrAtK
nodes.summary: Computes mean reciprocal rank at k: the reciprocal of the 1-based position of the first relevant hit within the top-k, or 0 if none is found.

nodes.name: ndcgAtK
nodes.summary: Computes normalized discounted cumulative gain at k by dividing the DCG of the retrieved ranking by the ideal DCG for the same relevant-set size.

nodes.name: jaccard
nodes.summary: Computes the Jaccard similarity (intersection over union) between two string id lists, defined as 1 when both are empty.

nodes.summary: Comprehensive unit tests for WorkingMemoryBuffer covering put/get hit-boost math, primed-entry content-token matching, eviction, and snapshot/restore round-tripping.

nodes.name: synapse-consumer-seam.test.ts
nodes.summary: Test-seam contract test that feeds a frozen search-response fixture into WorkingMemoryBuffer.prime()/get() to detect SearchResult schema drift before it silently breaks Synapse.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the 'frozen fixture' pattern: intentionally mutating a captured real response to assert the extractor fails loudly on shape drift rather than silently passing.

nodes.name: working-memory-buffer.ts
nodes.summary: Session-scoped hot cache for retrieval results, keyed by result id, that matches new queries against past queries (or primed content) via Jaccard token overlap and boosts hit scores; includes snapshot/restore helpers so a session's buffer survives a process restart.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Public barrel for the Synapse cognitive-modulation layer; re-exports all submodules and hosts the lazy SynapseManager singleton read from runtime config.

nodes.name: chain-inhibition.ts
nodes.summary: Detects query intent (decision/debug/pattern/symbol) via regex heuristics and boosts or suppresses search results whose memory-chain type matches, including a filePath-based type fallback for code-search results with no explicit type metadata.

nodes.name: confidence-gate.ts
nodes.summary: Adaptive relevance gate that classifies a query as specific/focused/broad via cheap heuristics and filters results below a class-proportional score threshold, preferring the raw pre-RRF vector score over the normalized one to avoid letting noise through on weak queries.

nodes.name: diversity-penalty.ts
nodes.summary: MMR-inspired re-ranker that demotes results too textually similar (Jaccard over tokens) or from the same file as a higher-ranked result, so the top-N results cover more distinct topics.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-exporting the four inhibition strategies (diversity penalty, confidence gate, temporal inhibition, chain inhibition) as the module's public surface.

nodes.name: temporal-inhibition.ts
nodes.summary: Anti-recency-bias filter that penalizes memories younger than a configurable age when the query itself carries no temporal intent, preventing freshness from masquerading as relevance.

nodes.name: type-inference.ts
nodes.summary: Heuristic that infers a synthetic memory-chain type (code, code-test, documentation) from a result's filePath, letting chain inhibition operate on code-search results that carry no explicit type metadata.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: One-line barrel re-exporting the score-spectrum metacognition function and its config type.

nodes.name: score-spectrum.ts
nodes.summary: Computes spread/mean/confidence over a result-score distribution and derives mutually-exclusive metacognition flags (definitiveMatch, noStrongMatch, lowConfidence) so callers can tell when retrieval itself is unsure.

nodes.name: strengthen.ts
nodes.summary: Pure analysis function that computes importance-score deltas for memories based on recent access frequency, graph-edge count, and decision references, using a smooth ramped boost instead of a hard threshold cliff; callers such as a consolidation job apply the deltas via the DB layer.

nodes.name: prefetch.ts
nodes.summary: Experimental (default-off) predictive-prefetch helpers that derive topic keywords from a file path and its symbols, build a search plan from them, and prime a session's working-memory buffer with the fetched results ahead of the agent's next query.

nodes.name: agent-affinity.ts
nodes.summary: Computes a [0,1] agent-affinity signal combining authorship (did this agent create the memory) and in-session usage frequency, used as one input to attention scoring.

nodes.name: attention-score.ts
nodes.summary: Multi-signal re-ranker that folds semantic, recency, access-heat, task-alignment, and agent-affinity signals into a final score over the top-N results, with active-weight renormalization so signals with no available data (e.g. no session) don't collapse the score.
nodes.languageNotes: Renormalizes weights over only the structurally-available signals per call, so a degenerate case (no session, no createdAt) still preserves the original RRF ordering instead of collapsing every score toward zero.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-exporting the attention-score, task-alignment, and agent-affinity scoring functions as the scoring module's public surface.

nodes.name: task-alignment.ts
nodes.summary: Measures how relevant a candidate result is to the agent session's current task, preferring embedding cosine similarity when both sides carry embeddings and falling back to token-overlap Jaccard over the result content.

nodes.name: session-store.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the synchronous SessionStore contract, a no-op MemorySessionStore test double, and the lazy-singleton factory that always instantiates PgSynapseSessionStore in production (requiring DATABASE_URL to be set).
nodes.languageNotes: Extremely condensed single-line-per-member style packs the interface, test double, and factory into 12 lines total.

nodes.name: synapse-manager.ts
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the full post-retrieval Synapse pipeline in a fixed order -- buffer merge, pre-gate, attention re-rank, chain inhibition, diversity penalty, temporal inhibition, confidence gate, then metacognition spectrum -- and writes survivors back into the session's working-memory buffer for the next query.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Shared type definitions for the Synapse cognitive-modulation layer: query classification, metacognition flags, the ephemeral AgentSession shape, query-intent-to-chain-boost mapping, and the full pipeline result shape.

nodes.name: WorkingMemoryBuffer
nodes.summary: Map-backed hot cache of SearchResults for a session; put()/get() match new queries against remembered query or content tokens via Jaccard, apply a hit-score boost off a stable baseline score, and evict by TTL or over-capacity lowest-score-first.

nodes.name: restoreWorkingMemoryBuffer
nodes.summary: Reconstructs a live WorkingMemoryBuffer from a persisted snapshot, skipping already-expired entries and treating a missing/malformed snapshot as a signal to start with a fresh buffer.

nodes.name: snapshotWorkingMemoryBuffer
nodes.summary: Serializes a live WorkingMemoryBuffer's entries and config into a plain BufferSnapshot for persistence, shared by session stores.

nodes.name: getSynapseManager
nodes.summary: Lazy singleton accessor that constructs the SynapseManager from the current runtime config on first call and caches it.

nodes.name: detectIntent
nodes.summary: Classifies a query string into decision/debug/pattern/symbol/general intent by testing it against specificity-ordered regex pattern groups.

nodes.name: extractType
nodes.summary: Reads a result's memory-chain type from metadata.type or metadata.context.type, falling back to a filePath-derived synthetic type when neither is present.

nodes.name: applyChainInhibition
nodes.summary: Applies the detected intent's per-chain boost multipliers to each result's score and re-sorts, passing results through unchanged for general intent or untyped results.

nodes.name: classifyQuery
nodes.summary: Classifies a query as specific/focused/broad using regex signals (file paths, identifier casing, function calls, quoted symbols) and a technical-keyword count, driving the adaptive confidence threshold.

nodes.name: prefilterByRawScore
nodes.summary: Cheap pre-pipeline filter that drops only results whose raw pre-RRF vector score is already below the classified threshold, sparing the expensive downstream re-ranking stages from candidates that would be cut anyway.

nodes.name: applyConfidenceGate
nodes.summary: Final-stage filter that drops results below the query-class-proportional relevance threshold, using the raw vector score when available instead of the RRF-normalized one.

nodes.name: applyDiversityPenalty
nodes.summary: MMR-style re-ranker that walks results in score order and multiplicatively penalizes each candidate's score for token-Jaccard similarity and same-filePath overlap with already-selected higher-ranked results.

nodes.name: hasTemporalIndicator
nodes.summary: Checks whether a query contains an English or Portuguese temporal indicator word (e.g. 'recent', 'hoje'), used to skip the anti-recency penalty when the user is explicitly asking for what's new.

nodes.name: applyTemporalInhibition
nodes.summary: Subtracts a fixed score penalty from results younger than a configurable age when the query carries no temporal intent, then re-sorts.

nodes.name: inferTypeFromPath
nodes.summary: Applies ordered regex rules to a file path to infer a synthetic memory-chain type (code-test, documentation, or code), returning null when the path gives no signal.

nodes.name: analyzeSpectrum
nodes.summary: Computes min/max/mean/spread/confidence over a set of result scores and derives three mutually-exclusive flags -- definitiveMatch, noStrongMatch, lowConfidence -- prioritized so a single strong hit isn't misclassified as low-confidence.

nodes.name: computeStrengthenUpdates
nodes.summary: Sums ramped (non-cliff) boosts for recent-access frequency, graph-edge count, and decision-reference flags into a capped importance delta per memory, returning only memories whose importance actually increased.

nodes.name: extractTopics
nodes.summary: Tokenizes a file path and its symbol names into deduplicated, stop-word-filtered lowercase topic keywords for use as a prefetch search query.

nodes.name: buildPrefetchPlan
nodes.summary: Turns extracted topics plus prefetch config into a concrete PrefetchPlan (query string, chains, thresholds, TTL) for the caller to execute.

nodes.name: executePrefetch
nodes.summary: Builds a prefetch plan, fetches matching entries via a caller-supplied function, and primes the working-memory buffer with the results, swallowing fetch errors into a skippedReason summary.

nodes.name: computeAgentAffinity
nodes.summary: Combines an authorship bonus (result created by the current agent) with a usage-frequency bonus (session access count, capped) into a clamped [0,1] agent-affinity score.

nodes.name: applyAttentionScore
nodes.summary: Re-ranks the top rerankWindow results by a weighted sum of semantic, recency, access-heat, task-alignment, and agent-affinity signals, renormalizing weights over only the structurally-available signals so missing session/metadata never collapses the score, and appends the untouched tail.

nodes.name: computeTaskAlignment
nodes.summary: Scores how aligned a result is with the session's current task via embedding cosine similarity when both sides carry embeddings, otherwise via token-overlap Jaccard against the task context.

nodes.name: MemorySessionStore
nodes.summary: No-op SessionStore test double whose save/load/delete/recordAccess methods are all no-ops; production code always uses PgSynapseSessionStore instead.

nodes.name: getSessionStore
nodes.summary: Lazy singleton factory that validates a PostgreSQL DATABASE_URL is configured and constructs the sole PgSynapseSessionStore instance.

nodes.name: SynapseManager
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the post-retrieval Synapse pipeline's process() method, composing buffer merge, scoring, and inhibition stages over a result set in a fixed order and recording which filters actually ran.

nodes.name: observation-extractor.ts
nodes.summary: Pure, side-effect-free classifier pipeline that derives a semantic ObservationCategory from a lifecycle event's (source, payload) shape — normalizing tool names across hosts and dispatching through an ordered set of category classifiers, falling back to "lifecycle-raw" when nothing matches.

nodes.name: session-pin-store.ts
nodes.summary: Bounded, TTL-expiring in-memory map from sessionId to projectId used for sticky hook-attribution pinning; an optimization only — process restart or eviction safely degrades attribution to a legal containment/verbatim fallback.

nodes.name: writer-queue.ts
nodes.summary: Single-writer promise-chain queue that serializes observation-persist writes so the hook ingestion fire-hose cannot starve readers, throwing QueueSaturatedError (mapped to HTTP 429) when the queue is full.

nodes.name: auto-improve-config.ts
nodes.summary: Thresholds, fallback defaults, and the defensive config reader for the auto-improve job, plus the set of valid memory-type strings used by apply-phase validation.

nodes.name: classifyToolCall
nodes.summary: Primary classifier mapping normalized tool names (Read, Write, Bash, Grep, etc., including MCP-namespaced calls) to their observation category.

nodes.name: classifyUserPrompt
nodes.summary: Classifies a user-prompt payload into goal/plan/decision/constraint/rejection/blocked/role categories via keyword-prefix and phrase matching.

nodes.name: classifySessionStart
nodes.summary: Classifies a session-start payload into session-settings, cwd-changes, or env-changes based on which fields are present.

nodes.name: classifyError
nodes.summary: Detects tool-response errors (explicit error flag/field or stdout error/failed markers) on post-tool-use events.

nodes.name: classifyRuleFile
nodes.summary: Detects reads of project rule files (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursorrules, etc.) and classifies them as "rules".

nodes.name: classifyGitPayload
nodes.summary: Detects git operations directly from payload command/diff fields, independent of the Bash tool-call classification path.

nodes.name: extractCategory
nodes.summary: Public entry point running the ordered classifier pipeline over (source, payload), defensively catching classifier exceptions and falling back to source-based defaults.

nodes.name: SessionPinStore
nodes.summary: LRU-ish bounded map (max size + lazy TTL expiry, oldest-access eviction) pinning a session id to a project id for sticky hook attribution.

nodes.name: QueueSaturatedError
nodes.summary: Typed error thrown when the writer queue is at capacity, carrying a retry-after-seconds hint for the caller.

nodes.name: WriterQueue
nodes.summary: Serializes async work onto a single promise chain with a pending-count cap; a failure in one queued item never poisons the chain.

nodes.name: readAutoImproveConfig
nodes.summary: Defensively reads memory.autoImprove config with a hard-coded fallback when the config block is absent (e.g. process-wide-mocked tests).

nodes.name: auto-improve-llm.ts
nodes.summary: Optional LLM-based refinement of rule-based auto-improve pattern candidates — rewrites content/rationale via a zod-validated schema, silently degrading to the verbatim rule-based candidates when the LLM is disabled or fails.

nodes.name: auto-improve-patterns.ts
nodes.summary: Pure, LLM-free rule-based pattern detection over recent observations — frequency-counts recurring queries, hot files, and repeated edit signatures, and turns qualifying ones into proposal-candidate drafts.

nodes.name: decay.ts
nodes.summary: Pure, dependency-free memory-salience decay function blending a recency-decayed importance term with an access-reinforcement term (pinned memories exempt); used by both the memory-consolidation job and MemoryService's ranking.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately has zero runtime dependencies beyond a shared type import, keeping it unit-testable without a database — the header comment calls this out explicitly.

nodes.name: memory-service.ts
nodes.summary: Pure domain-logic singleton for the memory subsystem — ID generation, L0-L4 level determination from agent hierarchy/scope rules, row-to-domain mapping, and the semantic/temporal/access/type-weighted ranking algorithm. No DB calls.

nodes.name: enrichWithLlm
nodes.summary: Refines pattern candidates via the injected LLM surface's structured-object call, merging refined content/rationale back onto matching candidates by signalKey; never throws.

nodes.name: buildEnrichmentPrompt
nodes.summary: Builds the LLM prompt listing candidate drafts plus recent observation context for the enrichment call.

nodes.name: detectPatterns
nodes.summary: Frequency-analyzes observations into recurring-query / hot-file / recurring-fix candidates, gated by per-signal thresholds.

nodes.name: extractQuery
nodes.summary: Extracts and normalizes a user-prompt's query text into a dedup signature.

nodes.name: extractFilePath
nodes.summary: Extracts a file path from a tool-call payload across several possible field shapes.

nodes.name: extractFixSignature
nodes.summary: Builds a tool:pathBucket signature representing a recurring edit pattern.

nodes.name: pathBucket
nodes.summary: Returns the parent-directory portion of a path, or "root" when there is none.

nodes.name: normalizeSignature
nodes.summary: Normalizes free text into a short, stopword-filtered, sorted 3-token signature for dedup grouping.

nodes.name: truncate
nodes.summary: Truncates a string to max characters with an ellipsis suffix.

nodes.name: decayScore
nodes.summary: Computes the decayed salience score for a memory, blending recency decay with access reinforcement; pinned memories return importance unchanged.

nodes.name: isCold
nodes.summary: Whether a memory's decayed score falls below the cold/prune threshold.

nodes.name: MemoryService
nodes.summary: Singleton owning memory ID generation, L0-L4 level determination, and semanticRank scoring (65% semantic + 20% temporal + 10% access + 5% type-boost), delegating temporal scoring to the shared decayScore.

nodes.name: serialize-interfaces.ts
nodes.summary: Explicit TypeScript contracts (GroupRowsByPrefixOptions, GroupedResult, GroupedGroup, GroupedRow) for the grouped-format helper in serialize.ts, shared verbatim by tools that consume grouped/tree output so interface drift fails the batch.

nodes.name: serialize.ts
nodes.summary: Shared serializer for MCP tool success-path responses — field projection (dotted-path, array-aware), TOON/JSON/tree format encoding, and the grouped-by-path-prefix helper used by both format:"tree" and format:"json" with grouped:true.

nodes.name: serializeToolResponse
nodes.summary: Top-level entry point — projects fields, then routes to grouped/tree/toon/json encoding based on options.

nodes.name: projectFields
nodes.summary: Recursively projects an object/array down to the requested dotted field paths, silently dropping unknown keys.

nodes.name: unescapeJsonField
nodes.summary: Detects and parses escaped-JSON string values into nested structures for projected output.

nodes.name: projectPath
nodes.summary: Recursive dotted-path walker used by projectFields for nested field projections.

nodes.name: mergeProjection
nodes.summary: Merges two projections sharing a top-level key (array element-wise or shallow object merge).

nodes.name: groupRowsByPrefix
nodes.summary: Groups rows by a 2-segment path prefix with per-group row caps and a group cap folding overflow into (other), powering both tree and grouped-JSON output.

nodes.name: resolvePrefix
nodes.summary: Resolves a row's group prefix from an explicit field or a derived file-path prefix.

nodes.name: twoSegmentPrefix
nodes.summary: Extracts the 2-segment directory prefix from a file path.

nodes.name: groupedToTree
nodes.summary: Renders a GroupedResult as a text-indented tree string.

nodes.name: treeFlat
nodes.summary: Fallback flat-tree text rendering for ungrouped data.

nodes.name: centrality.test.ts
nodes.summary: Pure unit tests for computePageRank covering empty graphs, single nodes, import-target score boosting, self-loop and unknown-endpoint edge skipping, [0,1] normalization, and convergence behavior.

nodes.name: cycle-detection.property.test.ts
nodes.summary: Property-based test validating the iterative Tarjan SCC implementation in detectCycles against a brute-force O(V^3) reachability oracle across 100 random small graphs, guarding against subtle lowlink-update bugs in the iterative algorithm.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a seeded mulberry32 PRNG for deterministic, reproducible fuzz-graph generation rather than Math.random().

nodes.name: get-architecture.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for GetArchitectureTool's parameter validation, covering the unknown-aspect teaching-error path (400 response with the valid-values list) and basic response shape; the full integration path is covered separately by architecture-map.test.ts.

nodes.name: impact-analysis-diff.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests defaultDiffRunner's committed-scope git diff behavior against a real throwaway git repository created via execFileSync, exercising the three-source diff logic that feeds ImpactAnalysisService.

nodes.name: impact-analysis.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests computeImpactedModules' path-prefix quotient rollup (grouping impacted files by 2-segment prefix, capped at 20 with an '(other)' overflow bucket) both as a pure function and end-to-end through ImpactAnalysisService.analyze.

nodes.name: mulberry32
nodes.summary: Seedable pseudo-random number generator used to make the property test's random graph generation deterministic and reproducible across runs.

nodes.name: bruteForceSccs
nodes.summary: O(V^3) brute-force reference implementation of strongly-connected-component detection via mutual reachability, used as the correctness oracle against which the Tarjan-based detectCycles is validated.

nodes.name: randomGraph
nodes.summary: Generates a random directed edge list of a given node count and density using the seeded PRNG, for property-test fuzzing of the cycle-detection algorithms.

nodes.name: teachingError
nodes.summary: Test helper that invokes a tool call expected to throw and asserts the thrown error carries a teaching message (e.g. a valid-values hint) rather than failing silently or opaquely.

nodes.name: imp
nodes.summary: Test helper constructing an ImpactedSymbol fixture object for a given file path, used to assert the impacted_modules quotient-rollup grouping logic.

nodes.name: symbol-graph-service.test.ts
nodes.summary: Full-method unit-test suite for SymbolGraphService (hasData, goToDefinition, lookupDefinition, getReferences, getEdges, getDependencies, listDefinitions, getTopCentralFiles, getProjectMap, getArchitecture, recomputeCentrality, snippet enrichment, and project-root caching), with the symbol-repository factory and workspace manager module-mocked so no live database is required.
nodes.languageNotes: Mocks module-level singletons (symbol-repository-factory, workspace-manager) before import so getSymbolRepository() resolves to a controllable stub — a bun:test module-mocking pattern that requires isolated-process execution.

nodes.name: makeDef
nodes.summary: Test helper building a SymbolDefinition fixture for a given file/name with overridable fields, used across SymbolGraphService method-coverage tests.

nodes.name: makeRef
nodes.summary: Test helper building a SymbolReference fixture (caller file/line/symbol/kind/target) for graph-traversal assertions in the SymbolGraphService suite.

nodes.name: makeImport
nodes.summary: Test helper building a SymbolImport fixture describing a from/to file import edge, optionally marked external, for dependency-graph assertions.

nodes.name: mockLookupResult
nodes.summary: Test helper constructing a DefinitionLookupResult fixture (found/ambiguous/not-found status) for stubbing DefinitionLookupService responses.

nodes.name: makeSnapshot
nodes.summary: Test helper assembling a full ProjectMapGraphSnapshot fixture (definitions, references, imports, centrality) used across SymbolGraphService.getProjectMap assertions.

nodes.name: embedding-cache-factory.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit test verifying createEmbeddingCache always returns an EmbeddingCachePg instance with a provider/model-derived namespace.

nodes.name: embeddings-cached-provider.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for CachedEmbeddingProvider using an in-memory fake cache, covering embedQuery/embedBatch cache hit/miss paths, availability delegation, stats, and the withCache factory helper.

nodes.name: embeddings-config.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the embedding provider configuration module, covering environment-variable-driven rate limits, max character limits, and API-key detection.

nodes.name: embeddings-provider.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for AISDKEmbeddingProvider covering text sanitization/truncation, per-provider model selection, direct Ollama API calls, retry/timeout behavior, availability checks, and the createProvider factory.

nodes.name: embedding-cache-contract.ts
nodes.summary: Type-only contract defining the EmbeddingCacheStore interface (get/set/batch/stats/cleanup) implemented by the PostgreSQL embedding cache.

nodes.name: embedding-cache-factory.ts
nodes.summary: Single-function factory that selects the embedding-cache backend; currently always returns a PostgreSQL-backed EmbeddingCachePg instance.

nodes.name: cached-provider.ts
nodes.summary: Decorator that wraps any EmbeddingProvider with a cache-first strategy, batching cache lookups and only calling the base provider for cache misses.
nodes.languageNotes: Decorator pattern over the EmbeddingProvider interface -- implements the same interface it wraps.

nodes.name: config.ts
nodes.summary: Central configuration for the multi-provider embedding system: per-provider env-driven rate limits and max-character limits, the embeddingProviders priority-ordered registry (Google, Vercel gateway, Ollama, and more), API-key detection, and retry/batch defaults.

nodes.name: rate-limiter.ts
nodes.summary: Sliding-window rate limiter for embedding API calls, enforcing per-provider requests-per-minute, tokens-per-minute, and requests-per-day limits with automatic wait/backoff.

nodes.name: metrics.ts
nodes.summary: Singleton MetricsCollector persisting embedding, compression, and context-optimization metrics (calls, tokens, cost, cache hit rate, latency percentiles) to a JSON file on disk, with a human-readable summary report and per-provider cost pricing table.
nodes.languageNotes: Classic singleton (static instance + getInstance()) that persists state to disk rather than an in-memory-only counter, so metrics survive process restarts.

nodes.name: createEmbeddingCache
nodes.summary: Factory function selecting the embedding-cache backend from the application's canonical database setting; always constructs an EmbeddingCachePg today.

nodes.name: CachedEmbeddingProvider
nodes.summary: EmbeddingProvider decorator that checks the cache before delegating to a wrapped base provider, batches cache misses into a single embedBatch call, and writes new results back to the cache.

nodes.name: withCache
nodes.summary: Convenience helper that wraps a base EmbeddingProvider and an EmbeddingCacheStore into a CachedEmbeddingProvider.

nodes.name: getRateLimits
nodes.summary: Resolves RPM/TPM/RPD and batch-size/delay rate limits for a provider from provider-specific environment variables, falling back to generic EMBEDDING_* vars.

nodes.name: getMaxChars
nodes.summary: Determines the maximum characters to send per embedding request based on provider and model-specific context-window heuristics, overridable via environment variable.

nodes.name: getProvidersByPriority
nodes.summary: Returns the configured embedding providers sorted by ascending priority (lower number tried first).

nodes.name: hasApiKey
nodes.summary: Checks whether a named embedding provider has the credentials it needs to run (API key for remote providers, or unconditionally true for local/no-key providers like Ollama and transformers).

nodes.name: EmbeddingRateLimiter
nodes.summary: Sliding-window rate limiter tracking per-minute and per-day request windows for a single embedding provider, exposing waitForCapacity to block until capacity is available and getStatus for current usage.

nodes.name: MetricsCollector
nodes.summary: Singleton metrics store that records embedding calls, compression runs, and context-optimization events with cost estimates from a per-provider pricing table, persists to a JSON file under data/metrics.json, and formats a human-readable summary report.

nodes.name: makeBaseProvider
nodes.summary: Test fixture builder that returns a minimal fake base EmbeddingProvider for exercising CachedEmbeddingProvider in isolation.

nodes.name: makeMemoryCache
nodes.summary: Test fixture builder returning an in-memory EmbeddingCacheStore implementation used as a fast, dependency-free cache double in CachedEmbeddingProvider tests.

nodes.name: makeConfig
nodes.summary: Test fixture builder returning a default EmbeddingProviderConfig for the Ollama provider, overridable per test.

nodes.name: 00.harness.smoke.test.ts
nodes.summary: E2E smoke test (T1) that proves the E2E harness itself works: verifies the live HTTP API is reachable, the MCP subprocess boots and advertises all 52 tools in the exact declared order, and the HTTP/MCP matrix-equivalence assertion holds for a read-only tool call.
nodes.languageNotes: Hardcodes the 52 expected tool names in declaration order and asserts a strict === count so a missing or misordered tool fails loudly instead of being masked by a >= comparison.

nodes.name: 02.indexing.test.ts
nodes.summary: E2E test validating the polyglot indexing contract: asserts the 33-file polyglot fixture covers every DEFAULT_ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS entry with a deterministic per-language sentinel, and exercises live indexing against the running stack including StructuralRuntime directly.

nodes.name: 05.memory.test.ts
nodes.summary: E2E test suite (T5) covering remember/recall/memory_update/memory_delete/memory_list against the live Tools API, Ollama embeddings, and MCP subprocess, seeding a canonical memory batch once and reusing it to amortize embedding latency.

nodes.name: postLong
nodes.summary: Issues a fetch POST with an AbortController-based timeout and JSON body/response handling, used as the base HTTP helper for every memory-tool call in this suite.
nodes.languageNotes: This timeout-bounded POST helper is re-implemented locally (not shared via _helpers.ts) in at least five E2E files — 05, 08, 14, 15, 19 — each with slightly different timeout defaults, rather than being centralized once.

nodes.name: assertRecallScores
nodes.summary: Asserts every memory in a recall/search payload carries a finite score within [0,1], labeling failures with the originating call for easier debugging.

nodes.name: seedAll
nodes.summary: Seeds the canonical set of test memories once per suite run, checking existing content via memList to avoid re-storing duplicates before subsequent tests reuse them.

nodes.name: 06.checkpoints.test.ts
nodes.summary: E2E test suite (T6, F68-F73) exercising create/list/restore checkpoint tools against the live stack, normalizing volatile fields (ids, timestamps) before comparing HTTP and MCP transport responses.

nodes.name: 18.graph-phase4.test.ts
nodes.summary: E2E test suite (T11b) covering the Phase-4 typed-edge and architecture surface -- typed edges, trace_path BFS, impact_analysis, and architecture-map -- against the shared live index, cross-checking MCP and HTTP transport parity.

nodes.name: 22.path-identity.test.ts
nodes.summary: E2E test (T15) verifying dedicated shared-index identity and path hygiene: indexing the polyglot fixture from a different filesystem path must not corrupt the canonical shared index's identity.

nodes.name: 23.owned-destructive.test.ts
nodes.summary: Self-contained destructive-recovery E2E harness that spawns its OWN dedicated PostgreSQL, Ollama, and Tools API child processes on isolated ports (3334/5433/11435), then verifies recovery behavior when each dependency is killed or restarted -- all gated behind RUN_OWNED_DESTRUCTIVE=1 and never touching the shared live stack.
nodes.languageNotes: Reimplements a miniature version of _helpers.ts/_mcp.ts's process-management primitives (spawn, health-poll, listener-pid tracking) scoped to an isolated port range, trading shared-helper reuse for total isolation from the live stack the other 20 E2E files depend on.

nodes.name: spawnOwned
nodes.summary: Spawns a child process for one owned-stack service (api/postgres/ollama), waits for its listener to bind the target port, and registers it in the ownedChildren map for later cleanup.

nodes.name: assertOwned
nodes.summary: Asserts a spawned owned service is the actual process listening on its port via lsof/ps cross-checks, and for Postgres additionally verifies its data directory and postmaster.pid agree with the spawned instance.

nodes.name: stopOwned
nodes.summary: Sends SIGTERM to an owned child process, waits for its listening port to free up, and deregisters it from ownedChildren.

nodes.name: cleanupOwned
nodes.summary: Best-effort teardown for one owned service: stops it if still tracked, then force-kills any leftover process still bound to its port.

nodes.name: writeConfig
nodes.summary: Writes a throwaway massa-ai config.json, with hooks enabled or disabled, into the isolated XDG config root used by the owned stack.

nodes.name: serviceEnv
nodes.summary: Builds the environment variable set (ports, DATABASE_URL, XDG paths) shared by every owned child process so they never collide with the real shared stack.

nodes.name: startPostgres
nodes.summary: Initializes (on first run) and spawns an owned, disposable PostgreSQL instance bound to a dedicated port and data directory.

nodes.name: startOllama
nodes.summary: Spawns an owned Ollama instance bound to a dedicated port and waits for its /api/tags endpoint to respond.

nodes.name: startApi
nodes.summary: Spawns an owned Tools API instance pointed at the owned PostgreSQL/Ollama pair and waits for its /health endpoint to report ready.

nodes.name: json
nodes.summary: Timeout-bounded fetch helper against the fixed-port owned API instance that returns the parsed JSON body alongside the HTTP status.

nodes.name: indexProject
nodes.summary: Triggers indexing on the owned API for a given project path/id and polls until the job completes, returning the final status.

nodes.name: createFixture
nodes.summary: Writes a small throwaway multi-file fixture project under a UUID-named temp directory for use by an owned-stack scenario.

nodes.name: hook
nodes.summary: Posts a single and a batch hook_ingest call against the owned API and asserts both return their expected status codes.

nodes.name: _mcp.ts
nodes.summary: MCP transport driver for E2E tests: spawns the real built massa-ai MCP server as a subprocess and drives it through the official SDK Client over StdioClientTransport, giving tests a true black-box MCP connection identical to how OpenCode or Claude connect.

nodes.name: startMcp
nodes.summary: Spawns the built massa-ai MCP server binary as a subprocess wired to the live Tools API, connects an SDK Client over stdio, and returns a handle exposing the client, its advertised tool names, and a stop() teardown.

nodes.name: mcpCall
nodes.summary: Invokes a single MCP tool by name through the connected client and parses its text-content result back into a JSON value.

nodes.name: requireTool
nodes.summary: Throws if a required tool name is not present in the MCP server's advertised tool list, failing a test early with a clear message.

nodes.name: polyglot-fixture.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the 33-language polyglot fixture contract -- one deterministic sentinel symbol expected per allowed file extension -- and provides helpers to inspect the fixture directory and statically assert its extension coverage matches DEFAULT_ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS exactly.

nodes.name: inspectPolyglotFixture
nodes.summary: Reads the polyglot fixture directory and returns its file list and sorted unique extension set, frozen to prevent accidental mutation by tests.

nodes.name: assertPolyglotContractStatic
nodes.summary: Statically asserts the polyglot fixture's declared expectations exactly match DEFAULT_ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS and that every sentinel maps to a real fixture file, catching drift between the fixture and the indexer's supported-extension list.

nodes.name: cycle-detection.ts
nodes.summary: Iterative (non-recursive) Tarjan strongly-connected-components finder over directed CALL edges, used by the architecture map's opt-in `cycles` aspect to surface file-level call cycles without risking a JS stack overflow.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses an explicit heap-allocated work stack instead of recursion specifically to avoid stack overflow on deep CALL graphs.

nodes.name: impact-analysis.ts
nodes.summary: Given a scoped git diff, reverse-traverses the import/reference graph to compute which symbols are impacted by a change and ranks them by a centrality+proximity risk score, bounded by depth/time/count budgets.
nodes.languageNotes: Reverse BFS is bounded by MAX_DEPTH, MAX_IMPACTED, MAX_DEF_QUERIES, and a wall-clock deadline so a pathological fan-out cannot exhaust memory or time; ships a behind-a-flag recursive-CTE alternative to the in-process BFS.

nodes.name: workspace-manager.ts
nodes.summary: Single source of truth for project registration and indexing status, persisting workspace rows to PostgreSQL and reacting to EventBus indexing lifecycle events to keep status current and trigger background centrality recomputation.

nodes.name: detectCycles
nodes.summary: Iterative Tarjan SCC algorithm over directed CALL edges using an explicit work stack (not recursion) to avoid stack overflow on deep call graphs; returns SCCs of size >1 plus self-looping singletons, budget-truncated for very large inputs.

nodes.name: ImpactAnalysisService
nodes.summary: Singleton service that runs a scoped git diff, maps changed files to symbols, reverse-traverses the import/reference graph up to a bounded depth, and scores impacted symbols by centrality+proximity risk.

nodes.name: computeImpactedModules
nodes.summary: Groups the full (pre-clamp) impacted-symbol set by 2-segment path-prefix into a capped quotient rollup, folding overflow into an '(other)' bucket.

nodes.name: defaultDiffRunner
nodes.summary: Production git-diff runner: runs a scoped `git diff --name-only` (unstaged/staged/committed/all), includes untracked new files while excluding secret-like paths, and validates ref params before shelling out.

nodes.name: WorkspaceManager
nodes.summary: Singleton managing project registration and indexing-status lifecycle (indexing/indexed/error) against the PostgreSQL workspaces table, subscribing to EventBus to auto-update status and trigger background centrality recomputation.

nodes.name: go_to_definition.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool that resolves where a symbol is declared, disambiguating by calling-file context, and returns location, doc comment, and code snippet.

nodes.name: GoToDefinitionTool
nodes.summary: MCP tool handler that delegates to SymbolGraphService.goToDefinition and shapes the result into a found/not-found response with location and snippet details.

nodes.name: health-checker-config.test.ts
nodes.summary: Verifies LocalHealthChecker resolves the embedding model name from config vs the OLLAMA_EMBEDDING_MODEL environment variable, with the shared config module mocked to control precedence.

nodes.name: project-identity-write-seams.test.ts
nodes.summary: T4 discrimination tests (spec req 3) proving PgHandoffStore.insert resolves a retired project id to its canonical target via ProjectIdentityAliasResolver at the write seam, rather than writing the stale id verbatim.

nodes.name: handoff
nodes.summary: Builds a HandoffRecord fixture whose projectId is a retired id, used to verify the alias-resolver write seam rewrites it to the canonical id.

nodes.name: mappingQuerier
nodes.summary: Stub Prisma query client returning a canned project-identity mapping row so the alias resolver can be exercised without a real database.

nodes.name: capturingClient
nodes.summary: Stub Prisma client that records every raw SQL execution's arguments so the test can assert the resolved canonical project id was written, not the retired one.

nodes.name: session-file-cache.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for SessionFileCache covering chunk-key generation, first delivery, unchanged/changed chunk detection with diffing, per-session isolation, cache invalidation, and stats reporting.

nodes.name: token-metrics.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for TokenMetrics' unified token-savings tracking across SessionFileCache, RedundancyFilter, and ContextController integrations, including aggregated statistics, time-series history, and models.dev pricing API integration with fallback.

nodes.name: handoff-contract.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the HandoffStore contract (insert/getById/listPending/setStatus/journalMode) and HandoffRecord shape shared by all handoff store implementations, plus an in-memory MemoryHandoffStore test double that is never selected by the production factory.

nodes.name: MemoryHandoffStore
nodes.summary: In-memory HandoffStore implementation used only as a test double; stores records in a plain array with deep-cloned reads/writes.

nodes.name: contracts.ts
nodes.summary: Zod request/response schemas and TypeScript contracts for the project identity rename/merge API: validates preview and apply requests, defines the plan-material shape used for hashing, and declares the ProjectIdentityService and transaction-client interfaces shared by every transport.

nodes.name: project-identity-apply.test.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive test suite for ProjectIdentityApplyService covering idempotent replay, pre-mutation gates, rename and merge success paths, concurrent retry races, rollback failpoints, error sanitization, post-commit invalidation and event publishing (T4), and defective-registry diagnostics, against an in-memory transactional fake client.

nodes.name: project-identity-contracts.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests the Zod request-contract validation for preview/apply requests and the canonical-JSON hashing utilities, including PostgreSQL driver value tagging (Date, bytea, bigint) fixed by the T6 finding.

nodes.name: project-identity-pg-array-codec.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the PG array-literal codec (parse/serialize round-trip, quoting, NULL tokens) and inspectIdentityPayload's text-array handling for both literal-string and native-array driver representations.

nodes.name: project-identity-planner.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests project identity storage discovery against a fake information_schema client and the ProjectIdentityPreviewPlanner's dry-run preview behavior.

nodes.name: parseProjectIdentityPreviewRequest
nodes.summary: Validates and parses an unknown input into a ProjectIdentityPreviewRequest via the Zod preview schema, throwing a sanitized ProjectIdentityError on failure.

nodes.name: parseProjectIdentityApplyRequest
nodes.summary: Validates and parses an unknown input into a ProjectIdentityApplyRequest via the Zod apply schema (requiring operationId and expectedPlanHash), throwing a sanitized ProjectIdentityError on failure.

nodes.name: FakeTransactionClient
nodes.summary: In-memory transactional fake with staged/committed row snapshots (COMMIT copies staged to committed, ROLLBACK reverts), fault injection after the first mutation, and mutation-count tracking - the primary test double driving every ProjectIdentityApplyService scenario in this suite.

nodes.name: baselineClient
nodes.summary: Builds a baseline FakeTransactionClient seeded with the standard registry tables for apply scenarios.

nodes.name: withSourceAndTarget
nodes.summary: Seeds a FakeTransactionClient with both source and target workspaces (or source-only for rename) plus optional row overrides.

nodes.name: serviceFor
nodes.summary: Constructs a ProjectIdentityApplyService wired to the given FakeTransactionClient via a minimal withTransaction adapter.

nodes.name: previewHash
nodes.summary: Computes the expected plan hash for a client/mode/source/target combination, mirroring computeIdentityPlan, to construct valid apply requests.

nodes.name: FakeClient
nodes.summary: Fake ProjectIdentityQueryClient returning canned information_schema and workspace rows for storage-discovery and preview-planner scenarios.

nodes.name: errors.ts
nodes.summary: Defines ProjectIdentityError, the single sanitized error type (with SQLSTATE-style codes and HTTP status mapping) shared by Core, REST, and MCP transports for every project rename/merge failure mode.

nodes.name: hash.ts
nodes.summary: Deterministic canonical-JSON serialization and SHA-256 hashing utilities for project identity plans and apply requests, with special tagged encodings for PostgreSQL driver values (Date, bytea, bigint) so hashes never collide across representations.

nodes.name: pg-array-codec.ts
nodes.summary: Hand-written parser and serializer for PostgreSQL TEXT-column array literals (e.g. `{a,b}`), handling quoting, escaping, and NULL tokens so identity payloads round-trip correctly regardless of whether the driver returns a literal string or a native array.

nodes.name: planner.ts
nodes.summary: Computes the authoritative, order-independent project identity plan (store counts, conflicts, unknown storage, and a storage fingerprint) shared by preview and apply, and exposes ProjectIdentityPreviewPlanner as the read-only dry-run entry point.

nodes.name: ProjectIdentityError
nodes.summary: Sanitized public error class for the project identity module: maps each error code to a fixed message and HTTP status, shared verbatim by Core, REST, and MCP so no transport leaks raw SQL or row data.

nodes.name: hashProjectIdentityRequest
nodes.summary: Computes a stable SHA-256 digest over an apply request's identity material (mode, source, target, operationId) used to detect operationId reuse with different request material.

nodes.name: canonicalize
nodes.summary: Recursively converts an arbitrary value into a canonical JSON-safe form: sorts object keys, rejects NaN/undefined/cycles, and tags Date/Buffer/Uint8Array/bigint values so they never collide with plain strings holding the same characters.

nodes.name: canonicalProjectIdentityJson
nodes.summary: Serializes a value to its canonical JSON string via canonicalize, the shared building block for every hash and fingerprint in the project identity module.

nodes.name: hashProjectIdentityPlan
nodes.summary: Computes the deterministic, version-bound SHA-256 plan hash over a normalized (sorted) ProjectIdentityPlanMaterial, so the same storage snapshot always yields the same hash regardless of query row order.

nodes.name: parsePgArrayLiteral
nodes.summary: Parses a PostgreSQL TEXT-array literal string (or passes through a native JS string array) into a string array, handling quoting, backslash escapes, and case-insensitive NULL tokens; returns undefined only for genuinely malformed input.

nodes.name: toPgArrayLiteral
nodes.summary: Serializes a string array to a PostgreSQL array literal, quoting and escaping elements that contain separators, quotes, braces, whitespace, or the NULL token so the literal round-trips through the parser unchanged.

nodes.name: selectColumnsFor
nodes.summary: Builds the deduplicated, quoted SELECT column list (identity column + primary key + material columns) for a discovered direct store.

nodes.name: loadDirectRows
nodes.summary: Loads every row from a direct store matching either the source or target project ID, projected to just the columns the plan needs.

nodes.name: computeIdentityPlan
nodes.summary: Computes the authoritative identity plan for a rename/merge request: validates source/target existence and retirement state, enforces root-match for merges, tallies per-store direct and adapted counts, detects key-collision and malformed-payload conflicts, and hashes the whole plan plus a storage fingerprint. Shared by preview and by apply inside its transaction.

nodes.name: ProjectIdentityPreviewPlanner
nodes.summary: Read-only dry-run entry point: parses a preview request, computes the identity plan, and wraps it as a ProjectIdentityPreview, translating any unexpected failure into PROJECT_IDENTITY_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE.

nodes.name: proposal-contract.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the ProposalStore contract (insert/getById/listPending/setStatus/journalMode) and status/kind enums shared by memory-change proposals, plus an in-memory MemoryProposalStore reference implementation used in tests and fallback paths.

nodes.name: MemoryProposalStore
nodes.summary: In-memory implementation of ProposalStore used for tests and non-persistent fallback paths; deep-clones records on every read/write to prevent aliasing.

nodes.name: session-file-cache.ts
nodes.summary: Singleton in-memory cache that tracks which file chunks were already delivered to an LLM within a session, enabling diff-only or reference-token delivery instead of resending unchanged content; evicts by LRU after a session cap or TTL.

nodes.name: computeDiff
nodes.summary: Produces a compact unified-style line diff between two versions of a file chunk's content, used to deliver only the changed lines instead of the full new content.

nodes.name: SessionFileCache
nodes.summary: Singleton per-session chunk-delivery tracker: classifies each check() as new/unchanged/changed against the session's last-seen hash, records token savings via TokenMetrics, and evicts idle or over-cap sessions.

nodes.name: token-metrics.ts
nodes.summary: Singleton metrics collector that tracks token savings from session caching, redundancy filtering, and compression, estimates USD cost savings via a fetched/cached model-pricing table, and exposes rolling history plus a human-readable summary.

nodes.name: TokenMetrics
nodes.summary: Singleton that accumulates token-savings counters across session cache, redundancy filter, and compression sources, fetches and caches model pricing to estimate USD cost savings, and maintains a bounded rolling request history.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-exporting WorkingMemoryBuffer and its config/result types from the sibling working-memory-buffer implementation, forming the public entry point for Synapse's working-memory buffer.

nodes.name: fetcher.ts
nodes.summary: Fetches and converts a single URL's content (HTML→markdown or JSON→key-path chunks) behind the SSRF guard, applies a size cap while streaming the body, chunks the result for indexing, and honors a TTL-based re-index skip.

nodes.name: composeFetchCacheKey
nodes.summary: Builds the TTL-cache key for a fetched URL from its source label and a truncated SHA-256 hash of the URL.

nodes.name: readCappedBody
nodes.summary: Streams a fetch Response body up to MAX_FETCH_BYTES, aborting the read and canceling the stream once the cap is exceeded to bound memory use for arbitrarily large remote responses.

nodes.name: fetchAndConvertOne
nodes.summary: End-to-end single-URL pipeline: checks the TTL cache, fetches through the SSRF guard, reads the capped body, converts/chunks it by content type, indexes the chunks, and marks the URL as indexed.

nodes.name: buildChunks
nodes.summary: Converts a fetched body into IndexedChunks based on content type — JSON is flattened into key-path chunks, HTML is converted to markdown and sliced, everything else is treated as plain text.

nodes.name: sliceMarkdown
nodes.summary: Splits long markdown into size-bounded slices, preferring to break on the last newline before the limit to avoid cutting mid-line.

nodes.name: html-to-md.ts
nodes.summary: Converts HTML to markdown via a lazily-initialized Turndown instance (stripping scripts/styles) and flattens arbitrary JSON into readable key-path markdown chunks for indexing non-HTML fetch responses.

nodes.name: getTurndown
nodes.summary: Lazily constructs and memoizes a single configured Turndown instance (with script/style tags stripped) used to convert HTML to markdown.

nodes.name: htmlToMarkdown
nodes.summary: Converts an HTML string to markdown via the shared Turndown instance and collapses excess blank lines.

nodes.name: jsonToKeyPathChunks
nodes.summary: Entry point that flattens an arbitrary JSON value into a list of readable key.path: value markdown lines via the recursive walk helper.

nodes.name: walk
nodes.summary: Recursively walks a JSON value, emitting one markdown bullet per leaf/array/object path so deeply nested JSON becomes flat, greppable text for indexing.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Public barrel for the web ingestion service, re-exporting the SSRF guard, HTML/JSON-to-markdown converters, fetch-and-chunk primitives, and WebController orchestrator as a single import surface.

nodes.name: ssrf.ts
nodes.summary: Server-Side Request Forgery guard for fetch_and_index: classifies IPs against a strict block-list (link-local/IMDS, loopback, RFC1918, multicast, malformed), then resolves DNS once and pins the outbound connection to the classified IP to close TOCTOU DNS-rebinding gaps, including on redirects.
nodes.languageNotes: The DNS-pin technique rewrites the fetch URL to the already-classified literal IP and sets the Host header to the original hostname, so the runtime's own connect-time DNS re-resolution never runs — closing the classic TOCTOU rebinding window between check and connect.

nodes.name: setDnsResolver
nodes.summary: Test/DI seam that overrides the module's DNS resolver function, allowing tests to simulate DNS-rebinding scenarios without real network lookups.

nodes.name: classifyIp
nodes.summary: Classifies a raw IP string (v4 or v6) into a safety category — loopback, link-local/IMDS, private RFC1918/ULA, multicast, unspecified, malformed, or public — the core decision function the SSRF guard blocks on.

nodes.name: assertUrlSafe
nodes.summary: Validates a URL's scheme and resolves and classifies every DNS-returned address, throwing SsrfBlockedError if any address is unsafe or if the hostname is malformed — the pre-connect half of the DNS-rebinding defense.

nodes.name: looksLikeIpLiteral
nodes.summary: Heuristically detects whether a hostname string is already a literal IPv4/IPv6 address rather than a DNS name.

nodes.name: fetchWithSsrfGuard
nodes.summary: SSRF-safe fetch wrapper that validates the URL, pins the connection to its classified IP, performs the request with a timeout, and re-validates each redirect target before following it manually.

nodes.name: pinConnection
nodes.summary: Rewrites a URL's host to a literal, already-classified IP address so the runtime's own DNS resolution is bypassed at connect time, closing the SSRF TOCTOU window.

nodes.name: SsrfBlockedError
nodes.summary: Typed error thrown when a fetch target is blocked by the SSRF guard, carrying the offending URL/IP and the specific block reason.

nodes.name: fetch_and_index.ts
nodes.summary: Thin MCP tool handler for fetch_and_index; validates nothing itself and delegates entirely to an injected run function that the Tools API route binds to WebController.fetchAndIndex (tests bind a stub instead).

nodes.name: FetchAndIndexTool
nodes.summary: IToolHandler implementation for fetch_and_index that declares the tool's MCP input schema and forwards every call to an injected run function, keeping the tool itself free of business logic.

nodes.name: search_code.ts
nodes.summary: Thin MCP tool handler for search_code that logs the request and delegates directly to SearchProjectTool.handle, sharing its search implementation under a code-oriented alias.

nodes.name: SearchCodeTool
nodes.summary: IToolHandler implementation for search_code that logs the incoming request and delegates handling directly to an internal SearchProjectTool instance.

nodes.name: native-skip.ts
nodes.summary: Test helper exposing an isNativeTarget platform/arch predicate and a describeNative conditional test-suite wrapper, used across the test suite to skip native tree-sitter grammar tests on unsupported platform/architecture combinations.

nodes.name: contextual-search-rlm.characterization.test.ts
nodes.summary: Characterization (golden-master) test suite for ContextualSearchRLM, covering RLM-gated contextual search behavior with mock search results, timing/gate helpers, and a stubbed native grammar set.

nodes.name: native-target-predicate.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the isNativeTarget platform/arch predicate that gates native tree-sitter grammar tests, exercising accepted and rejected platform/architecture combinations.

nodes.name: parse-long-class.test.ts
nodes.summary: Regression test verifying that ParseStage correctly parses very large class bodies without truncation or structural extraction errors.

nodes.name: structural-data-document.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests structural parsing of data-document content through StructuralRuntime, including embedded-slice query execution and source-span handling for a capacity-configurable runtime.

nodes.name: result
nodes.summary: Builds a mock search-result object (id, score, source) used as fixture data for characterization assertions.

nodes.name: makeStubGrammarSet
nodes.summary: Builds a stub grammar set map, keying stubbed parser entries by grammarArtifactKey to simulate native tree-sitter grammar loading in tests.

nodes.name: structural-grammar-readiness.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests parser-readiness validation and grammar-descriptor comparison logic, verifying grammar loader artifacts are validated and reported consistently before indexing begins.

nodes.name: structural-query-pack.test.ts
nodes.summary: Large test suite exercising tree-sitter query packs across TypeScript and other languages, verifying capability-gated query execution, capture normalization, and embedded-context resolution via StructuralRuntime.

nodes.name: grammar-integrity.ts
nodes.summary: Computes and verifies a SHA-512 source-integrity hash over the native tree-sitter grammar packages, guarding against silent tampering or drift from the locked native dependency identities.
nodes.languageNotes: Walks the package source tree deterministically (sorted directory entries, POSIX-normalized relative paths) so the resulting hash is stable across platforms.

nodes.name: descriptorEquals
nodes.summary: Structurally compares two PropertyDescriptor objects for the grammar-readiness test's own assertions.

nodes.name: parseTypeScriptWithCapabilities
nodes.summary: Parses TypeScript source with a given capability set by loading native grammars, selecting the dialect query pack, running StructuralRuntime, and executing the query pack against the resulting tree.

nodes.name: GrammarIntegrityError
nodes.summary: Error type for grammar-integrity verification failures, carrying a machine-readable code for programmatic handling.

nodes.name: resolvePackageRoot
nodes.summary: Resolves the on-disk root directory of an installed native grammar package by walking up from its resolved entry file to the directory containing package.json.

nodes.name: listSourceFiles
nodes.summary: Recursively lists all source files under a package root in deterministic sorted order, excluding ABI-specific build directories.

nodes.name: pushContribution
nodes.summary: Appends a labeled byte-buffer contribution (path plus content) into the running hash-input chunk list.

nodes.name: computePackageSourceIntegrity
nodes.summary: Computes a deterministic SHA-512 digest over a native grammar package's package.json, compiled grammar binary, and all source files.

nodes.name: verifyNativeGrammarIntegrity
nodes.summary: Verifies the source integrity of every trusted native grammar package against expectations, returning per-package pass/fail results.

nodes.name: resetGrammarIntegrityForTests
nodes.summary: Resets any cached grammar-integrity state; a test-only escape hatch matching the project's get*/reset* factory convention.

nodes.name: native-lock-identities.ts
nodes.summary: Pinned lockfile-derived identity table (versions and hashes) for every native tree-sitter grammar dependency plus the patched tree-sitter core package, consumed to verify native module integrity before parsing.

nodes.name: native-node-helpers.ts
nodes.summary: Low-level tree-sitter AST helper library providing byte-range text extraction, field/child lookups, BFS descendant traversal, and the large per-language symbolName resolver that extracts a declaration's name from dozens of different grammar node shapes.
nodes.languageNotes: symbolName alone spans ~90 lines of language-specific branching (JS/TS, Python, Rust, Elixir, Haskell, Kotlin, Swift, C#, Erlang, Clojure, OCaml, and more) to locate a declaration's identifier node.

nodes.name: parser-pool.ts
nodes.summary: Bounded, timeout-aware object pool that hands out reusable native tree-sitter Parser instances so concurrent structural parses don't exceed a capacity limit or hang indefinitely waiting for one.

nodes.name: query-pack-captures.ts
nodes.summary: Normalizes raw tree-sitter query captures into deduplicated, sorted structures and extracts language-specific import bindings (including Rust's nested use trees) and embedded-language slices such as Vue SFC blocks and fenced Markdown code blocks.

nodes.name: data-document.ts
nodes.summary: Declares the tree-sitter query packs for markup/data-document languages: Vue, Markdown, JSON, and YAML.

nodes.name: descendants
nodes.summary: Breadth-first collects every descendant node beneath a given tree-sitter node.

nodes.name: symbolName
nodes.summary: Extracts a declaration's display name from a tree-sitter node across dozens of language-specific grammar shapes (JS/TS, Python, Rust, Elixir, Haskell, Kotlin, Swift, C#, and more).

nodes.name: ancestor
nodes.summary: Walks up a node's parent chain to find the nearest ancestor of a given type.

nodes.name: unquote
nodes.summary: Strips matching quote characters from a raw source token, used when reading string-literal import paths and names.

nodes.name: frozenSpan
nodes.summary: Builds an immutable SourceSpan object from a SourceIndex and a pair of byte offsets.

nodes.name: ParserAcquireTimeoutError
nodes.summary: Error thrown when no pooled tree-sitter parser becomes available before the configured acquire timeout elapses.

nodes.name: StructuralParserPool
nodes.summary: Fixed-capacity pool of native tree-sitter Parser instances with FIFO waiter queuing and timeout-based acquisition, preventing unbounded parser creation under concurrent structural indexing.

nodes.name: normalizeQueryCaptures
nodes.summary: Sorts tree-sitter query captures by source position and removes duplicate (name, node) pairs.

nodes.name: frozenBindings
nodes.summary: Deduplicates a list of import bindings by imported/local/typeOnly/arity key and deep-freezes the result.

nodes.name: importBindings
nodes.summary: Extracts the list of imported names, aliases, and type-only flags from an import-statement capture across JS/TS-family grammars.

nodes.name: rustUseLeaves
nodes.summary: Recursively flattens a Rust use tree, including nested use_list groups, into individual leaf import paths.

nodes.name: functionalCaptures
nodes.summary: Builds captures for functional-language definition forms such as Clojure's defn/defrecord, classifying them by symbol family.

nodes.name: collectEmbeddedChildren
nodes.summary: Detects embedded-language regions such as Vue SFC blocks and fenced Markdown code blocks, slicing out their source range plus declared language tag for delegated parsing.

nodes.name: functional.ts
nodes.summary: Declares the tree-sitter query packs for functional languages: Elixir, Erlang, Clojure, OCaml, and Haskell.

nodes.name: managed.ts
nodes.summary: Declares the tree-sitter query packs for managed/VM languages: Java, Kotlin, Scala, C#, Swift, and Dart.

nodes.name: scripting.ts
nodes.summary: Declares the tree-sitter query packs for scripting languages: Python, Ruby, PHP, and Lua.

nodes.name: systems.ts
nodes.summary: Declares the tree-sitter query packs for systems languages: C, C++, Go, Rust, and Zig.

nodes.name: typescript.ts
nodes.summary: Declares the tree-sitter query packs for TypeScript and JavaScript, the project's own primary implementation languages.

nodes.name: metrics.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for MetricsCollector and PerformanceTracker, verifying per-model token-cost calculation, fallback pricing, compression-event recording, and aggregated report generation.

nodes.name: rate-limiter.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the token-bucket RateLimiter and the combined SmartRateLimiter, covering refill timing, tryConsume/consume behavior, and capacity status reporting.

nodes.name: types.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests validating the shape and values of the core shared enums (MemoryLevel, MemoryType) and the structural-transport symbol-kind taxonomy re-exported through types/index.ts.

nodes.name: xdg.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the pure XDG Base Directory resolution helpers, covering env-var precedence and default fallbacks for config/data/cache/runtime/state home directories.

nodes.name: xdg.ts
nodes.summary: Pure XDG Base Directory Specification resolver (config/data/cache/runtime/state home plus per-app subdirectory helpers) with zero project-module imports, deliberately breaking the config-loader/massa-ai-config circular dependency.
nodes.languageNotes: Explicitly zero-import by design (file docstring cites spec AC1/N36): only Node's `path`/`os` builtins are used so both config-loader.ts and massa-ai-config.ts can import it without forming a cycle.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Core shared type definitions for the memory hierarchy (MemoryLevel, MemoryType, Memory, MemoryMetadata), cache entries, search results, and compression contracts used across package boundaries; also re-exports the structural-transport symbol taxonomy.

nodes.name: structural-transport.ts
nodes.summary: Canonical symbol-kind taxonomy (STRUCTURAL_SYMBOL_KINDS) and FQN-resolution transport types shared by the HTTP and MCP structural/graph surfaces for definitions, references, and symbol traces.

nodes.name: metrics.ts
nodes.summary: Tracks LLM token usage, compression ratios, and cost savings (MetricsCollector) plus generic async-operation timing (PerformanceTracker), with a fallback per-model pricing table when the live pricing API is unavailable.

nodes.name: rate-limiter.ts
nodes.summary: Token-bucket `RateLimiter` primitive plus a `SmartRateLimiter` that combines separate request-count and token-count buckets (sized from config) to throttle LLM API calls, with async wait-for-capacity support.

nodes.name: MetricsCollector
nodes.summary: Static collector that computes per-request LLM cost from token counts and model pricing (with a fallback pricing table), records compression events, and aggregates them into a human-readable savings report.

nodes.name: PerformanceTracker
nodes.summary: Wraps an arbitrary async function to time its execution and record success/failure duration stats, exposing aggregate getStats() (avg/min/max, success rate) per operation name.

nodes.name: RateLimiter
nodes.summary: Token-bucket rate limiter primitive with time-based refill, a synchronous tryConsume, and an async consume that sleeps until capacity is available.

nodes.name: SmartRateLimiter
nodes.summary: Combines a request-count RateLimiter and a token-count RateLimiter (both sized from config) into one throttle for LLM API calls, with checkRequest, async waitForCapacity, and status reporting.

nodes.name: compress-context.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the compress_context MCP tool, exercising CodeCompressor's deterministic regex path with the LLM explicitly disabled via a test seam for reproducibility.

nodes.name: compressed-content.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the CompressedContent model, covering its constructor, static factories (create, identity, merge), and instance methods (calculateRatio, isEffective, getQualityScore, validate, toJSON).

nodes.name: llm-client-json-schema.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for Ollama json_schema constrained-decoding support in llmObject, covering the version-gated fallback to json_object and graceful degradation on schema errors, with the AI SDK network layer mocked.

nodes.name: reranker.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests for LLMJudgeReranker covering verdict application, window sizing, and silent degradation to input order on disabled or failed LLM calls, using an injected fake LLM surface.

nodes.name: salience-judge.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests for SalienceJudge's memory-importance scoring, covering the auto-importance config gate, neutral-default degradation paths, and clamping of LLM-returned scores, with config and the LLM surface mocked.

nodes.name: CompressedContent.ts
nodes.summary: Data model representing semantically compressed content with token-savings metadata, offering static factories (create, identity, merge) and quality/validation helpers used by the compression pipeline.

nodes.name: salience-judge.ts
nodes.summary: LLM-backed judge that scores a memory's importance (0-1) for MemoryController's auto-importance path, degrading silently to a neutral 0.5 default whenever the LLM or the feature flag is off.

nodes.name: query-understanding.ts
nodes.summary: Query understanding service that expands a search query via LLM rewrite (expansions + keywords) and HyDE (hypothetical-document embedding) behind a TTL-bounded per-project cache, returning null on any LLM failure so the caller falls back to the original search path.

nodes.name: reranker.ts
nodes.summary: LLM-judge reranker that re-scores the top-K fused search results via a single structured llmObject call, applying the returned permutation while guaranteeing no results are dropped or duplicated; degrades to the verbatim input order on any failure.

nodes.name: fakeSurface
nodes.summary: Builds a fake QueryLlmSurface returning a configurable rerank verdict, used to drive LLMJudgeReranker.rerank in tests without a real LLM.

nodes.name: makeSurface
nodes.summary: Builds a fake LLM surface with a configurable importance verdict, isEnabled flag, and call-count tracking for SalienceJudge tests.

nodes.name: CompressedContent
nodes.summary: Value object for a compression result, bundling original/compressed text with token-savings metadata; exposes static factories (create, identity, merge) plus quality-scoring and validation instance methods.

nodes.name: getSalienceJudge
nodes.summary: Module-level singleton accessor for the default-configured SalienceJudge, lazily constructed on first call.

nodes.name: buildPrompt
nodes.summary: Builds the salience-scoring prompt from truncated memory content and its type, instructing the LLM to return a single JSON importance field in [0,1].

nodes.name: SalienceJudge
nodes.summary: Scores a memory's importance in [0,1] via an injectable LLM surface, returning the neutral default 0.5 whenever the auto-importance flag is off, the LLM is disabled, content is empty, or the call fails.

nodes.name: rewriteQuery
nodes.summary: Expands a search query into structured expansions + keywords via an injected LLM surface and zod schema, returning null on any failure so the caller falls back to the original query.

nodes.name: hyde
nodes.summary: Generates a hypothetical implementation paragraph via the LLM and embeds it with the injected embedFn only after the LLM step succeeds, returning the resulting vector or null on any failure.

nodes.name: buildRewrittenFTSQuery
nodes.summary: Builds a quoted FTS5 OR query from the original query plus rewrite-derived keywords, falling back to the sanitized original query when no keywords survive cleaning.

nodes.name: QueryUnderstandingCache
nodes.summary: Bounded TTL cache for query-understanding results keyed by projectId+query, evicting the entry with the earliest expiry when over capacity and supporting per-project invalidation.
nodes.languageNotes: Eviction is TTL-earliest-expiry based rather than true LRU, a deliberate choice per spec to avoid a new dependency.

nodes.name: QueryUnderstandingService
nodes.summary: Orchestrates query rewrite and HyDE behind a per-(projectId, query) cache, reusing the shared EmbeddingService singleton for HyDE embedding and returning null on any failure path so the caller falls through to the original 2-stream search.

nodes.name: buildPrompt
nodes.summary: Builds the rerank judge prompt listing the top-K candidates with truncated content and score, instructing the LLM to return a strict best-first id ordering.

nodes.name: applyVerdict
nodes.summary: Applies the LLM's ranked-id permutation to the candidate head, placing verdict-ordered ids first, appending any omitted ids in original order, and dropping verdict duplicates so output length always equals input length.

nodes.name: LLMJudgeReranker
nodes.summary: Re-scores the top-K fused search results via a single structured llmObject call against an injectable LLM surface, degrading to the verbatim input order whenever the feature is off, disabled, or the call fails.

nodes.name: runtime.ts
nodes.summary: Detects installed language runtimes on the host (js/ts/python/shell/ruby/go/rust/php/perl/r) via command-existence and version probes, and builds the per-language invocation command used to run a sandboxed script.

nodes.name: commandExists
nodes.summary: Cheap `command -v`/`where` probe reporting whether a binary is on PATH, without running a --version check.

nodes.name: runnableExists
nodes.summary: Combines commandExists and getVersion to determine whether a runtime is both present on PATH and actually invocable.

nodes.name: getVersion
nodes.summary: Runs a command's version flag (shell or execFileSync path, chosen for argument-escaping safety) and returns the first line of output, or a placeholder on failure.

nodes.name: detectRuntimes
nodes.summary: Probes the host for all 10 supported language runtimes (node/python/bash/ruby/go/rustc/php/perl/Rscript) and returns a RuntimeMap of resolved commands or null for each unavailable language.

nodes.name: getRuntimeSummary
nodes.summary: Formats a human-readable multi-line summary of each detected runtime's availability and version, used for diagnostics.

nodes.name: getAvailableLanguages
nodes.summary: Returns the subset of supported languages that have a detected runtime available on the host.

nodes.name: buildCommand
nodes.summary: Builds the per-language invocation command array for a given script file path, mapping each of the 10 supported languages to its interpreter/compiler invocation, including a special Rust compile-then-run marker.

nodes.name: scheduler-safe-defaults.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests verifying the MASSA_AI_SCHEDULER_SAFE_DEFAULTS preset applied inside registerDefaultJobs correctly bumps consolidation/decay intervals and enables those jobs while leaving auto-improve and observation-bridge untouched.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Public barrel for the scheduler module, re-exporting the Scheduler engine, its store implementation/factory, cron utilities, shared domain types, and default-job registration.

nodes.name: scheduler-cron.ts
nodes.summary: Standalone 5-field cron expression parser (parseCron) and next-run-time calculator (nextCronRun) used by the Scheduler to compute a job's next fire time without any external cron library.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements cron scheduling semantics (wildcards, steps, ranges, lists) from scratch using pure UTC date arithmetic.

nodes.name: scheduler-defaults.ts
nodes.summary: Wires the existing memory-consolidation, decay-sweep, auto-improve, and observation-bridge job implementations to the Scheduler as default-disabled, conservative-interval jobs, with handlers lazily dynamic-imported to avoid pulling heavy job-layer dependencies into the scheduler module.
nodes.languageNotes: Handlers are registered via dynamic import() inside registerDefaultJobs (targets packages/core/src/services/jobs/*.ts) to keep the scheduler module free of direct job-layer dependencies; MASSA_AI_SCHEDULER_SAFE_DEFAULTS applies a conservative-interval preset before the per-kind env overrides are read.

nodes.name: scheduler-store-factory.ts
nodes.summary: Factory that lazily constructs and caches the singleton PgScheduledJobStore, guarding against a missing PostgreSQL DATABASE_URL and matching the getJobStore()/getMemoryRepository() factory pattern used elsewhere in the codebase.

nodes.name: scheduler-store.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the backend-neutral ScheduledJobStore interface — the synchronous persistence contract (save/get/listAll/listEnabled/delete) that any scheduler storage backend must implement.

nodes.name: scheduler-types.ts
nodes.summary: Shared TypeScript types for the scheduler domain: JobKind, ScheduleSpec, ScheduledJob (the persisted row shape including the success/failure split fields), JobHandler, TickResult, and SchedulerStatus.

nodes.name: scheduler.ts
nodes.summary: Core in-process Scheduler engine: a clock-driven tick loop that fires registered job handlers by jobKind on their cron/interval schedule, with a concurrency guard and cap, a missed-run skip-and-reschedule catch-up policy, and a module-level getScheduler()/resetScheduler() singleton.
nodes.languageNotes: Handlers are registered separately from job definitions (JobKind to JobHandler registry) so the scheduler never depends directly on job implementations; the tick timer is .unref()'d so it never keeps the process alive solely for scheduling.

nodes.name: makeInMemoryStore
nodes.summary: Test fixture building an in-memory Map-backed ScheduledJobStore stand-in used by the safe-defaults preset test suite.

nodes.name: parseField
nodes.summary: Parses one cron field (minute/hour/day/month/weekday) supporting wildcards, steps (*/n), ranges (a-b), and comma-separated lists into a sorted array of valid values within [min, max].

nodes.name: parseCron
