nodes.summary: Parses a standard 5-field cron expression string into a ParsedCron structure by delegating each field to parseField, normalizing day-of-week 7 to 0 (Sunday).

nodes.name: nextCronRun
nodes.summary: Computes the next UTC timestamp at or after a given time that satisfies a ParsedCron schedule, incrementally advancing month, day, hour, and minute until all field constraints match.

nodes.name: applySafeDefaults
nodes.summary: Applies the MASSA_AI_SCHEDULER_SAFE_DEFAULTS preset to a single default job definition, enabling consolidation and decay jobs at conservative minimum intervals (>=30min / >=60min) while leaving auto-improve and observation-bridge untouched.

nodes.name: registerDefaultJobs
nodes.summary: Boot-time wiring function that registers handlers for the four existing job kinds (memory-consolidation, decay-sweep, auto-improve, observation-bridge) on a Scheduler instance and upserts their default-disabled job definitions, applying the safe-defaults preset and per-kind env overrides.

nodes.name: getScheduledJobStore
nodes.summary: Returns the cached singleton ScheduledJobStore, constructing a PgScheduledJobStore on first call after verifying a PostgreSQL DATABASE_URL is configured.

nodes.name: resetScheduledJobStore
nodes.summary: Clears the cached ScheduledJobStore singleton, forcing the next getScheduledJobStore() call to reconstruct it; used by tests.

nodes.name: getScheduler
nodes.summary: Returns the module-level cached Scheduler singleton, constructing it with default options on first call.

nodes.name: resetScheduler
nodes.summary: Stops and clears the cached Scheduler singleton and resets the underlying ScheduledJobStore singleton; used by tests to get a clean scheduler between cases.

nodes.name: Scheduler
nodes.summary: In-process clock-driven job scheduler: maintains a jobKind-to-handler registry, ticks on a setInterval to fire enabled jobs whose nextRunAt has passed, enforces a concurrency guard and cap, and provides a missed-run catch-up policy (skip-and-reschedule) plus status/lifecycle methods.

nodes.name: smart-chunker.test.ts
nodes.summary: Coarser-grained characterization tests for smartChunk covering markdown, JSON, YAML, and code chunking behavior (label presence, chunk type, merge behavior) as a broad smoke test alongside the stricter byte-identical suite.

nodes.name: chunker-post.ts
nodes.summary: Shared post-processing pass for all chunkers — merges undersized chunks into neighbors, splits oversized chunks by line/char budget, and provides the fixed-size fallback chunker used when no format-specific strategy applies.

nodes.name: chunker-types.ts
nodes.summary: Shared type definitions (Chunk, ChunkerConfig) and default configuration constants for the smart-chunker module family.

nodes.name: smart-chunker.ts
nodes.summary: Format-aware chunking dispatcher and barrel facade that routes file content to the right chunker (markdown/JSON/YAML/code/fixed) by extension, applies post-processing, and optionally prefixes chunks with file-path and section-label context headers for embedding.
nodes.languageNotes: Classic TypeScript barrel: re-exports the entire chunker/ submodule surface (types, per-format chunkers, post-processing) alongside its own dispatch logic, so downstream consumers across the codebase only need one import path.

nodes.name: postProcess
nodes.summary: Second pass over chunker output that merges undersized chunks (below minChunkLines) into the previous chunk and splits oversized chunks via splitOversizedChunk, enforcing per-format line/char budgets.

nodes.name: splitOversizedChunk
nodes.summary: Splits a single oversized chunk into smaller sub-chunks at blank-line boundaries where possible, falling back to character-budget splitting via splitLineByChars for individual long lines.

nodes.name: splitLineByChars
nodes.summary: Splits a single very long line into multiple parts at word boundaries where possible, respecting a maximum character budget per part.

nodes.name: chunkFixed
nodes.summary: Fallback chunker that splits content into fixed-size line windows, used by every format-specific chunker when no smarter strategy applies or parsing fails.

nodes.name: smartChunk
nodes.summary: Main chunking dispatcher — selects a format-specific chunker by file extension (markdown/JSON/YAML/code/fixed), runs post-processing, and optionally prefixes each chunk with file-path and section-label context headers for embedding.

nodes.name: observation-emitter.ts
nodes.summary: Batches and debounces lifecycle observation events (tool use, prompts, sessions) and POSTs them to massa-ai's hook ingest endpoint, mirroring the Claude-plugin hook scripts by emitting raw host events for server-side classification rather than classifying them itself.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a fully injectable EmitterDeps interface (post/log/enabled/now/setTimer/clearTimer) so the batching and debounce logic is unit-testable without real timers or network calls; makeDefaultDeps wires the real fetch/setTimeout implementation.

nodes.name: session-project-pin.ts
nodes.summary: Memoizes a per-session project id computed via project id > git toplevel basename > directory basename > "default" precedence, plus an agentIdOf helper, so an OpenCode plugin session consistently attributes events to the same project even from subdirectory contexts.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements a bounded memo (default 1000 sessions) with oldest-key eviction using Map insertion order as an implicit LRU/FIFO structure.

nodes.name: session-project-pin.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for SessionProjectPin's per-session id memoization and eviction behavior alongside computePluginProjectId's fallback precedence.

nodes.name: buildToolPayload
nodes.summary: Converts an OpenCode tool call (name, args, output, cwd, sessionId) into the snake_case payload shape the server's observation classifier expects.

nodes.name: buildPromptPayload
nodes.summary: Builds a user-prompt observation payload including message/text aliases consumed server-side by classifyUserPrompt.

nodes.name: buildSessionPayload
nodes.summary: Builds a session-start/session-end observation payload from optional cwd, sessionId, model, settings, and env fields.

nodes.name: makeDefaultDeps
nodes.summary: Constructs the default EmitterDeps implementation backed by global fetch/setTimeout/Date.now, used to wire ObservationEmitter against the real runtime.

nodes.name: ObservationEmitter
nodes.summary: Batches lifecycle observation events and flushes them to the massa-ai hook-batch endpoint on a size/time debounce, swallowing network failures so emission never blocks the plugin's primary functions.

nodes.name: computePluginProjectId
nodes.summary: Resolves the plugin's project id using precedence: explicit projectId > git toplevel basename > directory basename > "default".

nodes.name: gitToplevelSafe
nodes.summary: Runs `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` via spawnSync with a 1s timeout, silently degrading to undefined on any failure or non-zero exit.

nodes.name: agentIdOf
nodes.summary: Extracts a host-provided agent id from an arbitrary event object, returning undefined when absent or not a non-empty string.

nodes.name: SessionProjectPin
nodes.summary: Per-session memo of a computed project id with bounded (default 1000-entry) eviction, so subsequent events in the same session reuse the first computed id.

nodes.name: dashboard-views.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the dashboard.js pure renderers, feeding deterministic fixtures into each observability section (scheduler, hook queue, Synapse sessions, system metrics) and asserting the resulting HTML, including running/empty/error/unavailable states.

nodes.name: web-ui-readonly.test.ts
nodes.summary: Enforces the Web UI's read-only guarantee by statically scanning app.js for every api.request() target and asserting none resolve to a forbidden mutating path, plus verifies write-mode-gated buttons only render when MASSA_AI_WEB_WRITE_MODE is enabled.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a regex-based static extraction of request() call targets plus a 'discrimination sensor' mutation test — it injects a fake mutating call into the source text and asserts the same assertion logic would catch it, guarding against a vacuously-passing test.

nodes.name: web-ui-render.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for app.js's markdownToHtml renderer (headings, bold/italic, inline/fenced code, lists, safe links, HTML-escaping) and the toggleTheme/initTheme dark-mode helpers exercised against fake document and localStorage doubles.

nodes.name: web-ui-views.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for app.js's HTML view renderers (projects, memory browser, search, handoffs, checkpoints), asserting each produces the expected fragments for populated, filtered, empty, and error-response fixtures matching the real REST response shapes.

nodes.name: dashboard.js
nodes.summary: Read-only dashboard module that fetches scheduler, hook-queue, Synapse-session, and system-metrics data in parallel via Promise.allSettled and renders each into an independent HTML section, degrading a single section to 'unavailable' instead of failing the whole page.

nodes.name: fetchDashboardData
nodes.summary: Fetches scheduler, hook-queue, Synapse-session, and metrics data from four endpoints in parallel via Promise.allSettled, unwrapping each into an independent {data, error} pair so one failing section doesn't block the others.

nodes.name: renderSchedulerSection
nodes.summary: Renders the scheduler status section as a jobs table (name, kind, enabled, next/last run, due, running) or a 'scheduler disabled'/'unavailable' message depending on data state.

nodes.name: renderHookQueueSection
nodes.summary: Renders the hook ingestion queue section showing pending count, max pending, and saturation state, or an 'unavailable' message on error.

nodes.name: renderSynapseSection
nodes.summary: Renders the active Synapse sessions table (session ID, agent, workspace, task context, expiry), or a 'No active sessions'/'unavailable' message depending on data state.

nodes.name: renderMetricsSection
nodes.summary: Renders the system metrics section showing process uptime, database size, and heap/RSS memory usage, or an 'unavailable' message on error.

nodes.name: renderDashboard
nodes.summary: Assembles the full observability dashboard by concatenating the scheduler, hook-queue, Synapse, and metrics sections into one HTML block, defaulting each to an 'unavailable' fixture when its data is missing.

nodes.name: cache-l1-memory.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for L1MemoryCache covering get/set/delete/clear/invalidatePattern/preWarm/getStats, LRU eviction under a size limit, adaptive TTL extension, expired-entry cleanup, and intelligent TTL derived from access patterns.
nodes.languageNotes: Injects L1 cache limits per test by mutating the shared singleton `config` through an unsafe cast to its private `set()` method, restoring production defaults in `afterEach`.

nodes.name: CacheEntry.ts
nodes.summary: Data model for a single entry in the hierarchical (L1/L2) cache, tracking TTL, access count/frequency, and size, with promotion/eviction heuristics and JSON serialization for persistence.
nodes.languageNotes: Generic class `CacheEntry<T>` implements the shared `ICacheEntry<T>` contract from `@massa-ai/shared`; `fromJSON`/`getDefaultTTL` are static factory helpers used to rehydrate entries and pick per-level defaults.

nodes.name: CacheEntry
nodes.summary: Generic cache entry tracking value, TTL, and access stats; exposes isExpired/getRemainingTTL/getAccessFrequency/shouldPromote/shouldEvict heuristics, an update() mutator, and toJSON/fromJSON round-trip plus a static per-level default-TTL lookup.

nodes.name: l1-memory-cache.ts
nodes.summary: Fastest tier of the hierarchical cache: a Map-backed in-memory LRU cache with size-limited eviction, periodic cleanup of expired entries, and adaptive/intelligent TTL calculated from recent access-interval patterns.
nodes.languageNotes: Layers a heuristic 'intelligent TTL' - derived from the average interval between the last 10 accesses - on top of standard LRU eviction (Map insertion order) and adaptive TTL extension on frequent reads, plus a background setInterval sweep started in the constructor.

nodes.name: L1MemoryCache
nodes.summary: In-memory LRU cache reading its size/TTL limits from shared config; get() promotes TTL on frequent access and re-orders entries for LRU, set() evicts the least-recently-used entry when over the size budget, and a background cleanup loop removes expired entries.

nodes.name: db-guard.ts
nodes.summary: Guards against a DEDICATED-stack process accidentally binding the shared production PostgreSQL database, plus URL validation and DB-name extraction helpers built on DATABASE_URL. Documents a real footgun where Bun auto-loads the repo-root .env and silently binds the shared massa_ai DB.
nodes.languageNotes: The exported assertDedicatedDbAllowed is a no-op unless MASSA_AI_DEDICATED=1, and is meant to be called immediately after env loading and before any DB client initialization — a fail-fast guard pattern rather than a runtime check embedded in the pool constructor.

nodes.name: int-env.ts
nodes.summary: Provides parsePositiveIntEnv for safely parsing positive-integer environment variables, avoiding the Number(env) || default bug where an explicit 0 is silently replaced by the default unless the caller opts in via { allowZero }.
nodes.languageNotes: The allowZero opt-in distinguishes 'unset/garbage, use default' from 'explicit zero is a valid value' — used for knobs like MASSA_AI_PROXY_TIMEOUT_MS where 0 means 'disable timeout' versus reaper intervals where 0 would cause a tight loop.

nodes.name: db-guard.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the DEDICATED-stack DB guard and integer env parsing utilities, covering URL validation, shared-vs-isolated DB name detection, the dedicated-mode fail-fast guard, and parsePositiveIntEnv's zero-handling behavior.

nodes.name: requirePostgresDatabaseUrl
nodes.summary: Validates and returns a usable PostgreSQL connection URL from DATABASE_URL (or an explicit argument), throwing before any DB pool is initialized if the URL is missing, malformed, uses a non-Postgres protocol, or lacks a database name.

nodes.name: getDbName
nodes.summary: Extracts and lowercases the database name (last path segment, query stripped) from a Postgres connection URL, returning null when the URL is unset or unparseable.

nodes.name: isSharedDb
nodes.summary: Checks whether a given database URL resolves to the shared/live massa_ai database name.

nodes.name: assertDedicatedDbAllowed
nodes.summary: Fail-fast guard that throws if a process flagged MASSA_AI_DEDICATED=1 would bind the shared production database instead of an isolated one; no-op when the flag is unset.

nodes.name: parsePositiveIntEnv
nodes.summary: Parses a positive integer environment variable, falling back to a default for unset, non-numeric, negative, or non-integer values; optionally honors an explicit 0 via { allowZero } instead of flooring it to the default.

nodes.name: mcp-stdout-clean.test.ts
nodes.summary: Regression guard verifying the MCP stdio server emits nothing on stdout during startup (a pure JSON-RPC channel) while all logs route to stderr — protects the stdio handshake from the Bug 3 dotenv/logger leak.
nodes.languageNotes: Spawns the compiled server under a throwaway HOME/XDG_CONFIG_HOME so the first-run 'write default config' branch — where the original leak hid — actually executes; inheriting the developer's HOME would silently skip that path.

nodes.name: spawnMcp
nodes.summary: Spawns the built MCP server binary under an isolated temp HOME and collects its stdout/stderr/exit code as a promise.

nodes.name: recover-project.test.ts
nodes.summary: Behavior tests (T34/N42) for recoverProjectPath: a valid projectId re-associates the Workspace row and preserves the projectId alias-chain, while an unknown projectId returns found:false without calling update. Prisma is mocked via mock.module.

nodes.name: recover-project.ts
nodes.summary: Implements recoverProjectPath (N42) — re-associates an indexed project's Workspace row with a new filesystem path via a Prisma update, without re-indexing, preserving the projectId alias-chain (M16/M17).

nodes.name: recoverProjectPath
nodes.summary: Looks up a Workspace by projectId and, if found, updates its projectPath to newPath, returning the old and new paths; returns found:false when no matching project exists.

nodes.name: project-reset.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests the POST /api/v1/project/reset route's lexical/semantic clear lifecycle (vector, keyword, symbol, memory deletion) and its M8 audit-log attribution (op, actor, scope, meta), using mock.module to stub out core repositories.

nodes.name: reset
nodes.summary: Test helper that POSTs a reset request body to the mounted Elysia app and returns the parsed status/JSON response.

nodes.name: events.test.ts
nodes.summary: Coverage for the SSE `/api/v1/events` route — heartbeat frames, auto-close after max duration, and the cancel-hook teardown regression (the stream's start-return cleanup used to be dead code), using env-overridden short timer intervals.

nodes.name: drain
nodes.summary: Polls the SSE reader on a short interval, accumulating decoded chunks for a fixed window so heartbeat/close frames can be asserted on.

nodes.name: dashboard.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests the dashboard data-fetch aggregator (fetchDashboardData) and its section renderers (scheduler, hook-queue, synapse, metrics) — covering fulfilled, rejected-Error, and non-Error rejection paths for each parallel API call.

nodes.name: index.test.ts
nodes.summary: Trivial smoke test asserting the web-ui package's WEB_UI_PACKAGE_MARKER constant equals "@massa-ai/web-ui", confirming the type-check-anchor entry point loads.

nodes.name: route-contract.test.ts
nodes.summary: Contract regression pinning the checkpoints-view renderer to a golden JSON fixture captured from the live `/api/v1/checkpoints/list` response, so renderer/route field-shape drift (e.g. `type` vs `checkpointType`) fails loudly instead of leaving the view silently empty.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Type-check anchor entry point for the @massa-ai/web-ui package — exports a package marker constant only; the real browser bundle is the zero-build static asset set (index.html, styles.css, app.js) served verbatim by the Tools API at /ui/*.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Single-page shell for the read-only massa-ai Memory Browser — hash-routed nav (projects/memory/search/handoffs/proposals/checkpoints/dashboard), a no-FOUC theme bootstrap script, and a module script tag loading the zero-build app.js bundle.
nodes.languageNotes: Loads marked and DOMPurify from a CDN for markdown rendering, and reads the persisted dark/light theme from localStorage before the stylesheet paints to avoid a flash of unstyled content.

nodes.name: styles.css
nodes.summary: Dependency-free stylesheet for the web UI memory browser — CSS custom properties for a light theme with a `[data-theme="dark"]` override, plus layout rules for the topbar, filters, data grids, cards, pager, and markdown content areas.
nodes.languageNotes: Theming is done entirely with CSS custom properties (--bg, --fg, --accent, etc.) redefined under a [data-theme="dark"] selector, so index.html's inline bootstrap script only needs to toggle one root attribute.

nodes.name: prisma.config.ts
nodes.summary: Prisma CLI configuration for packages/core — loads .env from the package root, points Prisma at prisma/schema.prisma and prisma/migrations, and forwards DATABASE_URL as the datasource URL when set.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Prisma's newer declarative prisma.config.ts (defineConfig) rather than the legacy package.json "prisma" key.

nodes.name: compression-index.test.ts
nodes.summary: Smoke test for the compression service barrel (services/compression/index.ts) — verifies CodeCompressor is exported, constructable, and reports the CODE_STRUCTURE compression strategy.

nodes.name: decorator-heavy.ts
nodes.summary: Polyglot e2e fixture exercising native tree-sitter structural extraction against heavy TypeScript decorator usage (class + method decorators) plus an intentionally-unresolvable import, used to validate the structural parser's resilience.
nodes.languageNotes: Combines stacked class decorators (@Injectable, @Component) with a method decorator and a deliberately-broken import ("./does-not-exist") to prove the structural extractor degrades gracefully instead of failing the whole file.

nodes.name: PolyRoot
nodes.summary: Decorator-annotated fixture class with a `title` field and a decorated `decoratedMethod`, used to test structural extraction of decorated class members.

nodes.name: polyFactory
nodes.summary: Factory function that constructs and returns a new PolyRoot instance.

nodes.name: symbol-repo-generation.ts
nodes.summary: Data-access layer for the symbol-graph generation lifecycle — locking pending or active generations, validating file writes against a lease, copying or deleting a file's symbols between generations, and marking files stale, all via raw SQL inside Prisma transactions.

nodes.name: lockOwnedPendingGeneration
nodes.summary: Acquires a row lock on the caller's pending generation and asserts the lease still owns it, guarding against concurrent generation takeover.

nodes.name: lockActiveGenerations
nodes.summary: Locks and returns the active generation id for each of a set of projects within a transaction, used to pin writes to the currently active generation.

nodes.name: validateGenerationFileWrite
nodes.summary: Validates that a file-write input's line and byte counts are well-formed non-negative integers before it is persisted.

nodes.name: definitionCandidate
nodes.summary: Builds a frozen candidate descriptor (file, qualified name, kind, signature hash) from a raw symbol definition row, used for FQN-alias comparisons.

nodes.name: compareDefinitionCandidates
nodes.summary: Comparator that orders definition candidates deterministically by file, qualified name, kind, then signature hash.

nodes.name: copyFileGeneration
nodes.summary: Copies a file's definitions, references, imports, and centrality rows from a source generation into the caller's pending generation, used when a file is unchanged across an incremental index.

nodes.name: writeFileGeneration
nodes.summary: Writes a file's full symbol set — definitions, references, and imports — into the pending generation in a single transaction, replacing any previously retained rows for that file.

nodes.name: deleteFileGeneration
nodes.summary: Removes a deleted file's definitions, references, and imports from the pending generation.

nodes.name: markFileStaleGeneration
nodes.summary: Marks a file as stale in the pending generation by carrying forward its last-known-good symbol rows, used when reparsing fails but prior data should still be queryable.

nodes.name: updateCentralityGeneration
nodes.summary: Writes updated centrality (importance) scores for a batch of files into the pending generation.

nodes.name: writeFileSymbols
nodes.summary: Legacy-path writer that persists a file's definitions and references directly against the active generation without going through the pending-generation lease flow.

nodes.name: symbol-repo-graph.ts
nodes.summary: Data-access layer for graph-shaped symbol queries — active-generation snapshots, import edges, reference lookups, project-map aggregates and snapshots, BFS impact analysis, and FQN resolution — all implemented as raw SQL against PostgreSQL.

nodes.name: getActiveGraphSnapshot
nodes.summary: Fetches the id and file/definition/reference/import counts of a project's currently active symbol-graph generation.

nodes.name: allFiles
nodes.summary: Returns the relative paths of every file tracked in a project's active generation.

nodes.name: allImportEdges
nodes.summary: Returns every import edge (from-file to to-file) recorded in a project's active generation.

nodes.name: updateCentrality
nodes.summary: Locks the active generation and writes a batch of updated centrality scores for the project's files.

nodes.name: findImporters
nodes.summary: Finds every file that imports a given target file within the active generation.

nodes.name: findReferencesByFqn
nodes.summary: Finds all symbol references that resolve to a given fully-qualified name.

nodes.name: findReferencesByName
nodes.summary: Finds all symbol references matching a bare symbol name, used when an FQN cannot be resolved.

nodes.name: getProjectMapAggregates
nodes.summary: Computes summary aggregates for the project map — definition counts by kind, file counts by extension, and recently indexed files.

nodes.name: getProjectMapSnapshot
nodes.summary: Builds the full project-map snapshot (workspace, files, definitions, imports, centrality, HTTP and call-graph edges) for the active or a specified generation.

nodes.name: runBfsCteImpact
nodes.summary: Runs a recursive SQL CTE breadth-first search over import edges to compute which files are impacted, within a hop limit, by a set of changed files.

nodes.name: findEdges
nodes.summary: Runs a dynamically-built filtered query over symbol reference edges, supporting filters by symbol, file, kind, and edge type.

nodes.name: countEdgesByKind
nodes.summary: Counts symbol reference edges in the active generation grouped by reference kind.

nodes.name: resolveDefinitionFqn
nodes.summary: Resolves a fully-qualified or legacy symbol name to its current definition row and any alias candidates sharing the same signature hash.

nodes.name: symbol-repo-identity.ts
nodes.summary: Pure helper functions that derive the identity columns (parsed FQN parts, canonical signature hash) used to upsert symbol definitions and references consistently across the repository layer.

nodes.name: definitionIdentityColumns
nodes.summary: Parses a symbol definition's FQN and derives the qualifier, simple name, and other identity columns used for upserts.

nodes.name: generationDefinitionIdentityColumns
nodes.summary: Extends definitionIdentityColumns with a canonical-signature SHA-256 digest and generation-scoped identity fields for the pending-generation write path.

nodes.name: referenceSourceSpan
nodes.summary: Validates and normalizes a symbol reference's source span (start/end line and byte offsets) into a fixed-length integer array.

nodes.name: symbol-repo-mappers.ts
nodes.summary: Pure mapper functions that convert raw PostgreSQL row shapes into the repository's typed workspace, file, definition, reference, and import domain objects.

nodes.name: mapWs
nodes.summary: Maps a raw workspace row into the typed WorkspaceRow domain object, converting timestamps to epoch millis.

nodes.name: mapFile
nodes.summary: Maps a raw symbol_files row into the typed SymbolFileRow domain object.

nodes.name: mapDef
nodes.summary: Maps a raw symbol_definitions row into the typed SymbolDefinition domain object.

nodes.name: mapRef
nodes.summary: Maps a raw symbol_references row into the typed SymbolReference domain object.

nodes.name: mapImp
nodes.summary: Maps a raw symbol_imports row into the typed SymbolImport domain object.

nodes.name: symbol-repo-queries.ts
nodes.summary: Core CRUD and query data-access layer for the symbol repository — workspace, file, definition, reference, import, and centrality operations plus batch-upsert helpers — implemented as raw SQL against PostgreSQL via Prisma, and re-exporting the workspace lifecycle functions.

nodes.name: getWorkspace
nodes.summary: Fetches a single workspace row by project id.

nodes.name: listWorkspaces
nodes.summary: Lists all workspace rows across all projects.

nodes.name: deleteWorkspace
nodes.summary: Deletes a workspace row by project id.

nodes.name: upsertFile
nodes.summary: Inserts or updates a tracked file's metadata row (hash, size, indexed timestamp) for a project.

nodes.name: getFile
nodes.summary: Fetches a single tracked file row by project id and relative path.

nodes.name: upsertDefinition
nodes.summary: Inserts or updates a single symbol definition row, computing its identity columns first.

nodes.name: deleteDefinitionsByFile
nodes.summary: Deletes all symbol definitions recorded for a given file.

nodes.name: searchDefinitions
nodes.summary: Searches symbol definitions by name substring with optional kind, exported-only, and file-path filters.

nodes.name: countDefinitions
nodes.summary: Counts symbol definitions matching the same filters as searchDefinitions, for pagination.

nodes.name: getDefinition
nodes.summary: Fetches a single symbol definition by its fully-qualified name.

nodes.name: insertReference
nodes.summary: Inserts a single symbol reference row after normalizing its source span.

nodes.name: deleteReferencesByFile
nodes.summary: Deletes all symbol references recorded for a given file.

nodes.name: getReferences
nodes.summary: Fetches symbol references matching a symbol name, most recent first, up to a limit.

nodes.name: insertImport
nodes.summary: Inserts a single symbol import edge row.

nodes.name: deleteImportsByFile
nodes.summary: Deletes all import edges recorded for a given file.

nodes.name: getImportsFrom
nodes.summary: Fetches all import edges originating from a given file.

nodes.name: upsertCentrality
nodes.summary: Inserts or updates a single file's centrality score.

nodes.name: getTopCentralFiles
nodes.summary: Fetches the highest-centrality files for a project, up to a limit.

nodes.name: getCentrality
nodes.summary: Fetches all centrality scores for a project as a file-path-to-score map.

nodes.name: batchUpsertDefinitions
nodes.summary: Batch-upserts many symbol definitions within a single locked-generation transaction.

nodes.name: batchInsertReferences
nodes.summary: Batch-inserts many symbol references within a single locked-generation transaction.

nodes.name: batchInsertImports
nodes.summary: Batch-inserts many symbol import edges within a single locked-generation transaction.

nodes.name: clearProject
nodes.summary: Deletes every workspace, file, definition, reference, import, and centrality row for a project.

nodes.name: getActiveGenerationScope
nodes.summary: Fetches the active generation id and status for a project, used to scope subsequent queries.

nodes.name: findDefinitionsByName
nodes.summary: Finds all symbol definitions matching an exact name across a project.

nodes.name: findDefinitionByFqn
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper around getDefinition for looking up a definition by fully-qualified name.

nodes.name: findDependencies
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper around getImportsFrom for finding a file's dependencies.

nodes.name: listDefinitions
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper around searchDefinitions with a paginated-list-shaped options object.

nodes.name: listAllDefinitions
nodes.summary: Lists every symbol definition for a project without name filtering, optionally scoped to a generation.

nodes.name: symbol-repo-types.ts
nodes.summary: Central TypeScript type definitions for the symbol repository layer — row shapes, workspace and generation options, query filters, and the raw-to-mapped row type pairs shared across all symbol-repo-*.ts modules.

nodes.name: symbol-repo-workspace.ts
nodes.summary: Workspace lifecycle data-access functions — creating or updating a workspace row and transitioning its indexing status, including the SQL to promote a pending generation to active on success.

nodes.name: upsertWorkspace
nodes.summary: Inserts or updates a workspace row and, when needed, creates its initial pending generation inside a transaction.

nodes.name: updateWorkspaceStatus
nodes.summary: Transitions a workspace's indexing status and, on success, promotes its pending generation to active while retiring the previous one.

nodes.name: fqn-codec.ts
nodes.summary: Core structural fully-qualified-name (FQN) codec — normalizes file paths and symbol text, canonicalizes and hashes structural signatures into a versioned format, parses and formats FQN strings, and resolves FQN aliases across schema versions via a registry.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses private class fields (#byDialectVersion-style) and NFC Unicode normalization to keep symbol identity stable across platforms and re-parses.

nodes.name: normalizeStructuralFile
nodes.summary: Normalizes a file path to the canonical structural form — NFC-normalized, forward slashes, no leading drive letter or slash.

nodes.name: canonicalizeStructuralSignature
nodes.summary: Builds a versioned, order-independent canonical JSON signature from a symbol's kind, parameter arity, type tokens, and modifiers, used as the hashing input for structural identity.

nodes.name: decodeCanonicalSignatureVersion
nodes.summary: Parses the version prefix out of a canonical signature string so callers can check schema compatibility before hashing.

nodes.name: assertCanonicalSignatureSupported
nodes.summary: Throws SchemaAheadError if a canonical signature's version is newer than this build supports.

nodes.name: sha256SignatureDigest
nodes.summary: Computes the SHA-256 hex digest of a canonical structural signature string.

nodes.name: createStructuralIdentity
nodes.summary: Builds the full structural identity (file, name, qualified name, kind, canonical signature, hash, FQN string) for a parsed symbol, validating the signature digest and detecting reserved-suffix collisions.

nodes.name: formatStructuralFqn
nodes.summary: Formats a structural identity into its canonical FQN string form (file#qualifiedName@hash).

nodes.name: parseStructuralFqn
nodes.summary: Parses a canonical or legacy FQN string back into its file, qualified name, and optional signature-hash components.

nodes.name: structuralFqnDisplayName
nodes.summary: Derives a short human-readable display name from a parsed FQN's qualified name.

nodes.name: candidate
nodes.summary: Builds a frozen candidate descriptor from a structural identity, used for deterministic alias-list ordering.

nodes.name: compareCandidates
nodes.summary: Comparator that orders FQN alias candidates deterministically by file, qualified name, kind, then signature hash.

nodes.name: FqnHashCollisionError
nodes.summary: Error thrown when two structurally-different symbols hash to the same modern FQN signature, carrying the offending code and signature hash.

nodes.name: StructuralFqnRegistry
nodes.summary: In-memory registry that indexes structural identities by canonical hash, modern FQN, and legacy FQN, detecting hash collisions on register and resolving either FQN form back to its identity or alias list.

nodes.name: prisma-client.ts
nodes.summary: Shared Prisma client singleton for PostgreSQL, lazily constructing the client with a pg-adapter connection pool on first use and exposing disconnect and test-reset helpers.

nodes.name: _resetPrismaForTesting
nodes.summary: Test-only helper that clears the cached Prisma client and pool singletons so a fresh instance is constructed on next use.

nodes.name: getPrismaClient
nodes.summary: Lazily constructs and caches the singleton Prisma client, wiring a pg Pool through the Prisma pg-adapter and requiring a PostgreSQL DATABASE_URL.

nodes.name: disconnectPrisma
nodes.summary: Disconnects the cached Prisma client and ends its underlying connection pool.

nodes.name: resolve.ts
nodes.summary: ETL pipeline stage that resolves parsed structural symbols into concrete cross-file references and import edges — matching import specifiers to files via tsconfig path aliases and monorepo package detection, then persisting the resolved symbol graph through the symbol repository.

nodes.name: ResolveStage
nodes.summary: ETL stage that resolves every file's raw imports and structural symbol references into concrete file paths and definition FQNs, combining tsconfig path-alias resolution, monorepo package aliasing, and a project-wide symbol index, then writes the resolved graph via the symbol repository.

nodes.name: memory-clustering.ts
nodes.summary: Memory clustering service that groups embedded memory rows into semantic clusters using a from-scratch k-means++ implementation, then summarizes and labels each cluster from its members' content.

nodes.name: MemoryClustering
nodes.summary: Singleton service that fetches a project's embedded memories, runs k-means++ clustering with an elbow-style cluster-count heuristic, and produces labeled, summarized clusters with a dominant memory type per cluster.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements k-means++ centroid seeding and Euclidean distance from scratch rather than depending on a numerics library, since embeddings are stored as raw byte buffers.

nodes.name: resolver.ts
nodes.summary: Structural resolver framework — a dialect-versioned registry of per-language resolvers, a builder that groups parsed symbols into resolver-ready definitions, and a per-parse-session resolver that turns raw symbol references into resolved FQNs using the registered dialect resolver.

nodes.name: buildStructuralResolverDefinitions
nodes.summary: Groups a set of parsed structural documents' symbols by declaration (merging split declaration/implementation pairs) and marks each definition as exported or synthesized-container based on qualified-name conventions.

nodes.name: StructuralResolverRegistry
nodes.summary: Version-aware registry mapping a language dialect to its structural resolver implementation, used so each language's import and reference resolution logic can evolve independently.

nodes.name: StructuralResolverSession
nodes.summary: Per-parse-session facade that builds structural identities for every document via a StructuralFqnRegistry, then resolves symbol references to FQNs by delegating to the dialect-appropriate resolver from the registry.

nodes.name: typescript.ts
nodes.summary: TypeScript/JavaScript-family structural resolver — resolves import specifiers (including path aliases) to concrete files, and matches symbol references to candidate definitions via same-file, re-export, and cross-file import resolution.

nodes.name: candidates
nodes.summary: Builds a frozen, deterministically-sorted list of lightweight candidate descriptors from a list of structural identities.

nodes.name: outcome
nodes.summary: Builds a resolution outcome object from a reference and its matches, deduplicating by FQN and marking whether the result is definite or ambiguous.

nodes.name: normalizedReference
nodes.summary: NFC-normalizes and trims a symbol reference's lexical scope, target name, and qualifier before matching.

nodes.name: indexDefinitions
nodes.summary: Builds a StructuralFqnRegistry index over a set of definitions, registering each by its de-hashed public and internal-suffixed qualified names.

nodes.name: resolveStructuralSpecifier
nodes.summary: Resolves a relative or path-aliased import specifier from a given file into a concrete known project file path, probing extensions and alias patterns.

nodes.name: matchesStructuralPathAlias
nodes.summary: Checks whether an import specifier matches any of a dialect's configured path-alias patterns.

nodes.name: exportedMatches
nodes.summary: Recursively finds a file's exported definitions matching a sought name, following re-export chains (export * from / export { x } from) up to the concrete defining file.

nodes.name: importedMatches
nodes.summary: Resolves a symbol reference that came from an import statement by resolving the import's specifier to a file and matching the reference against that file's, and for namespace imports its re-exported, definitions.
nodes.languageNotes: Handles a broad family of import forms across languages (esm_import, python_import, go_import, rust_use, java_import, and more) with the same matching logic, since the structural parser normalizes them to a common edge shape.

nodes.name: sameFileMatches
nodes.summary: Matches a symbol reference against definitions in the same file, narrowing by lexical scope when multiple same-name candidates exist.

nodes.name: workspace-manager.test.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL-backed unit test suite for WorkspaceManager, covering markIndexing, markIndexed, markError, listWorkspaces, getWorkspace, resolveByNameTail, removeWorkspace, and EventBus integration.

nodes.name: symbol-repository-pg.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL symbol-repository facade (N31): a singleton with one-line delegate methods that forward to per-domain query, graph, and generation modules while re-exporting their types under stable import paths.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the M14 delegate pattern — every public method is a single-line passthrough to a specialized module (queries/graph/generation), keeping the class itself free of query logic.

nodes.name: SymbolRepositoryPg
nodes.summary: Singleton facade exposing 49 delegate methods for workspace, file, definition, reference, import, centrality, generation-scoped, and graph-traversal persistence operations.

nodes.name: enum-validation.ts
nodes.summary: Kernel-tier enum/finite-set validation shared by tools and services: throws a teaching ToolError listing valid values instead of silently falling through a default case.

nodes.name: ToolError
nodes.summary: Error thrown by tool handlers for invalid user-supplied parameters; carries a statusCode (default 400) that the MCP and HTTP transports map to isError/HTTP status.

nodes.name: validateEnum
nodes.summary: Validates that a value is a string member of a finite set of valid values, narrowing its type on success or throwing a ToolError listing the valid values on failure.

nodes.name: lru-evict.ts
nodes.summary: Shared insertion-order eviction function used by five independent LRU-bounded caches across the codebase, each keeping its own cap, TTL, and read-promotion policy.
nodes.languageNotes: The eviction bound is a post-call bound rather than 'the cap' itself, letting one function serve both pre-insert (>=) and post-insert (>) call sites without changing retained counts.

nodes.name: evictOldest
nodes.summary: Evicts the oldest (first-inserted) entries from a Map until its size is at or under maxRetained, relying on JS Map's insertion-order iteration.

nodes.name: file-content-cache.ts
nodes.summary: TTL-and-LRU-bounded file content cache extracted from ReadFileTool (module 4 of the read_file split); caches raw file text keyed by absolute path with metadata extraction on cache miss.

nodes.name: FileContentCache
nodes.summary: Per-tool-instance cache mapping file paths to their content and extracted metadata, honoring a TTL and an LRU cap enforced via the shared evictOldest helper.

nodes.name: file-metadata.ts
nodes.summary: Extracts descriptive metadata (line count, language, symbol counts, imports) from file content, the one read-file module allowed to reach the database-backed SymbolGraphService.

nodes.name: FileMetadataExtractor
nodes.summary: Composes language detection and import scanning with an optional SymbolGraphService lookup to produce a FileMetadata summary (total lines, language, definition/reference counts, imports) for a read file.

nodes.name: line-range.ts
nodes.summary: Pure functions turning a read_file request into a clamped, line-numbered text slice: calculateRange, adjustRange, extractLines, and the capped selectLines entry point.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately free functions rather than a class since every function is pure and the only state is a process-wide env-derived constant; the clipped output path intentionally omits line-number prefixes that the unclipped path includes.

nodes.name: calculateRange
nodes.summary: Derives a line range from a read_file request's offset/limit or lineStart/lineEnd fields.

nodes.name: adjustRange
nodes.summary: Clamps a requested line range to the bounds of the actual file's total line count.

nodes.name: extractLines
nodes.summary: Slices a file's lines to a range and prefixes each with a padded line number for display.

nodes.name: selectLines
nodes.summary: Top-level entry point that extracts a numbered line range from file content and applies the MASSA_AI_READ_FILE_MAX_LINES output cap, re-slicing the raw (unnumbered) lines when clipping.

nodes.name: path-containment.ts
nodes.summary: Security-sensitive path resolution and filesystem containment checks (Wave 5 FR-12) that prevent read_file from escaping the project root or configured allowed roots.

nodes.name: PathContainment
nodes.summary: Resolves a requested filePath to an absolute path (absolute passthrough, projectId-relative, or ambiguous) and verifies the result stays within the project root or an explicit MASSA_AI_READ_FILE_ROOTS allowlist, throwing a teaching error otherwise.

nodes.name: project-root-cache.ts
nodes.summary: Per-tool-instance, LRU-bounded cache mapping projectId to canonical project-root path, invalidated on 'indexing:started' events via the shared EventBus.

nodes.name: ProjectRootCache
nodes.summary: Caches projectId-to-root-path resolutions with an LRU cap and read-promotion, subscribing to indexing-start events to evict stale entries; falls back to WorkspaceManager on cache miss.

nodes.name: read-file.service.ts
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the full read_file pipeline (module 7 of the extraction): containment checks, range calculation, cached read, compression decision, result assembly, token accounting, and usage-tip generation, composing modules 2-6.
nodes.languageNotes: The largest module produced by the read_file split by design — it composes the five smaller single-responsibility modules (containment, project-root cache, file-content cache, metadata, line-range) rather than distributing the composition logic across them.

nodes.name: readFileOptions
nodes.summary: Reads the six option fields (compress, targetRatio, format, fields, includeSymbols, includeImports) off a ReadFileParams request, at the same call position the original handler used, to preserve null/undefined rejection behavior.

nodes.name: ReadFileService
nodes.summary: Composes path containment, project-root caching, file-content caching, metadata extraction, line-range selection, and optional compression into the single read() operation backing the read_file MCP tool.

nodes.name: filter-validation.ts
nodes.summary: Server-side revalidation of client-supplied include/exclude glob filter hints before they reach filterByPatterns: enforces a pattern-count cap, validates glob syntax, and downgrades contradictory include/exclude pairs.

nodes.name: validateFilters
nodes.summary: Validates and cleans include/exclude glob filter arrays, enforcing a max pattern count, checking glob syntax, and downgrading any pattern that contradicts itself by appearing in both lists.

nodes.name: assertValidGlob
nodes.summary: Verifies a glob pattern compiles via minimatch.makeRe, throwing a teaching ToolError when the pattern is invalid or unusable.

nodes.name: active-generation.ts
nodes.summary: Two helpers shared by graph-reader tool handlers (impact_analysis, trace_path, get_references, search_definitions): looking up a workspace's active graph generation id and enforcing an opt-in staleness precondition.

nodes.name: getActiveGeneration
nodes.summary: Looks up the current active_graph_generation_id for a workspace, returning null when the workspace has never been indexed or is vector-only.

nodes.name: assertGenerationNotStale
nodes.summary: Opt-in precondition that throws a 412 ToolError when a client's cached graph generation id no longer matches the workspace's current active generation.

nodes.name: architecture.ts
nodes.summary: Pure functions deriving architectural signal (packages, entry points, routes, hotspots, community labels, layer classification, and cycle decoration) from the file-import graph and symbol definitions, feeding the project-map and get_architecture responses.
nodes.languageNotes: Heuristics ported from codebase-memory-mcp's get_architecture aspects, adapted from a labeled property graph to massa-ai's symbol_imports/symbol_references relational model.

nodes.name: buildGraphView
nodes.summary: Builds an adjacency-list graph view (in/out edges per file index) from the file list and import edges, used as the shared substrate for every architecture-detection pass.

nodes.name: detectPackages
nodes.summary: Groups files into packages by common directory/marker, computing fan-out/fan-in package-level coupling metrics.

nodes.name: detectEntryPoints
nodes.summary: Flags candidate entry-point files (bootstrap files, files with disproportionate out-degree/in-degree) with a human-readable reason.

nodes.name: detectRoutes
nodes.summary: Extracts HTTP route information from http_call edges and route-like symbol definitions, deduping by method+path.

nodes.name: detectHotspots
nodes.summary: Ranks files by combined centrality (PageRank) and symbol density to surface architectural hotspots.

nodes.name: labelCommunities
nodes.summary: Assigns a human-readable label to each detected community using its most-connected member files and a common path-prefix heuristic.

nodes.name: commonPrefixLabel
nodes.summary: Derives a shared directory-path label from a set of file paths by computing their longest common prefix down to a directory boundary.

nodes.name: classifyLayers
nodes.summary: Classifies each detected community into an architectural layer (e.g., routes/entry vs internal) using route-file membership and bootstrap-file heuristics.

nodes.name: computeArchitectureMap
nodes.summary: Top-level entry point assembling the full architecture map (packages, entry points, routes, hotspots, community labels, layers, and opt-in cycle detection) from the file-import graph and validating the requested aspects.

nodes.name: decorateCycle
nodes.summary: Formats a detected import cycle (list of file nodes) into a display string and computes which internal call edges participate in it.

nodes.name: centrality.ts
nodes.summary: Computes PageRank centrality scores over the file-import graph, used to rank files by architectural importance.

nodes.name: computePageRank
nodes.summary: Iteratively computes PageRank scores for a weighted directed graph of files and import edges until convergence or a max-iteration bound.

nodes.name: communities.ts
nodes.summary: Multi-level Louvain modularity optimization with a connectivity-refinement pass over the file-import graph, surfacing tightly-coupled clusters of files as de-facto modules.
nodes.languageNotes: Adds an explicit connectivity-refinement pass (split-and-reattach by connected components) to close Louvain's known defect of internally-disconnected communities, approximating Leiden-quality output without the extra dependency; falls back to connected-components + label propagation above 8000 nodes or 50000 edges.

nodes.name: buildGraph
nodes.summary: Builds a CSR-style (offsets + neighbors + weights) undirected weighted graph from directed import edges, symmetrizing and deduping multi-edges into weights.

nodes.name: localMove
nodes.summary: Louvain local-moving phase: greedily reassigns each node to the neighboring community maximizing modularity gain until stable, re-queuing only neighbors of moved nodes.

nodes.name: refineConnectivity
nodes.summary: Ensures every community found by local-moving is internally connected, splitting disconnected communities along their connected components via union-find.

nodes.name: relabel
nodes.summary: Renumbers community labels to a dense zero-based range after splits or merges.

nodes.name: aggregate
nodes.summary: Collapses each community into a single super-node for the next Louvain level, producing a coarser weighted graph.

nodes.name: modularityOf
nodes.summary: Computes the modularity score of a given community assignment over a weighted graph.

nodes.name: fallbackCommunities
nodes.summary: Cheaper connected-components-based community assignment used when the graph exceeds the node/edge caps for full Louvain.

nodes.name: runLouvain
nodes.summary: Top-level Louvain entry point: builds the graph, runs local-moving/refinement/aggregation across levels (bounded by MAX_LEVELS), or falls back to the cheaper hybrid above the size caps, then back-projects final communities onto original node ids.

nodes.name: buildCommunities
nodes.summary: Converts a flat community-assignment array into grouped member-id arrays per community.

nodes.name: definition-lookup.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves a bare symbol name or fully-qualified name (FQN) query to a definition, sharing one active-generation lookup contract across every graph-reading consumer (go-to-definition, references, trace-path).

nodes.name: toSymbolIdentityResolution
nodes.summary: Projects an internal DefinitionLookupResult onto the stable SymbolIdentityResolution shape shared by the HTTP and MCP transport surfaces.

nodes.name: DefinitionLookupService
nodes.summary: Resolves a query string to a definition: a bare name (no '#') searches by name, while a FQN is parsed and resolved via the repository, returning resolved/ambiguous/missing/bare status variants.

nodes.name: git-ref-validation.ts
nodes.summary: Validates git-ref parameters (base_branch, since) before they reach execFileSync, blocking git's own arg-injection surface (e.g. a ref starting with --upload-pack=) that shell-injection defenses alone don't cover.

nodes.name: validateGitRef
nodes.summary: Rejects git-ref values that start with -- or contain characters outside the accepted branch/tag/SHA pattern, throwing a teaching ToolError; empty string is allowed as a 'use default' signal.

nodes.name: graph-controller.ts
nodes.summary: Orchestration layer fronting the symbol-graph traversal tools (trace_path, impact_analysis), keeping tool handlers thin by owning input validation, seed resolution, and result-shaping around TracePathService and ImpactAnalysisService.

nodes.name: GraphController
nodes.summary: Singleton controller exposing tracePath and analyzeImpact operations, timing each call, logging results, and converting seed-resolution failures into the shared SymbolIdentityResolution shape.

nodes.name: symbol-graph.service.ts
nodes.summary: High-level code-navigation API (go-to-definition, references, dependency graph, definition listing) plus centrality recomputation, sitting on top of the PostgreSQL symbol repository and the architecture/community/centrality algorithms.

nodes.name: SymbolGraphService
nodes.summary: Singleton service implementing go_to_definition, get_references, get_dependencies (BFS import walk), list_definitions, project-map assembly with safe architecture-map computation, and PageRank centrality recomputation triggered after ETL.

nodes.name: trace-path.ts
nodes.summary: Bounded, cycle-guarded BFS over typed structural edges (CALLS/DATA_FLOWS/HTTP_CALLS/EMITS/LISTENS/IMPORTS) from a seed symbol, producing an agent-consumable node/edge graph plus readable call chains.

nodes.name: TracePathService
nodes.summary: Resolves a seed symbol (name or FQN) to definitions, then runs a depth- and cycle-bounded BFS filtered by edge mode and direction, reconstructing readable call chains from the traversal's predecessor map.

nodes.name: get_analytics.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool returning search analytics and performance metrics: summary, per-project stats, per-query stats, cache performance, or recent searches, selected by a type parameter.

nodes.name: GetAnalyticsTool
nodes.summary: Implements the get_analytics MCP tool: validates the requested analytics type against a finite set and dispatches to the corresponding SearchAnalytics accessor.

nodes.name: get_architecture.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool returning the architecture map for a project (packages, entry points, routes, hotspots, communities, layers, and opt-in cycle detection) with a teaching-error-first contract for unknown aspects.

nodes.name: GetArchitectureTool
nodes.summary: Implements the get_architecture MCP tool: validates opt-in aspects against VALID_ARCHITECTURE_ASPECTS, delegates to SymbolGraphService.getArchitecture, and serializes the result.

nodes.name: get_references.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool finding all usage sites of a symbol across the project, returning file, line, usage kind, and code-context snippets, with an opt-in staleness precondition.

nodes.name: GetReferencesTool
nodes.summary: Implements the get_references MCP tool: checks the active graph generation precondition, delegates to SymbolGraphService.getReferences, groups results by file, and serializes the response.

nodes.name: impact_analysis.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool analyzing a scoped git diff (unstaged/staged/committed) to find impacted callers/dependents of changed code, ranked by a risk score blending PageRank centrality with graph proximity.

nodes.name: ImpactAnalysisTool
nodes.summary: Implements the impact_analysis MCP tool: validates scope/params, checks the active-generation precondition, delegates to ImpactAnalysisService.analyze, and serializes the ranked impacted-symbol list.

nodes.name: list_projects.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool listing all indexed workspaces with status, file/symbol counts, and last-indexed time, sourced from WorkspaceManager.

nodes.name: ListProjectsTool
nodes.summary: Implements the list_projects MCP tool: validates the status filter, lists workspaces via WorkspaceManager, and formats timestamps for the response.

nodes.name: read_file.ts
nodes.summary: Thin MCP tool wrapper (schema + delegation only) for reading files with automatic compression, caching, and symbol metadata; all logic lives in services/file-read/, composed by ReadFileService.

nodes.name: ReadFileTool
nodes.summary: Implements the read_file MCP tool: derives read options, delegates to ReadFileService.read, and serializes the discriminated success/error outcome.

nodes.name: search_definitions.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool browsing symbols (functions, classes, types) in a project via the PostgreSQL symbol index, filterable by query text, kind, file, and exported-only.

nodes.name: SearchDefinitionsTool
nodes.summary: Implements the search_definitions MCP tool: validates kind filters and the active-generation precondition, then delegates to SymbolGraphService.listDefinitions.

nodes.name: trace_path.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool tracing paths through the code graph from a seed symbol along typed structural edges (calls, data flow, cross-service), in either direction, for callers/dependency/impact exploration instead of grep.

nodes.name: TracePathTool
nodes.summary: Implements the trace_path MCP tool: validates direction/mode enums and the active-generation precondition, delegates to TracePathService.tracePath, and serializes nodes/edges/chains.

nodes.name: events-job-filter.test.ts
nodes.summary: Integration test verifying the SSE `/api/v1/events` endpoint filters emitted indexing events by `?jobId=` and `?projectId=` query parameters, including AND-composition and legacy events that carry no jobId.

nodes.name: web-ui-key-http.test.ts
nodes.summary: Wire-level test that boots a real Node-adapter Elysia server to verify the SEC-05 trust decision — loopback callers to `/ui` receive the API key embedded in the shell, non-loopback callers get a configure-access banner instead of the key.
nodes.languageNotes: Includes a tripwire test asserting request.ip still exists on the srvx-backed Elysia node adapter — an implementation detail the trust check depends on but that is not public API, so a dependency bump silently removing it would otherwise degrade SEC-05 to "nobody trusted" with no error.

nodes.name: web-ui-trust.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the pure SEC-05 trust-decision helpers (`isLoopbackAddress`, `isTrustedWebUiCaller`, the `MASSA_AI_WEB_UI_TRUST_LOCAL` override) and the `injectAccessMarkup` HTML-shell injector, covering loopback/non-loopback address matching and attribute-injection safety.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Main entry point for the massa-ai Tools API — bootstraps the Elysia/Node HTTP server, wires CORS, Swagger docs, auth middleware, and roughly twenty route groups, then starts the stale-job reaper, in-process scheduler, and graceful-shutdown handling.
nodes.languageNotes: Startup ordering is load-bearing, not stylistic: CORS-origin validation and API-key provisioning must both complete before the port binds (a config error or unwritable config.json exits the process rather than serving unauthenticated), and the stale-job reaper timer is unref'd so it never keeps the event loop alive on its own.

nodes.name: auth-http.test.ts
nodes.summary: Wire-level test that boots a real Node-adapter server, in the same route-mount order as production, to prove the API-key middleware actually gates the executor routes and the former "admin" endpoints over a live socket.
nodes.languageNotes: Mocks only the ExecutorController via mock.module, leaving the real route, schema, and path intact — the point is to prove the middleware gates the genuine route rather than a stand-in that merely shares its path.

nodes.name: auth.test.ts
nodes.summary: In-process unit tests for `authMiddleware`, `isPublicPath`, and `initAuth`, covering the fail-closed behavior when no API key is configured and the exact-or-child-path matching used for the public route allowlist.

nodes.name: auth.ts
nodes.summary: Elysia middleware enforcing a mandatory `x-api-key` header on every route outside a small public allowlist, resolving/provisioning the key once at startup via `initAuth()` and deriving a minimal `ActorContext` for audit-log attribution.
nodes.languageNotes: The resolved key is cached in module-level state rather than re-read from process.env per request, so a later env mutation cannot change what a running server accepts — deliberate, and covered by a dedicated test.

nodes.name: cors-http.test.ts
nodes.summary: Wire-level test booting two real servers (no allowlist vs. an explicit origin allowlist) to verify SEC-02 CORS headers — foreign origins get no Access-Control-Allow-Origin, allow-listed origins are echoed back exactly, and near-miss origins are rejected.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately exercises response headers over a real socket rather than an in-process app.handle() call, since the node adapter is what actually writes CORS headers on the wire.

nodes.name: architecture.ts
nodes.summary: Elysia route module exposing `GET /api/v1/project/:id/architecture` (the architecture map, mirroring the `get_architecture` MCP tool) and a companion endpoint listing the valid opt-in aspect names.

nodes.name: SseCollector
nodes.summary: Test helper that opens the SSE `/api/v1/events` stream, incrementally decodes and splits `data:` frames out of the response body buffer, and exposes the collected frames plus a `stop()` teardown.

nodes.name: withCollector
nodes.summary: Test harness that opens an `SseCollector` against a given query string, waits for the stream to settle, runs the caller's callback, then drains trailing events and stops the collector.

nodes.name: allocateTcpPort
nodes.summary: Reserves an ephemeral TCP port by briefly binding a throwaway server, then closes it and resolves the assigned port number for the test server to reuse.

nodes.name: allocateTcpPort
nodes.summary: Reserves an ephemeral TCP port on 127.0.0.1 for booting a real Node-adapter server inside the test.

nodes.name: post
nodes.summary: Sends a JSON POST request to the booted test server, optionally attaching an `x-api-key` header, used to exercise the auth-gated executor and former-admin routes.

nodes.name: isPublicPath
nodes.summary: Determines whether a request path is exempt from API-key auth, matching a public path exactly or as a child path rather than by string prefix, so a route like `/uixyz` is not accidentally exempted alongside `/ui`.

nodes.name: initAuth
nodes.summary: Resolves (and provisions if absent) the process's API key via `resolveApiKey()`, caching it in module state before the server starts accepting connections; called once from index.ts at startup.

nodes.name: getConfiguredApiKey
nodes.summary: Returns the API key resolved by `initAuth()`, or undefined before startup runs, letting the web UI route stamp the key into the dashboard shell without re-provisioning it.

nodes.name: __setAuthKeyForTests
nodes.summary: Test-only seam that sets the module's configured API key directly, bypassing the filesystem-touching `initAuth()`/`resolveApiKey()` path.

nodes.name: deriveActor
nodes.summary: Derives a minimal ActorContext for audit-log attribution from the optional `x-actor-id` request header, defaulting to "unknown" when absent — the single seam that future identity sources (JWT, session, MCP agent id) will replace.

nodes.name: authMiddleware
nodes.summary: The Elysia plugin that enforces the API-key check on every non-public route and derives the request's ActorContext, registered globally in index.ts before all route groups.

nodes.name: allocateTcpPort
nodes.summary: Reserves an ephemeral TCP port on 127.0.0.1 for booting a real CORS test server.

nodes.name: boot
nodes.summary: Boots a real Elysia/Node-adapter server with a given CORS origin allowlist on an ephemeral port, so the test can assert on actual emitted Access-Control-* headers rather than an in-process handle() call.

nodes.name: boundedInt
nodes.summary: Parses a query-string value into an integer clamped between min and max, falling back to a default on missing, non-numeric, or array-shaped input.

nodes.name: architectureRoutes
nodes.summary: Exposes `GET /:id/architecture` (the architecture map with opt-in aspects like cycle detection) and `GET /architecture/_aspects` (the list of valid aspect names), mirroring the `get_architecture` MCP tool over HTTP.

nodes.name: project.ts
nodes.summary: Elysia route handlers for project lifecycle management — listing indexed projects, kicking off async indexing, receiving uploaded files from remote MCP clients to stage-and-index, resetting a project's vector/symbol/memory data with audit logging, and transactional identity rename/merge (preview-then-apply with plan-hash confirmation).
nodes.languageNotes: The rename/merge endpoints follow a dry-run-by-default preview/apply pattern where apply must echo back the plan hash from the preview, guarding against stale or unconfirmed destructive operations.

nodes.name: synapse.ts
nodes.summary: Elysia routes for the Synapse session lifecycle — create/inspect/update/delete sessions, prime and prefetch the working-memory buffer, record accesses for agent-affinity scoring, and the 5-in-1 task-begin/task-end envelope that collapses create+prime+search+prefetch+access into single calls.

nodes.name: web-ui.ts
nodes.summary: Serves the read-only web dashboard's static bundle (index.html shell plus assets) with path-traversal-safe file resolution, content-type detection, SPA-style fallback to index.html, and SEC-05 API-key injection into the HTML shell restricted to trusted local callers.
nodes.languageNotes: Static-directory resolution deliberately avoids depending on process.cwd(), walking up from both the module's own directory and cwd to support monorepo-root, package-relative, and containerized deployment layouts.

nodes.name: web.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for POST /api/v1/web/fetch_and_index covering lazy initialization of the WebController/FetchAndIndexTool on the first request, reuse of the cached tool on subsequent requests, and the multi-request batch payload shape.

nodes.name: startup-config.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests the fail-fast startup contract: initAuthOrExit's success/failure paths (including a non-Error throw), buildCorsOptions' wildcard rejection and allowlist trimming, and source-level assertions that index.ts calls initAuthOrExit before binding the port and registers authMiddleware ahead of every guarded route.

nodes.name: startup-config.ts
nodes.summary: Startup-time validation module: enforces the mandatory PostgreSQL database contract, builds a CORS allowlist that rejects wildcard origins (SEC-02), and wraps API-key resolution so any provisioning failure exits the process before the port binds (SEC-01).

nodes.name: web-ui-trust.ts
nodes.summary: Determines which callers of the /ui dashboard route are trusted to receive the embedded API key (SEC-05), based on loopback-address detection across its IPv4, IPv6, and IPv4-mapped spellings, or an explicit Docker-only trust override, with a one-shot startup warning when that override is active.
nodes.languageNotes: isLoopbackAddress normalizes IPv6 zone indices and the ::ffff: IPv4-mapped prefix before validating each octet of the 127.0.0.0/8 block, since a naive string match against '127.0.0.1' would miss most real request.ip values observed in this stack.

nodes.name: index-job-tracker-events.test.ts
nodes.summary: Verifies IndexJobTracker publishes indexing:* events to the global eventBus only for transitions the ETL pipeline itself does not own (early-exit pending→failed, reaper running→failed), stays silent on progress ticks and the main pending→running→completed path, and includes an end-to-end SSE test confirming a ?jobId= subscriber receives (and is filtered to) the right job's events.

nodes.name: handleProjectIdentity
nodes.summary: Shared handler for the rename and merge identity routes: previews by default (dryRun !== false) and returns a plan without mutating, or applies the change and translates a ProjectIdentityError into a sanitized {code, message} response with the error's status code.

nodes.name: serializeSession
nodes.summary: Projects an internal Synapse session object into the JSON-safe shape returned by every session endpoint, including derived buffer/access-history sizes.

nodes.name: buildStaticDirCandidates
nodes.summary: Builds the ordered list of candidate directories for the web UI's static bundle by walking up from both the module directory and cwd, checking both monorepo-root and sibling-package layouts at each level.

nodes.name: resolveStaticDir
nodes.summary: Returns the first existing directory among the precomputed static-dir candidates, or null if none exist.

nodes.name: resolveSafePath
nodes.summary: Resolves a requested sub-path against the static directory root and rejects any path that traverses outside it, returning the absolute path plus whether the target exists.

nodes.name: injectAccessMarkup
nodes.summary: Stamps the served HTML shell with either a meta tag carrying the API key (trusted caller) or an 'access not configured' marker plus a visible banner (untrusted caller), so the client script knows whether to make authenticated calls.

nodes.name: post
nodes.summary: Test helper that POSTs a JSON body to /api/v1/web/fetch_and_index through the in-process Elysia app and returns the parsed status and JSON response.

nodes.name: validateApiStartup
nodes.summary: Enforces the mandatory dedicated-Postgres startup contract, asserting a dedicated DB is allowed and returning the validated database URL.

nodes.name: buildCorsOptions
nodes.summary: Builds CORS options from a configured origin allowlist (SEC-02): trims and drops blank entries, throws if a wildcard is present since it cannot legally combine with credentials, and returns credentials-enabled origins or a fully-closed policy when the allowlist is empty.

nodes.name: initAuthOrExit
nodes.summary: Resolves the API key before the port binds (SEC-01 AC2) and calls an injectable fatal handler — defaulting to logging and process.exit(1) — if resolution throws, so a config.json write failure never leaves an unauthenticated listener bound.

nodes.name: isLoopbackAddress
nodes.summary: Recognizes loopback peer addresses across every spelling this stack actually produces — ::1, IPv4-mapped ::ffff:127.x, bracketed and zone-suffixed forms, and the full 127.0.0.0/8 block — while defaulting unrecognized or absent addresses to not-loopback.

nodes.name: trustLocalOverrideEnabled
nodes.summary: Reads the MASSA_AI_WEB_UI_TRUST_LOCAL environment flag that lets a Docker deployment bypass the loopback check.

nodes.name: isTrustedWebUiCaller
nodes.summary: Combines the loopback check and the Docker trust override into the single predicate that decides whether a /ui caller receives the embedded API key.

nodes.name: warnIfTrustOverrideEnabled
nodes.summary: Emits a one-time-per-process warning when the Docker trust override is active, so the weakest access configuration is never also the quietest.

nodes.name: __resetTrustWarningForTests
nodes.summary: Test-only seam that resets the one-shot warning guard between test cases.

nodes.name: captureEvents
nodes.summary: Test helper that subscribes to a list of named eventBus events, collects every published payload, and returns a stop function that unsubscribes all of them.

nodes.name: SseCollector
nodes.summary: Test helper that opens an SSE connection against the events route, incrementally decodes the byte stream into newline-delimited 'data: {...}' frames, and exposes the parsed frames plus a stop method to cancel the reader.

nodes.name: base-vector-store.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the abstract BaseVectorStore class covering cosine similarity, distance/similarity conversions, thread-safe lazy provider loading, and embedding helper methods via a TestableVectorStore subclass with constructor-injected fake providers.
nodes.languageNotes: Injects a fake embedding provider through the constructor (embeddingProviderFactory) instead of mock.module, following the project's fix for the data->services layering violation this file used to rely on.

nodes.name: concurrent-indexing.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests the queue-based concurrent indexing mutex on ContextualSearchRLM, verifying that indexProject calls fully serialize under any number of concurrent callers, the lock map cleans up correctly, locks release on error, and return values propagate to the right caller.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses describeNative to gate the suite on native tree-sitter availability and restores/re-mocks shared modules defensively since it runs alongside other files in Bun's shared process group.

nodes.name: contextual-search-rlm-coverage.test.ts
nodes.summary: Large coverage suite exercising roughly twenty thin instance-method delegates on ContextualSearchRLM (filterByPatterns, index/search lifecycle methods, synapse and scoring helpers) that the dedicated search-facade-*.test.ts suites leave untested, using the injected-deps constructor seam plus heavy infrastructure mocking.
nodes.languageNotes: Pinned at exactly 41 test cases by an acceptance criterion, so related late-bind sensors live in separate sibling files rather than being added here.

nodes.name: file-filter-cache.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the pure in-memory FileFilterCache covering cache hit/miss/expiry, include/exclude filtering, eviction, project invalidation, clearing, and stats reporting.

nodes.name: hybrid-search-late-bind.test.ts
nodes.summary: Late-binding sensor verifying ContextualSearchRLM.search assembles a fresh HybridSearchDeps record (five stores plus three re-entrant callbacks) on every call rather than capturing a stale snapshot at construction or memoizing it after the first call.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately narrow regression test: the ordinary coverage suite is measured to be blind to a memoize-on-first-call defect, so this file targets exactly that mutation shape.

nodes.name: ignore-patterns.test.ts
nodes.summary: Extended unit tests for ignore-patterns covering applyCapturePolicy classification, the capture-policy test-reset hook, loadProjectIgnore edge cases (missing .gitignore, comments, blank lines), exported constants, and extension glob building.

nodes.name: index-admin-late-bind.test.ts
nodes.summary: Late-binding sensor verifying ContextualSearchRLM.getAnalytics rebuilds its six-key IndexAdminDeps record fresh on every call, including the re-entrant search callback, rather than reusing a captured or memoized snapshot.
nodes.languageNotes: Reassigns all five non-re-entrant fields (wider than sibling late-bind sensors) because two of them are already stubbed post-construction elsewhere in the suite, which would hide a single-field memo defect.

nodes.name: index-manager-seam.test.ts
nodes.summary: Sensor for the IndexManager constructor-injection seam on ContextualSearchRLM, proving both that an injected IndexManager is honored and that the default path still constructs one directly over the resolved vector store when nothing is injected.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses zero mock.module calls by design — injecting all five stores makes ensureInitialized skip every factory, avoiding any fallback to live embedding-provider auto-selection.

nodes.name: index-manager.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for IndexManager's staleness detection, file-to-reindex diffing, and metadata read/write/clear operations, using a temp-directory fixture and a mock IVectorStore that persists metadata documents in memory.

nodes.name: lexical-search.test.ts
nodes.summary: Pure-function unit tests for the lexical-search kernel module: trigram query sanitization, Levenshtein distance, adaptive max-edit-distance, phrase-position/span finding for proximity reranking, query term extraction, and stopword filtering.

nodes.name: postgres-vector-store.integration.test.ts
nodes.summary: Integration test suite for PostgresVectorStore against a real PostgreSQL+pgvector instance, covering connection health, document CRUD, similarity search, statistics, project listing, and performance, gated to run only when DATABASE_URL points at Postgres.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses describe.skipIf on DATABASE_URL/POSTGRES_TEST_URL and real embeddings rather than mocks, since it needs to validate genuine pgvector search behavior.

nodes.name: project-indexer-late-bind.test.ts
nodes.summary: Late-binding sensor verifying ContextualSearchRLM assembles a fresh seven-key IndexerDeps record (including the re-entrant indexFile/indexProject callbacks) on every checkSearchAdmission call, rather than a construction-time or memoized snapshot.
nodes.languageNotes: Carries an extra fourth test beyond its sibling late-bind sensors because IndexerDeps is the first deps record with re-entrant callback members that must be proven to re-resolve at call time.

nodes.name: search-analytics-pg.test.ts
nodes.summary: Pool-mocked unit tests for SearchAnalyticsPg covering recordQuery SQL generation with defaults, and the lazy pool-initialization path, without requiring a live PostgreSQL connection.

nodes.name: search-cache-pg.test.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive pool-mocked unit tests for SearchCachePg covering L1 in-memory and L2 persisted cache hit/miss/expiry, LRU eviction, project and per-file invalidation, cleanup, stats, and cache-key normalization.

nodes.name: search-facade-admin.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests the admin surface ContextualSearchRLM delegates to index-admin.ts -- clearProjectIndex, getProjectStats, warmupCache, and getAnalytics -- using the injected-deps constructor seam with heavy infrastructure mocked out.

nodes.name: search-facade-hybrid.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests the hybrid-search surface of ContextualSearchRLM -- cache hit/miss, result fusion, query understanding/fuzzy correction, degradation callbacks, context enrichment, and score explanation -- via injected mock stores and module mocks for supporting infrastructure.

nodes.name: search-facade-indexing.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests the indexing lifecycle surface of ContextualSearchRLM -- runWithIndexLock, ensureInitialized, checkSearchAdmission, ensureFreshIndex, indexFile, full project indexing, gitignore loading, and canonical-project-id centrality lookup (BUG-05) -- via injected deps and mocked collaborators.
nodes.languageNotes: Holds the richest concentration of post-construction dependency assignment sites in the repository, which is why several dedicated late-bind sensor files exist as siblings rather than extending this one.

nodes.name: search-facade-synapse.test.ts
