nodes.summary: Tests the Synapse-integration surface of ContextualSearchRLM -- applySynapseState, correctQuery, and buildGraphStream -- verifying graph traversal, memory full-text search, and session-bias correction behavior via mocked graph/memory/synapse collaborators.

nodes.name: TestableVectorStore
nodes.summary: Concrete subclass of BaseVectorStore that exposes its protected similarity/distance/embedding methods for direct testing and receives a swappable fake embedding provider via constructor injection.

nodes.name: indexerDeps
nodes.summary: Builds the expected IndexerDeps assertion record (five stores plus two re-entrant callback matchers) used to verify ContextualSearchRLM assembles indexing dependencies correctly per call.

nodes.name: hybridDeps
nodes.summary: Builds the expected HybridSearchDeps assertion record (five stores plus three re-entrant callback matchers) used to verify ContextualSearchRLM assembles hybrid-search dependencies correctly per call.

nodes.name: makeMockVectorStore
nodes.summary: Factory producing a mock IVectorStore whose collection query/add implementation persists _metadata:-prefixed documents into an in-memory map, standing in for IndexManager's staleness-metadata storage.

nodes.name: result
nodes.summary: Builds a SearchResult fixture with sensible defaults (HYBRID source, derived filePath) for the lexical-search proximity and query-term test cases.

nodes.name: makeCache
nodes.summary: Constructs a SearchCachePg instance wired to a fake Postgres pool that records every query/params pair, letting tests assert on the exact SQL issued without a live database.

nodes.name: makeSearchInstance
nodes.summary: Builds a ContextualSearchRLM instance with injected stub vector store, keyword search, cache, and analytics collaborators, parameterized by stub result sets and optional trigram/fuzzy-correct/cache-hit overrides.

nodes.name: makeSearchInstanceWithQU
nodes.summary: Builds a ContextualSearchRLM instance like makeSearchInstance but additionally wires a stubbed queryUnderstanding collaborator that can return a canned result or throw, for testing the query-understanding search path.

nodes.name: session-bias-late-bind.test.ts
nodes.summary: LATE-BIND regression sensor verifying that ContextualSearchRLM.applySynapseState assembles its SessionBiasDeps dependency record fresh on every call rather than capturing it once at construction. Spies on the session-bias capability module to assert per-call freshness, correct field contents, and an exact two-key shape.

nodes.name: vector-embedding-seam.test.ts
nodes.summary: Seam test for the data -> services layering boundary between BaseVectorStore and the vector-store-factory composition root, verifying that a store built without an injected embeddingProviderFactory fails loudly instead of silently reaching a live embedding provider. Also proves parity of the relocated default provider-construction call and that concurrent callers share one memoised provider.

nodes.name: TestableVectorStore
nodes.summary: Minimal concrete BaseVectorStore subclass used by the embedding-seam test to expose protected embedding methods (getEmbeddingProvider, embedContent, embedBatch) as public test hooks, with all IVectorStore CRUD methods stubbed to no-ops.

nodes.name: vector-store-factory.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the PostgreSQL-backed vector store singleton factory: singleton caching, reset-and-recreate behavior, concurrent-call sharing, and a DATABASE_URL-gated skip for environments without Postgres.

nodes.name: wave-4-sql-bounds.test.ts
nodes.summary: Regression test (WAVE4-N10) pinning three bounded SQL query builders — the searchTwoPhase candidate LIMIT cap, the parameterized ref_kind IN-clause in findEdges, and the 5000-row populateVocabulary batch size — plus a repo-wide scan asserting no C-style sprintf/snprintf formatting exists in TypeScript sources.

nodes.name: keyword-search-pg.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL full-text search implementation of keyword search, using to_tsvector/tsquery for ranking plus trigram fuzzy matching and a process-local Levenshtein correction cache. Lazily initializes its connection pool and table schema, installing the project-identity guard trigger on first use.

nodes.name: KeywordSearchPg
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL full-text keyword search engine with lazy pool/table initialization, tsvector-based ranking search, filtered search, trigram fuzzy search, and a cached Levenshtein-based spelling corrector.

nodes.name: base-vector-store.ts
nodes.summary: Abstract base class shared by vector store implementations, providing thread-safe lazy loading of the embedding provider (fixing a race condition where concurrent calls could construct multiple providers) plus shared cosine-similarity/distance conversion utilities. Requires an injected embeddingProviderFactory and throws rather than falling back to a default provider, closing the data -> services layering edge.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a memoised promise field rather than a resolved value to guarantee only one embedding-provider construction happens even under concurrent callers.

nodes.name: BaseVectorStore
nodes.summary: Abstract vector-store base providing thread-safe lazy embedding-provider initialization via a memoised promise, cosine similarity/distance conversions, and default embedContent/embedBatch implementations that subclasses' CRUD methods build on.

nodes.name: postgres-vector-store.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL + pgvector implementation of the vector store, selecting between single-phase HNSW search and a two-phase binary-quantization ANN-then-rerank strategy based on embedding dimensionality. Also defines PostgresVectorCollection, a lightweight per-collection query/add/delete wrapper used by callers that want a scoped collection handle.
nodes.languageNotes: All write/delete/list operations use raw parameterized SQL instead of Prisma, working around a Prisma 7.7.0 + Bun ORM bug (isObjectEnumValue is not a function).

nodes.name: PostgresVectorStore
nodes.summary: Concrete pgvector-backed vector store implementing dimension-aware index selection (HNSW vs. two-phase binary quantization), document CRUD, orphaned-chunk detection, and project statistics, extending BaseVectorStore.

nodes.name: PostgresVectorCollection
nodes.summary: Lightweight IVectorCollection adapter scoping count/query/add/delete operations to a single collection by delegating to its owning PostgresVectorStore instance.

nodes.name: identity-guard-installer.ts
nodes.summary: Kernel-level installer for the project-identity guard SQL trigger, idempotently installing it on every mutable identity column across the static direct-store registry and runtime vector_documents* tables. Failure-isolated by design: a single table's install failure is recorded with a sanitized PostgreSQL error code and never aborts the loop or throws.

nodes.name: installGuardOnTable
nodes.summary: Installs (or idempotently replaces) the project_identity_install_guard SQL trigger on a single table/column via the pg SQL function, returning a sanitized error code on failure instead of throwing.

nodes.name: installProjectIdentityGuards
nodes.summary: Iterates the static direct-store registry plus discovered runtime vector_documents* tables and installs the project-identity guard trigger on every mutable identity column, isolating per-table failures into a sanitized report rather than aborting.

nodes.name: installProjectIdentityGuardsFromPool
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper that acquires a pool client via getPgPool and runs installProjectIdentityGuards against it, releasing the client when done.

nodes.name: lexical-search.ts
nodes.summary: Pure, I/O-free lexical search helpers shared by the PostgreSQL keyword store and the hybrid fusion layer: trigram query sanitization, Levenshtein fuzzy correction, and proximity/title-based result re-ranking. Kept dependency-free so it can be unit-tested in isolation and shared across data- and service-tier callers without crossing the layering boundary.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements RRF-adjacent positional scoring (minSpan/adjacent-pair window) layered on top of rank-based fusion, referencing Cormack et al. 2009 as prior art but rewritten fresh in TypeScript.

nodes.name: dedupeTokens
nodes.summary: Case-insensitively deduplicates a token list while preserving first-seen order, used to clean trigram query terms before sanitization.

nodes.name: sanitizeTrigramQuery
nodes.summary: Strips special characters from a raw query and quotes/dedupes its terms for safe use in a PostgreSQL trigram OR/AND query.

nodes.name: levenshtein
nodes.summary: Computes Levenshtein edit distance between two strings via classic dynamic programming, used to rank fuzzy spelling corrections.

nodes.name: maxEditDistance
nodes.summary: Returns the maximum edit distance allowed for fuzzy correction as a function of word length, tightening tolerance for short words.

nodes.name: findAllPositions
nodes.summary: Finds every occurrence index of a term within text via repeated indexOf scanning, feeding the proximity re-ranking window calculation.

nodes.name: findMinSpan
nodes.summary: Finds the minimum window that contains at least one occurrence from every query term's position list, used to score how tightly clustered matched terms are.

nodes.name: countAdjacentPairs
nodes.summary: Counts how many query-term position pairs across different terms fall within a small gap of each other, rewarding results where query terms appear near one another.

nodes.name: extractQueryTerms
nodes.summary: Lowercases and tokenizes a query, filtering out stopwords, to produce the term list used by proximity and title-boost scoring.

nodes.name: resolveTitle
nodes.summary: Derives a display title for a search result from its first content line, used by proximity re-ranking's title-match boost.

nodes.name: applyProximityRerank
nodes.summary: Re-ranks search results by boosting title matches and computing a proximity bonus from minimum term span and adjacent-term-pair density, layering a positional signal on top of upstream RRF ranking.

nodes.name: contextual-search-rlm.ts
nodes.summary: Main contextual search facade (ContextualSearchRLM) coordinating per-project indexing and hybrid vector+keyword search with RRF fusion, delegating to a set of single-purpose capability modules (hybrid-search, project-indexer, index-admin, result-fusion, session-bias, etc.) via per-call assembled dependency records rather than passing itself. Owns lazy initialization of all backing stores (keyword, vector, cache, analytics, symbol repo) and admission/degradation handling.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses private (#-prefixed) accessor methods to assemble per-call dependency records for each capability module, a documented LATE-BIND pattern that avoids capturing collaborators at construction time.

nodes.name: ContextualSearchRLM
nodes.summary: Main search facade coordinating indexing and hybrid search across a project, lazily initializing keyword/vector/cache/analytics/symbol backing stores and delegating each operation (search, indexing, admin, fusion, session-bias) to single-purpose capability modules via freshly assembled per-call dependency records.

nodes.name: file-filter-cache.ts
nodes.summary: In-memory TTL cache that pre-computes and caches valid file lists for a project's include/exclude glob filters, avoiding repeated minimatch evaluation on every search. Bounded to 50 entries with a shared LRU eviction helper and a 1-hour TTL.

nodes.name: FileFilterCache
nodes.summary: TTL-bounded LRU cache of pre-computed valid-file sets per project/include/exclude combination, avoiding repeated glob filtering on every search request.

nodes.name: hybrid-search.ts
nodes.summary: Hybrid retrieval capability module implementing the vector+keyword search pipeline with Reciprocal Rank Fusion, query correction, proximity re-ranking, and graceful per-source degradation reporting. Extracted from the search facade as a dependency-injected, facade-agnostic module (design.md §4.1) to keep the facade's foreign-reach low.
nodes.languageNotes: Its HybridSearchDeps interface deliberately keeps three callbacks (buildGraphStream, addContextToResults, applySynapseState) as per-call arrow-wrapped functions rather than bound methods, to preserve late-binding semantics against the owning facade's current state.

nodes.name: search
nodes.summary: Executes the hybrid vector+keyword search pipeline for a project: cache lookup, query correction, parallel keyword/vector/graph retrieval with degradation tracking, RRF fusion, proximity re-ranking, and result-set caching.

nodes.name: correctQuery
nodes.summary: Applies spelling/term correction to a query using the keyword store's fuzzy matcher over the extracted query terms.

nodes.name: addContextToResults
nodes.summary: Enriches search results with a short content preview extracted via extractPreview.

nodes.name: extractPreview
nodes.summary: Truncates result content to a bounded number of lines for display as a search-result preview.

nodes.name: calculateAvgScore
nodes.summary: Computes the mean relevance score across a result set, used for search-quality telemetry.

nodes.name: filterByPatterns
nodes.summary: Filters search results to only those whose file path matches include globs and does not match exclude globs, via minimatch.

nodes.name: ignore-patterns.ts
nodes.summary: Shared file-scanning ignore/allow-list logic used by the indexer, the ETL discover stage, and the search facade: builds extension globs, merges .gitignore rules with default ignores, and applies the capture-policy pure module to classify a path as Keep/Drop/MetadataOnly. Single source of truth so all callers see identical inclusion behavior.

nodes.name: buildExtensionGlob
nodes.summary: Builds one glob pattern per allowed extension rather than a single brace-expansion glob, sidestepping the single-alternative brace-expansion bug where `{.ts}` matches nothing.

nodes.name: getActivePolicy
nodes.summary: Resolves and caches the active file-capture policy from config, falling back to the pure module's DEFAULT_POLICY and validating any user-supplied policy on first use.

nodes.name: _resetCapturePolicyCacheForTesting
nodes.summary: Test-only seam that clears the cached capture policy so tests can re-resolve it under different config.

nodes.name: applyCapturePolicy
nodes.summary: Applies the active capture policy to a single file path, returning a Keep/Drop/MetadataOnly disposition.

nodes.name: getActiveCapturePolicy
nodes.summary: Exposes the active capture policy object itself (not a per-path decision) for callers like DiscoverStage that need to derive a variant of it, e.g. stripping test-file globs for one run.

nodes.name: loadProjectIgnore
nodes.summary: Loads and merges a project's .gitignore rules with the default ignore list into an Ignore instance, run before capture-policy application so gitignore negation semantics are preserved.

nodes.name: index-admin.ts
nodes.summary: Index administration capability module providing clearProjectIndex, getProjectStats, warmupCache, and getAnalytics, each taking a narrow IndexAdminDeps record instead of the search facade instance. Bodies are behavior-preserved from the pre-refactor facade methods, with the facade now hoisting ensureInitialized() before assembling the deps record.

nodes.name: clearProjectIndex
nodes.summary: Clears a project's indexed data across the keyword store, vector store, cache, and file-filter cache.

nodes.name: getProjectStats
nodes.summary: Returns aggregate statistics about a project's indexed content.

nodes.name: warmupCache
nodes.summary: Pre-warms the search cache by running a set of default or caller-supplied queries against a project before real traffic arrives.

nodes.name: getAnalytics
nodes.summary: Returns the project's aggregated search analytics from the analytics store.

nodes.name: index-manager.ts
nodes.summary: Manages a project's search index lifecycle: staleness detection via file mtimes/hashes, incremental reindexing of only modified files, and automatic reindex triggering on stale search. Caches per-project index metadata in memory and scans the project tree using the shared extension glob and .gitignore rules.

nodes.name: IndexManager
nodes.summary: Manages project index lifecycle: staleness detection by comparing file mtimes/sizes against cached metadata, and incremental scanning of the project tree respecting extension and ignore-pattern filters.

nodes.name: project-indexer.ts
nodes.summary: Project indexing capability module implementing the full indexing pipeline — per-project locking, chunking and embedding of changed files, freshness checks, and search-admission gating — as dependency-injected functions taking an IndexerDeps record rather than the search facade. Byte-preserved extraction from the former rlm-indexing.ts, coordinating the vector store, keyword store, symbol repository, and managed-run repository.

nodes.name: runWithIndexLock
nodes.summary: Serializes indexing work per project via an in-memory lock map, so concurrent index requests for the same project queue rather than race.

nodes.name: indexProjectInternal
nodes.summary: Performs a full project index: discovers files via glob + ignore rules, resolves identity aliasing, and indexes each file's chunks into the keyword and vector stores.

nodes.name: ensureFreshIndex
nodes.summary: Checks whether a project's index is stale and, if so, performs an incremental reindex of only the modified/new/deleted files before a search proceeds.

nodes.name: checkSearchAdmission
nodes.summary: Gates a search request on index readiness, deciding whether to allow, degrade, or block the search based on current indexing state.

nodes.name: indexFile
nodes.summary: Indexes a single file: chunks its content via smartChunk and writes the resulting chunks into the keyword and vector stores under the resolved project identity.

nodes.name: result-fusion.ts
nodes.summary: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) implementation combining vector and keyword result sets into one ranked list, with query-aware keyword boosting and an optional human-readable score-explanation generator. Depends on no facade state — its only external input is the query and result sets, keeping it a pure capability module.
nodes.languageNotes: Hosts three of the four FROZEN-ANCHOR needle-test anchors (KEYWORD_BOOST, rrfNormalized, normalizedScore) — constants and identifiers pinned by content rather than location for a retrieval-benchmark fixture.

nodes.name: fuseResults
nodes.summary: Combines multiple ranked result sets (vector, keyword, ...) into one list using Reciprocal Rank Fusion with keyword-match and exact-match boosting.

nodes.name: generateScoreExplanation
nodes.summary: Builds a human-readable breakdown of how a result's final fused score was derived from its RRF, vector, and keyword component scores and ranks.

nodes.name: search-analytics-pg.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL-backed search analytics store tracking per-query events (duration, result count, cache hits) and aggregating them into per-project analytics such as average duration and top queries. Lazily creates its table and installs the project-identity guard trigger on first use, mirroring the other PG-backed search stores' init pattern.

nodes.name: SearchAnalyticsPg
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL-backed search analytics tracker recording query events and computing per-project aggregates like average duration, average result count, cache-hit rate, and top queries.

nodes.name: search-cache-pg.ts
nodes.summary: Two-level (in-memory L1 + PostgreSQL L2) cache for search results, keyed by query/project/options hash, with hit/miss statistics tracking. Lazily initializes its backing table and installs the project-identity guard trigger, following the same init pattern as the other PG-backed search stores.

nodes.name: SearchCachePg
nodes.summary: Two-level (in-process L1 map + PostgreSQL L2) search result cache with access-count/hit-rate statistics, keyed by a hash of query, project, and options.

nodes.name: vector-store-factory.ts
nodes.summary: Backend-neutral composition root for the vector subsystem: the one module allowed to import both PostgresVectorStore (data tier) and createEmbeddingProvider (services tier), wiring the embedding-provider factory into the store's constructor. Caches a singleton PostgresVectorStore instance behind a health-check gate and exposes resetVectorStore for tests.
nodes.languageNotes: An earlier alternative design — a process-wide registration port filled by services/embeddings as a module-load side effect — was built and reverted because it created an import-order dependency that could silently break production, not just tests.

nodes.name: getVectorStore
nodes.summary: Composition-root factory that constructs the singleton PostgresVectorStore, wiring in the default embedding-provider factory and HNSW/IVFFlat index parameters from env, gated behind a 5-second health check.

nodes.name: resetVectorStore
nodes.summary: Closes and clears the cached vector-store singleton so the next getVectorStore call constructs a fresh instance.

nodes.name: api-client.ts
nodes.summary: HTTP client for the Tools API with exponential-backoff retry, AbortController timeouts, and structured error handling; the default (non-embedded) implementation of the MCP client's API contract.
nodes.languageNotes: Retries with exponential backoff but short-circuits on 4xx client errors, and times out each request via AbortController rather than a library-level timeout option.

nodes.name: embedded-api-client.ts
nodes.summary: In-process implementation of the MCP client's API contract that dispatches every tools-api REST-equivalent endpoint directly to @massa-ai/core services and tools, letting the MCP server run without a separate HTTP process when MASSA_AI_EMBEDDED=true.
nodes.languageNotes: Hand-mirrors the tools-api REST route table (string switch plus regex-matched parametric routes) so a tool call yields an identical result shape in both HTTP and embedded transports — an explicitly tested parity contract.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Entry point and MCP stdio server for the massa-ai client: parses config-related CLI flags, selects the HTTP or embedded API client via MASSA_AI_EMBEDDED, and proxies ListTools/CallTool MCP requests to the Tools API.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Bun's import.meta.main to gate CLI/startup side effects so the module can be imported by tests without spawning a server, and keeps stdout reserved exclusively for MCP JSON-RPC traffic.

nodes.name: embedded-api-client-endpoints.test.ts
nodes.summary: Coverage-focused integration test that exercises every GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE endpoint branch and private handler of EmbeddedApiClient against a real Postgres test database.

nodes.name: embedded-mode-parity.test.ts
nodes.summary: Verifies MASSA_AI_EMBEDDED correctly selects ApiClient vs EmbeddedApiClient and that both produce parity result shapes for tool calls, including the special-cased index tool and uploadAndIndex path-safety validation.

nodes.name: executor-sandbox-passthrough.test.ts
nodes.summary: Regression test (SEC-03) confirming the executor's sandboxMode field survives serialization through EmbeddedApiClient.post for both single execute and batch_execute calls.

nodes.name: index.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the MCP client entry point covering CLI flag handling, embedded-mode detection, and McpProxyServer's tool listing, tool-call proxying, index-tool validation, and startup health check.

nodes.name: ApiHttpError
nodes.summary: Error subclass carrying the HTTP status code and parsed response body of a failed Tools API request, so callers can branch on status without re-parsing text.

nodes.name: ApiClient
nodes.summary: HTTP implementation of the Tools API client, exposing get/post/patch/delete helpers, exponential-backoff retry with 4xx short-circuiting, AbortController timeouts, file upload/index, and a health check.

nodes.name: fetchAndIndexTool
nodes.summary: Async lazy singleton that initializes the vector store, keyword search, and WebController before constructing FetchAndIndexTool, deduplicating concurrent initialization via a shared in-flight promise.

nodes.name: serializeSession
nodes.summary: Converts an internal Synapse session record into the plain JSON shape returned by the REST session endpoints, including buffer size and access-history count.

nodes.name: EmbeddedApiClient
nodes.summary: In-process ToolProxyApiClient implementation routing every tools-api REST endpoint (symbol graph, search, memory, checkpoints, executor, synapse sessions, handoff, proposals, project lifecycle) to direct core service/tool calls instead of an HTTP round-trip.
nodes.languageNotes: Combines a string switch for exact-match endpoints with regex matching for parametric routes (e.g. /api/v1/synapse/session/:id), and wraps every branch's errors in the same ApiHttpError shape the HTTP client throws.

nodes.name: processCliArgs
nodes.summary: Handles massa-ai's config-related CLI flags (--config-show, --config-path, --config-dir, --config-init, --help) and rejects unknown flags, returning an exit code when a flag was handled or undefined to continue normal MCP startup.

nodes.name: textContent
nodes.summary: Wraps a plain string into the MCP tool-result content-array shape expected by the protocol.

nodes.name: isEmbeddedMode
nodes.summary: Reads the MASSA_AI_EMBEDDED environment variable to decide whether the MCP server should use the in-process API client instead of HTTP.

nodes.name: McpProxyServer
nodes.summary: MCP stdio server that lists and proxies tool calls to the Tools API (HTTP or embedded), special-casing the index tool for local file collection and upload, and performing a startup health check.

nodes.name: captureConsole
nodes.summary: Test helper that temporarily redirects console.log/console.error to capture their output while running a sync or async function under test, restoring the originals afterward.

nodes.name: bootstrap-service.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests BootstrapService's repo signal scanning, LLM-based and rule-based memory seeding, idempotency, degradation handling, and event emission, using injected fakes (memory repo, LLM surface, centrality source, git runner) and temp fixture project roots.

nodes.name: compaction-snapshot-escaping.test.ts
nodes.summary: Regression tests for SEC-6 (CodeQL js/incomplete-sanitization alerts #15-#17) verifying CompactionSnapshotService uses JSON.stringify rather than naive quote-escaping when interpolating retrieval-call summary tokens into resumable snapshots.

nodes.name: db-connection.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the db-connection kernel module covering getDbConfig's connection-string and pool-size defaults, the DB_POOL_SIZE env override, and closeConnections idempotency.

nodes.name: graph-queries.test.ts
nodes.summary: Coverage tests for GraphQueries — BFS traversal, path finding, contradiction detection, hub analysis, and neighborhood summary — using a scripted mock IGraphStore for edge traversal and the real dedicated PostgreSQL DB for memory-batch-loading helpers.

nodes.name: graph-store-factory.test.ts
nodes.summary: Coverage tests for the graph-store factory's cache creation, cache reuse, and reset path including the defensive clear-failure branch; gated to the dedicated maintenance database.

nodes.name: graph-store-pg-coverage.test.ts
nodes.summary: Exercises GraphStorePg methods not reached by the parity suite — findEdges filter branches, getOutgoing/Incoming, bfsNeighbors, edge-deletion variants, getDegree, getHubMemories, findPaths, clear, and the createEdge FK-failure path — hard-gated to the dedicated maintenance DB.

nodes.name: graph-store-pg-parity.test.ts
nodes.summary: Assertion-level PostgreSQL parity tests for the PostgreSQL-canonical GraphStorePg implementation, hard-gated to the disposable maintenance database with prefix-scoped fixtures and foreign-key-cascade cleanup.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a `DEDICATED_DB` guard (env var plus a regex on the connection string matching 127.0.0.1:5433/massa_ai_test) to hard-skip outside the disposable maintenance database — a recurring gating pattern across this test family.

nodes.name: graph-stream-project-scope-pg.test.ts
nodes.summary: Regression test (BUG-02/TASK-010) proving buildGraphStream's graph-neighbor RRF stream is project-scoped, guarding against a cross-project memory leak caused by memory_edges lacking a project_id column; hard-gated to the dedicated maintenance DB.
nodes.languageNotes: First test is deliberately two-sided (asserts the other project's content is absent AND the current project's own neighbor is still present) so a correct cross-project drop can't be confused with a filter that drops every row.

nodes.name: handoff-service.test.ts
nodes.summary: Full-behavior tests for HandoffService covering begin/accept/cancel/listPending, session-start auto-injection surfacing, the handoff:accepted event shape, and pure helper functions, using injected fake stores and an LLM summary surface so the real MemoryRepository singleton is untouched outside one dedicated integration block.

nodes.name: hook-attribution-acceptance.test.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL acceptance tests (T4/M45/HAR-05-07) for durable hook-attribution persistence — agent_id and attribution_source storage, canonical mirror keying after an alias rename, and honest-absence NULL handling — gated on an owned HOOK_ATTRIBUTION_ACCEPTANCE_DATABASE_URL with all migrations applied.
nodes.languageNotes: Points the shared pg/prisma singletons at the owned URL via process.env so the real PgObservationStore and AttributionResolver exercise true integration rather than a mocked seam.

nodes.name: memory-operations.script.ts
nodes.summary: Standalone manual integration script exercising the full MemoryController lifecycle — store, retrieve, search, list, and delete — directly against PostgreSQL, printing each step's result to the console for manual verification.
nodes.languageNotes: Runs as a plain executable Bun script (shebang, no bun:test import) rather than through the test runner, so it is exercised manually rather than in the automated suite.

nodes.name: memory-consolidation-job.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for MemoryConsolidationJob covering decay, prune, merge, and the top-level consolidate() path, with getMemoryRepository, getGraphStore, and the LLM surface all mocked so no real database is touched.

nodes.name: memory-controller.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for MemoryController covering store, update, delete, and search orchestration branches — explicit vs auto importance, tag merge/replace, content re-embed, graph enrichment, empty/not-found, invalid input — with the repository factory, MemoryService, MemoryGraphService, salience judge, consolidation job, and event bus all mocked.

nodes.name: memory-graph-service.test.ts

nodes.name: mkSession

nodes.name: memory-repository-pg.ts

nodes.name: alias-resolver.ts
nodes.summary: Application-layer resolver that maps a caller-supplied project id to its current canonical id via the DB's project_identity_resolve function, with a short-TTL cache and fail-open timeout so writers never block on identity resolution.

nodes.name: db-connection.ts
nodes.summary: Shared PostgreSQL connection pool module exposing a lazily-created, memoized pg Pool singleton and a graceful shutdown helper used across the persistence layer.

nodes.name: attribution-resolver.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves the durable project id to attribute a hook event to, using an ordered explicit/sticky/containment/verbatim strategy chain over cached workspace roots, always failing open so attribution never blocks or rejects an event.

nodes.name: co-retrieval-hook.ts
nodes.summary: Event-driven hook that strengthens associative links between memories retrieved in the same search session by creating or incrementing RELATES_TO edges in the graph store, opt-in via a feature flag.

nodes.name: compaction-snapshot-service.ts
nodes.summary: Builds a compact, reference-based XML snapshot of a session's observations for use on /compact or PreCompact, summarizing each category and providing runnable retrieval calls instead of inlining raw data, bounded to roughly 2KB.
nodes.languageNotes: Enforces a ~2KB XML size ceiling structurally (last-N items, dedup, short summaries) rather than truncating content, so raw events stay fully queryable in the observation store.

nodes.name: mem
nodes.summary: Test helper building a partial MemoryRow fixture with an embedding buffer for RelationExtractor tests.

nodes.name: recordingStore
nodes.summary: Test helper creating a scripted IGraphStore double that records created edge ids and stubs edge lookup/creation/weight-increment methods for RelationExtractor assertions.

nodes.name: makePayload
nodes.summary: Test helper building a SearchSessionHook event payload fixture with overridable fields.

nodes.name: parsePgTextArray
nodes.summary: Parses a PostgreSQL text[] array literal (or a passthrough JS array) returned by the pg driver into a plain string array, handling quoted and escaped elements.
nodes.languageNotes: Hand-rolled parser working around @prisma/adapter-pg not mapping OID 1009 (text[]) to a native JS array type.

nodes.name: MemoryRepositoryPg
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL-backed memory repository implementing CRUD, full-text and vector search, importance/access tracking, and consolidation-candidate listing for the memories table using raw SQL.

nodes.name: ProjectIdentityAliasResolver
nodes.summary: Resolves a caller-supplied project id to its current canonical id via the server-side project_identity_resolve function, with a short-TTL cache, bounded timeout, and fail-open behavior so alias-DB slowness never blocks writers.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Promise.race against a timeout to bound a single lookup, falling back to the original id when the alias DB is slow or errors — a fail-open pattern reused by MemoryRepositoryPg, PgObservationStore, and AttributionResolver.

nodes.name: getProjectIdentityAliasResolver
nodes.summary: Singleton accessor returning the process-wide ProjectIdentityAliasResolver instance, creating it lazily on first call.

nodes.name: resetProjectIdentityAliasResolver
nodes.summary: Test-only hook clearing the cached ProjectIdentityAliasResolver singleton so the next call rebuilds it.

nodes.name: setProjectIdentityAliasResolverForTests
nodes.summary: Test-only hook that injects a specific resolver instance as the singleton, bypassing lazy construction.

nodes.name: getDbConfig
nodes.summary: Builds the PostgreSQL pool configuration by reading the required DATABASE_URL and an optional pool-size env var.

nodes.name: getPgPool
nodes.summary: Lazily creates and returns the process-wide pg Pool singleton, memoizing it across calls.

nodes.name: closeConnections
nodes.summary: Ends the shared PostgreSQL pool and clears the module-level reference, used for graceful shutdown and test cleanup.

nodes.name: PgWorkspaceRootProvider
nodes.summary: Cached provider of registered workspace roots (project id + path pairs) read from PostgreSQL, bounded by a timeout and TTL cache so a slow or hanging DB cannot stall hook admission; fails open to an empty root list.

nodes.name: AttributionResolver
nodes.summary: Resolves the durable project id for a lifecycle hook event using an ordered strategy chain — explicit caller id, sticky session pin, cwd containment within a workspace root, then verbatim fallback — never throwing and always degrading safely.

nodes.name: defaultCanonicalize
nodes.summary: Default cwd canonicalizer resolving symlinks via fs.realpathSync, falling back to path.resolve when the path cannot be realpath'd.

nodes.name: getAttributionResolver
nodes.summary: Singleton accessor returning the process-wide AttributionResolver instance, creating it lazily on first call.

nodes.name: resetAttributionResolver
nodes.summary: Test-only hook clearing the cached AttributionResolver singleton.

nodes.name: setAttributionResolverForTests
nodes.summary: Test-only hook that injects a specific resolver instance as the AttributionResolver singleton.

nodes.name: CoRetrievalHook
nodes.summary: Singleton event hook that listens for memory-session-stored events and creates or strengthens RELATES_TO graph edges between memories retrieved together in the same search session, implementing Hebbian-style co-retrieval reinforcement.
nodes.languageNotes: Models associative reinforcement (the 'fire together, wire together' Hebbian metaphor) by incrementing an edge weight up to a cap rather than only creating new edges.

nodes.name: summarizeObservation
nodes.summary: Builds a short, category-specific summary token for one observation's payload (tool calls, file paths, prompts, errors, etc.) for inclusion in a compaction snapshot's table of contents.

nodes.name: buildRetrievalCall
nodes.summary: Constructs the exact recall/search tool-call string a resuming agent can run to re-fetch a snapshot section's full raw observations, deduplicating short keyword tokens per category.

nodes.name: CompactionSnapshotService
nodes.summary: Builds a bounded, reference-based XML compaction snapshot from a session's observations — a table of contents with brief per-category summaries and runnable retrieval calls rather than inlined raw data — so a resuming agent can reconstruct session continuity without truncation.

nodes.name: getCompactionSnapshotService
nodes.summary: Singleton accessor returning the process-wide CompactionSnapshotService, constructing it against the observation store on first call.

nodes.name: resetCompactionSnapshotService
nodes.summary: Test-only hook clearing the cached CompactionSnapshotService singleton.

nodes.name: search-session-hook.ts
nodes.summary: Singleton EventBus hook that auto-stores a low-importance session memory whenever a search returns results, with TTL-based dedup and best-effort (non-blocking) failure handling, bridging ephemeral search context into persistent memory.

nodes.name: SearchSessionHook
nodes.summary: Singleton class subscribing to the `search:completed` event, deduplicating identical (session, project, query) triples within a 60s TTL, and persisting a lightweight CONVERSATION memory summarizing the top 3 result paths via MemoryController.

nodes.name: auto-improve-apply.ts
nodes.summary: Fail-closed validation and application logic for auto-improve proposals — validates create/update payloads against allowed memory types/levels, and applies approved proposals to the memory repository while rejecting edits to pinned or unreadable targets.

nodes.name: ApplyRejection
nodes.summary: Error subclass carrying a structured rejection reason (pinned, unreadable_target, malformed-payload) thrown when an auto-improve proposal cannot be applied.

nodes.name: validateCreatePayload
nodes.summary: Fail-closed validator for memory.create proposal payloads, rejecting malformed type/level/importance/tags before insertion.

nodes.name: buildUpdatePatch
nodes.summary: Builds a validated UpdateMemoryPatch from a proposal payload, mirroring validateCreatePayload's fail-closed checks for update operations.

nodes.name: applyProposal
nodes.summary: Applies an approved auto-improve proposal — creates or updates the target memory row, rejecting the operation if the target is pinned, unreadable, or the payload is malformed.

nodes.name: readTargetForApply
nodes.summary: Reads and validates the target memory row for an update proposal, raising ApplyRejection when the target is missing or pinned.

nodes.name: auto-improve-job.ts
nodes.summary: Facade for the Phase 5 auto-improvement loop — the AutoImproveJob class owns config/state and delegates runOnce/approve/reject to auto-improve-ops.ts, while re-exporting pattern-detection, LLM-enrichment, and apply helpers from sibling modules as a single public surface.

nodes.name: AutoImproveJob
nodes.summary: Stateful facade holding LLM/observation/proposal/memory dependencies and thresholds for the auto-improve loop; exposes maybeRun (debounced trigger), runOnce/approve/reject (delegated to auto-improve-ops.ts), and listPending.

nodes.name: getAutoImproveJob
nodes.summary: Singleton accessor returning the cached AutoImproveJob instance, constructing it lazily on first call.

nodes.name: resetAutoImproveJob
nodes.summary: Test utility that clears the cached AutoImproveJob singleton so the next getAutoImproveJob() call constructs a fresh instance.

nodes.name: auto-improve-ops.ts
nodes.summary: Standalone run/approve/reject operations for the auto-improve loop, extracted from AutoImproveJob using the M14 delegate pattern where functions receive the job instance as their first parameter.

nodes.name: runOnce
nodes.summary: Scans recent observations for a project, detects recurring patterns, optionally enriches candidates via LLM, dedups by signal key, creates pending proposals, and auto-approves them when the review gate is disabled.

nodes.name: approve
nodes.summary: Approves a pending auto-improve proposal, applies it via applyProposal, updates its status, and publishes an auto-improve:proposal-approved event — silently rejecting on apply failure.

nodes.name: reject
nodes.summary: Marks a pending auto-improve proposal as rejected without applying it.

nodes.name: memory-consolidation-job.ts
nodes.summary: Backend-polymorphic background job that decays stale memories, soft-deletes cold ones, and merges near-duplicate clusters into consolidated summary memories linked by SUPERSEDES edges, emitting memory:consolidated events per batch.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a dynamic `await import()` inside promoteSessionMemories to lazy-load the Prisma client only on the PostgreSQL code path, keeping the module import itself backend-polymorphic and side-effect-free on non-Postgres backends.

nodes.name: addSupercedesEdge
nodes.summary: Creates a SUPERSEDES graph edge from a newly consolidated memory back to one of its source memories via the backend-agnostic IGraphStore contract.

nodes.name: MemoryConsolidationJob
nodes.summary: Debounced consolidation job with four phases — decayStaleMemories, pruneColdMemories, mergeMemories (LLM-gated clustering via consolidateWindow), and promoteSessionMemories — orchestrated from consolidate() and gated by maybeRun's minInterval check.

nodes.name: observation-consolidation-job.ts
nodes.summary: Phase 3 consolidation bridge that debounces and summarizes windows of raw lifecycle observations into a single structured memory via the LLM, always retaining the original observations and silently no-op'ing when the LLM is disabled or fails.

nodes.name: readBridgeConfig
nodes.summary: Reads the observation-consolidation bridge's tunable config (min observations, min interval, max window) from the shared config store.

nodes.name: buildObservationPrompt
nodes.summary: Formats a window of observations into an LLM prompt requesting a single structured summary memory (type/level/rationale/sourceIds).

nodes.name: ObservationConsolidationJob
nodes.summary: Debounced job that summarizes recent lifecycle observations into a memory via the LLM, linking to any prior summary for the same project with a SUPERSEDES edge and publishing memory:consolidated.

nodes.name: graph-queries.ts
nodes.summary: Read-side traversal and analytics over the memory knowledge graph — BFS-based related-context lookup, shortest-path finding, contradiction detection, decision-chain assembly, and hub-memory ranking — optimized to batch-load memories and avoid N+1 queries.
nodes.languageNotes: Refactored to batch-load memory rows via loadMemoriesByIds (a single SQL WHERE id IN (...) query) instead of one query per node, cutting BFS traversal from O(N) queries to O(depth) queries per operation.

nodes.name: GraphQueries
nodes.summary: Query layer over IGraphStore providing getRelatedContext (BFS), findPath (shortest-path BFS + reconstruction), findContradictions, getDecisionChain, getHubMemories, and getNeighborhoodSummary, all batch-loading memory rows to keep query counts proportional to depth rather than neighbor count.

nodes.name: graph-store-factory.ts
nodes.summary: Factory that returns the cached, backend-agnostic IGraphStore singleton (currently GraphStorePg), with a matching reset for tests.

nodes.name: getGraphStore
nodes.summary: Returns the cached IGraphStore singleton, constructing GraphStorePg on first call.

nodes.name: resetGraphStore
nodes.summary: Test utility that clears both the edges in the cached graph store and the module-level singleton cache.

nodes.name: graph-store-pg.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL implementation of the IGraphStore contract using Prisma — full CRUD over memory_edges (create/get/find/update/delete), BFS neighbor traversal, degree/hub/stats analytics, and recursive-CTE multi-hop path finding, with a lazily-initialized Prisma proxy to avoid eager client construction at import time.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a JS Proxy to lazily bind the Prisma client on first property access (so importing the module has no side effects), and a `WITH RECURSIVE` CTE in findPaths for weighted multi-hop graph traversal computed directly in PostgreSQL.

nodes.name: rowToEdge
nodes.summary: Maps a raw memory_edges SQL row into the shared MemoryEdge domain shape, parsing JSON metadata.

nodes.name: GraphStorePg
nodes.summary: Singleton PostgreSQL-backed graph store implementing IGraphStore — edge CRUD, getOutgoingEdges/getIncomingEdges/getAllEdges filtering, bfsNeighbors traversal, weight updates, batchCreateEdges, degree/hub/stats analytics, and recursive-CTE findPaths.

nodes.name: memory-graph.service.ts
nodes.summary: Orchestration facade composing GraphStore, RelationExtractor, and GraphQueries behind a single API, invoked by memory lifecycle events (store/delete) and consumed by tools/services that need graph access without touching graph internals.

nodes.name: MemoryGraphService
nodes.summary: Singleton facade routing onMemoryStored/onMemoryDeleted lifecycle hooks to RelationExtractor/GraphStore, and exposing getRelatedContext/findPath/findContradictions/getDecisionChain/getHubMemories/getNeighborhoodSummary/linkMemories/unlinkMemories by delegating to GraphQueries and the underlying IGraphStore.

nodes.name: relation-extractor.ts
nodes.summary: Background relation extractor that finds semantically similar memories via embedding cosine similarity and classifies the relation type (contradiction, resolution, derivation, support) using heuristic keyword rules, creating graph edges for high-confidence matches.

nodes.name: RelationExtractor
nodes.summary: Runs after each store_memory call to find similar recent memories by embedding cosine similarity, classify the relation type via keyword heuristics (contradiction/resolution/derivation/support signals) and tag overlap, and create graph edges above the confidence threshold.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Shared type contracts for the memory graph module — row projections (MemoryRow, MemoryRowWithEmbedding), traversal results (RelatedMemory), edge I/O shapes (EdgeCreateInput, EdgeFilter), and the backend-agnostic IGraphStore interface implemented by the graph store backend.
nodes.languageNotes: IGraphStore is the canonical async contract that lets getGraphStore() return a backend-agnostic store, eliminating any sync/async signature divergence between graph-store implementations.

nodes.name: consolidator.ts
nodes.summary: Pure, backend-agnostic memory consolidation logic — clusters near-duplicate memories by project and embedding cosine similarity into a bounded window, then merges a window into one summary memory via an injected LLM surface and a zod-validated schema.

nodes.name: vecFrom
nodes.summary: Normalizes a raw pgvector/array/typed-array embedding value into a plain number[], returning null for unusable input.

nodes.name: cosineSimilarity
nodes.summary: Computes cosine similarity between two equal-length embedding vectors.

nodes.name: pickConsolidationWindow
nodes.summary: Rule-based prefilter that clusters candidates by project_id and pairwise embedding cosine similarity (>= 0.65) into a bounded clique of up to 8 recent memories, returning null when no cluster of at least 2 exists.

nodes.name: buildPrompt
nodes.summary: Formats a consolidation window into an LLM prompt requesting a single merged summary memory.

nodes.name: consolidateWindow
nodes.summary: Two-stage consolidation entry point — prefilters a window via pickConsolidationWindow, then asks the injected LLM to produce a validated ConsolidatedBatch, returning null when no window exists or the LLM is disabled/fails.

nodes.name: rowsToCandidates
nodes.summary: Maps raw memory rows into lightweight ConsolidateCandidate shapes used by the prefilter.

nodes.name: memory-controller.ts
nodes.summary: Top-level orchestration facade for memory operations — composes MemoryRepository, MemoryService, MemoryGraphService, SalienceJudge, and the consolidation job into store/update/delete/search entry points that tools delegate to exclusively.

nodes.name: MemoryController
nodes.summary: Singleton facade exposing store (salience-scored insert + graph link + consolidation trigger), update (content/tag/embedding patch), delete (repo + graph edge cleanup), and search (hybrid FTS/semantic ranking with neighborhood-summary enrichment) as the single entry point for all memory use cases.

nodes.name: graph-stream.ts
nodes.summary: Builds the graph-neighbor RRF result stream for hybrid search — BFS depth-2 over outgoing memory-graph edges seeded from top vector hits and code-chunk-to-memory id bridging, degrading silently to an empty stream when the graph store or memory repo is unavailable.

nodes.name: buildGraphStream
nodes.summary: Seeds graph BFS from top vector-search hits (bridging code-chunk ids to memory ids via filePath/symbol full-text search when needed), traverses depth-2 outgoing edges via the graph store, and resolves the neighbor ids into SearchResults at a fixed sub-hit score — returning [] on any degradation.

nodes.name: delete_memory.ts
nodes.summary: Thin MCP tool handler for delete_memory — hard-deletes a memory by id via MemoryController and removes its graph edges.

nodes.name: DeleteMemoryTool
nodes.summary: IToolHandler implementation exposing the delete_memory MCP tool, delegating to MemoryController.delete and serializing the result (json/toon).

nodes.name: search_memories.ts
nodes.summary: Thin MCP tool handler for search_memories — delegates to MemoryController.search and serializes the ranked, timestamp-formatted memory results.

nodes.name: SearchMemoriesTool
nodes.summary: IToolHandler implementation exposing the search_memories MCP tool, delegating to MemoryController.search, formatting createdAt as ISO strings, and serializing the response (json/toon).

nodes.name: store_memory.ts
nodes.summary: Thin MCP tool handler for store_memory — delegates to MemoryController.store to persist a new memory in the hierarchical memory system.

nodes.name: StoreMemoryTool
nodes.summary: IToolHandler implementation exposing the store_memory MCP tool, delegating to MemoryController.store and serializing the resulting memory id/level/type.

nodes.name: update_memory.ts
nodes.summary: Thin MCP tool handler for update_memory — delegates to MemoryController.update to patch a memory's content, importance, or tags.

nodes.name: UpdateMemoryTool
nodes.summary: IToolHandler implementation exposing the update_memory MCP tool, delegating to MemoryController.update and serializing the patched memory.

nodes.name: acquire-indexing-lease.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the acquireIndexingLease service that pin both failure branches — a busy lease and a thrown begin() — to a terminal job-tracker transition, and confirm a throw from ManagedRunRepositoryPg.getInstance() (outside the try) rejects instead of silently resolving to failed.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses bun:test spyOn with typed mockImplementation casts and a discriminated-union result type (AcquireIndexingLeaseResult) to assert exhaustive branch coverage.

nodes.name: discover-capture-policy.test.ts
nodes.summary: Integration tests proving DiscoverStage actually consults the configured capturePolicy (Keep/Drop/MetadataOnly rules) during file discovery, composed AND-wise after the .gitignore/DEFAULT_IGNORES layer, plus the security.allowedExtensions single-extension glob-expansion edge case.

nodes.name: etl-cache-invalidation.test.ts
nodes.summary: Drives a full stubbed-grammar ETL pipeline run to prove the project search cache is invalidated before a completed indexing job becomes visible to pollers, guarding against a stale-cache read race.
nodes.languageNotes: Single long-running test budgeted at 180s to absorb `bun run test:coverage` instrumentation overhead on the full ETL module graph.

nodes.name: etl-idempotent.test.ts
nodes.summary: PG-backed tests proving ETL re-runs are idempotent: deterministic vector/keyword chunk ids dedupe on replay, and the FileCursor persisted after each file's load commit lets a killed mid-load run resume from the last completed file rather than reprocessing everything.

nodes.name: etl-load-keyword.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit test for the ETL LoadStage proving resolved file chunks are written identically, and with the same project-scoped chunk-id shape, to both the vector store and the keyword search index.

nodes.name: etl-pipeline-lease.test.ts
nodes.summary: PG-backed tests of EtlPipeline's managed_runs lease integration: the pipeline completes the lease on success, aborts it on ETL failure, surfaces busy contention between concurrent same-project runs, and — the BUG-03 regression case — never leaves an orphaned heartbeat loop running after a stale-generation retry.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses bun:test fake timers plus a manual microtask-flush loop to make an async heartbeat-loop leak observable deterministically.

nodes.name: etl-pipeline-queue.test.ts

nodes.name: lease
nodes.summary: Builds a fixture GraphGenerationLease with a fixed project/generation id pair and a 60-second expiry.

nodes.name: lifecycleRepository

nodes.name: resetWorkspace
nodes.summary: Truncates the workspaces table and re-seeds one workspace with a legacy active graph generation, giving each test a clean, known starting state against the owned scratch database.

nodes.name: begin
nodes.summary: Calls the real repository's begin() with the legacy generation as the expected active id, asserting acquisition succeeds, and returns the acquired lease for the calling test.

nodes.name: insertRecoveredFile
nodes.summary: Inserts a single symbol_files row with a 'recovered' parser status under the given lease's generation, for tests asserting recovered-file diagnostics survive activation.

nodes.name: insertCompleteGraph
nodes.summary: Seeds a full graph fixture under the given lease's generation — a file, a class definition, a reference, an import, and a centrality score — used to assert activation carries a complete graph through to the active generation.

nodes.name: cleanup
nodes.summary: Deletes every symbol/graph-generation/workspace row for a given project id, in FK-safe child-to-parent order, against the shared dedicated test database.

nodes.name: seedActiveWorkspace
nodes.summary: Inserts a workspace row, seeds an active graph generation for it, then backfills the workspace's active_graph_generation_id pointer once the FK target exists.

nodes.name: seedGeneration
nodes.summary: Inserts a graph_generations row with a configurable status, lease token/expiry, fingerprint, snapshot hash, and expected file count, computing a real JS Date for the lease expiry so Prisma sends a typed timestamp parameter.

nodes.name: seedFile
nodes.summary: Inserts a minimal symbol_files row for a given generation, path, parser status, and staleness flag.

nodes.name: beginInput
nodes.summary: Builds a BeginGraphGeneration input fixture for a given project, expected active generation, and expected file count.

nodes.name: resetFixture
nodes.summary: Truncates the workspaces table and re-seeds one workspace with an active and a pending graph generation plus a full active-generation graph (file, definition, reference, import, centrality), giving each test a known starting point for the generation-scoped symbol repository assertions.

nodes.name: makeJob
nodes.summary: Builds an IndexJob fixture with a unique prefixed job/project id and a running-progress snapshot, with per-test overrides.

nodes.name: fixtureRoots
nodes.summary: Creates a temp directory with two real subdirectories and a symlink alias to the first, for testing canonical project-root resolution and reuse validation.

nodes.name: project-root-identity.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests pinning the pure path-algebra behavior of the project-root-identity helpers (operand order in the reuse-rejection message, path resolution before canonicalization) using injected canonicalize doubles rather than a real filesystem.

nodes.name: structural-etl.test.ts
nodes.summary: Integration tests driving the Parse/Resolve/Load ETL stages end-to-end against real temp-directory fixtures, covering TypeScript path-alias resolution, smart-chunking, and C/C++ header-language evidence collection.

nodes.name: structural-identity.test.ts
nodes.summary: Golden tests for UTF-8-aware source-span indexing (BOM, CRLF, emoji byte-columns) and the structural FQN codec's signature canonicalization, hash-collision detection, and display-name formatting.

nodes.name: structural-resolver.test.ts
nodes.summary: Large unit suite for the structural resolver registry and its per-language-family resolver definitions (scripting, systems, managed, functional, data/document, TypeScript), verifying cross-file symbol resolution against hand-built fixture documents.

nodes.name: graph-generation-repository-pg.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL-backed implementation of the graph-generation lease/CAS lifecycle (begin, heartbeat, complete, activate, abort, cleanup) that gates when a newly-built symbol graph is safe to publish as the project's active generation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses raw parameterized $queryRaw/$executeRaw calls inside Prisma transactions for row-level locking rather than the Prisma query builder, needed for the compare-and-swap lease semantics.

nodes.name: managed-run-repository-pg.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL-backed CAS/lease repository for the standalone managed_runs table, mirroring the graph-generation lease pattern but for indexing-run process ownership, with a reaper that clears expired active rows before each acquire race.
nodes.languageNotes: Relies on a partial unique index plus ON CONFLICT ... DO NOTHING to make a losing concurrent begin() a clean no-op rather than a unique-violation abort, since Prisma's pg adapter can't transparently roll back to a savepoint.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Kernel-tier definitions of the canonical structural taxonomy -- symbol kinds, edge kinds, capability tiers -- plus the versioned schema constants and discriminated-union parse-outcome types shared by every structural/ETL consumer.
nodes.languageNotes: A discriminated union (StructuralParseOutcome) encodes ok/recovered/unsupported/failed parse states type-safely, and version constants are documented as additive-only to avoid silently breaking persisted data.

nodes.name: graph-generation-coordinator.ts
nodes.summary: Thin coordinator that wraps the graph-generation repository with deadlock retry and computes the canonical, order-independent SHA-256 hash of a file snapshot used to detect whether a new graph generation's inputs actually changed.

nodes.name: fixture
nodes.summary: Test helper that writes a fixture file into a fresh temp directory and returns its parsed-file context, tracking the temp dir for afterEach cleanup.

nodes.name: identity
nodes.summary: Builds a StructuralIdentityInput fixture with sensible defaults, overridable per test case, for constructing resolver test symbols.

nodes.name: definition
nodes.summary: Builds a resolved symbol-definition fixture on top of the identity() builder for resolver test cases.

nodes.name: imported
nodes.summary: Builds a NormalizedStructuralImport fixture with frozen bindings arrays for import-resolution test cases.

nodes.name: reference
nodes.summary: Builds a StructuralReference fixture representing an unresolved or resolved symbol reference for resolver test cases.

nodes.name: symbol
nodes.summary: Builds a normalized structural symbol fixture with qualified name and signature-material overrides for resolver test cases.

nodes.name: validateBegin
nodes.summary: Validates and bounds-checks a BeginGraphGenerationInput (project ID, fingerprint, snapshot hash, TTL) before the begin() transaction runs.

nodes.name: counts
nodes.summary: Maps a raw completion-counts SQL row into the typed GenerationCounts shape used to decide whether a graph generation is complete.

nodes.name: lockGeneration
nodes.summary: Row-locks a specific graph_generations record within a transaction via raw parameterized SQL, returning null if it no longer exists.

nodes.name: generationCounts
nodes.summary: Queries aggregate file/definition/reference/diagnostic counts for a graph generation, used by complete() and activate() to decide completeness.

nodes.name: leaseMatches
nodes.summary: Checks whether a caller-supplied lease token/expiry still matches the workspace or generation's currently-held lease, guarding every state-transition method against a stale caller.

nodes.name: validateBegin
nodes.summary: Validates and bounds-checks a BeginManagedRunInput (project ID, run kind, event ID, TTL) before the begin() transaction attempts to acquire the lease.

nodes.name: toLease
nodes.summary: Maps a raw managed_runs row plus a caller-generated lease token into the typed ManagedRunLease returned to a winning begin() caller.

nodes.name: toActive
nodes.summary: Maps a raw managed_runs row into the typed ActiveManagedRun shape returned by getActive(), including the persisted file cursor for crash-resume.

nodes.name: buildGraphInputSnapshotHash
nodes.summary: Computes a canonical, sort-order-independent SHA-256 hash over a project's file snapshot (path, content hash, size), used to detect whether a new graph generation's inputs actually changed from the active one.

nodes.name: GraphGenerationRepositoryPg
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL implementation of GraphGenerationRepository providing the begin/heartbeat/complete/activate/abort/cleanupSuperseded lease lifecycle that gates promoting a newly-built symbol graph to the project's active generation.

nodes.name: ManagedRunRepositoryPg
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL CAS-lease implementation of ManagedRunRepository for the managed_runs table, providing begin/heartbeat/complete/updateFileCursor/abort/getActive so at most one live indexing run per (project, kind) can hold the lease, with a self-healing reaper for stale rows.

nodes.name: GraphGenerationCoordinator
nodes.summary: Thin per-run wrapper around the graph-generation repository that adds deadlock retry to heartbeat calls and exposes begin/heartbeat/activate/abort/cleanup to the ETL pipeline without leaking raw repository/lease details.

nodes.name: pipeline.ts
nodes.summary: Singleton ETL pipeline orchestrator that runs discover -> parse -> resolve -> load in sequence, coordinating a graph-generation lease and an optional managed-run lease with independent heartbeat timers, cooperative abort on lease loss, and search-cache/vector-store invalidation on completion.
nodes.languageNotes: Runs two independent background heartbeat loops (graph-generation lease and managed-run lease) behind their own AbortControllers, aborting the whole run via a shared graphAbortController if either lease is lost mid-run.

nodes.name: stage-context.ts
nodes.summary: Shared contract types passed between the four ETL stages (discover -> parse -> resolve -> load): the per-run stage context, event/progress types, and the file/symbol/import/edge shapes each stage produces and the next consumes.

nodes.name: discover.ts
nodes.summary: ETL Stage 1 -- scans the project directory for indexable files, computes SHA-256 content hashes to skip unchanged files, applies gitignore and capture-policy filtering, and orders output by symbol centrality so high-value files load first.

nodes.name: load.ts
nodes.summary: ETL Stage 4 -- persists resolved files in parallel to the vector store, keyword store, and symbol database inside per-file PostgreSQL transactions with deadlock retry, updating the fingerprint cursor used for crash-resumable indexing.

nodes.name: parse.ts
nodes.summary: ETL Stage 2 -- parses each changed file's content through the native Tree-sitter structural runtime for supported languages, chunking text for embeddings, with regex-based symbol/import extraction fallbacks for Python, Dart, and Kotlin.
nodes.languageNotes: Maintains hand-rolled regex extractors (extractPySymbols/extractDartSymbols/extractKtSymbols/extractPyImports/extractKtImports) as a semantic-only fallback for languages outside the native query-pack manifest.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: The public re-export barrel for the entire services/ tier -- search, memory, context, executor, graph/symbol, structural, jobs, scheduler, synapse, and web controllers -- forming the @massa-ai/core services surface consumed by tools/ and the transports.

nodes.name: acquire-indexing-lease.ts
nodes.summary: Extracted synchronous half of index_project's managed-run lease acquisition -- begins the managed_runs lease and maps the repository's begin() outcome (acquired/busy/failed) to an exhaustive result the tool handler switches on, always resolving the job tracker to a terminal state on failure.

nodes.name: execute-indexing.ts
nodes.summary: Background half of index_project -- runs the full ETL pipeline, optionally warms the search cache, and transitions the index job tracker to its terminal success/error state, swallowing pipeline failures into a recorded job result rather than rejecting.

nodes.name: buildHeaderLanguageEvidence
nodes.summary: Scans discovered .h files and compile_commands.json-style build records to classify each header as C- or C++-imported/built, producing per-header language evidence used to disambiguate the correct grammar during parsing.

nodes.name: abortable
nodes.summary: Races a promise against an AbortSignal, rejecting with the abort reason if the signal fires before the operation settles, used to make every ETL stage call cooperatively cancellable.

nodes.name: formatDuration
nodes.summary: Formats a millisecond duration as mm:ss for human-readable progress and completion log lines.

nodes.name: buildSymbolPersistenceBatch
nodes.summary: Transforms a ResolvedFile's raw symbols, imports, and edges into the flat SymbolDefinition/SymbolReference/SymbolImport rows the symbol repository persists for a given project and generation.

nodes.name: resolveChunkerMaxChars
nodes.summary: Resolves the smart-chunker's max-characters-per-chunk budget from an embedding-provider-specific environment override, falling back to a provider-appropriate default.

nodes.name: acquireIndexingLease
nodes.summary: Acquires the managed_runs indexing lease for a project via the repository's begin(), mapping its acquired/busy outcome (or a thrown infrastructure error) into an exhaustive acquired/busy/failed result, always leaving the job tracker in a terminal state on the two failure branches.

nodes.name: executeIndexing
nodes.summary: Runs the background half of an indexing job: executes the EtlPipeline, optionally warms the search cache, and always resolves the index job tracker to a terminal success or error result rather than letting the failure propagate as a rejection.

nodes.name: EtlPipelineBusyError
nodes.summary: Error thrown when a managed_runs indexing lease for a project is already held by another live process, carrying the active run ID and lease expiry so callers can map it to a 409 response and poll for status.

nodes.name: EtlPipeline
nodes.summary: The singleton ETL orchestrator: serializes per-project runs, resolves the canonical project root, acquires/heartbeats the graph-generation and managed-run leases in parallel, runs discover -> parse -> resolve -> load, and publishes progress/completion events while invalidating caches on success.

nodes.name: DiscoverStage
nodes.summary: ETL Stage 1 implementation: globs the project for indexable files honoring capture policy and .gitignore, hashes each file's content to skip unchanged ones, and orders the discovered set by symbol centrality then recency.

nodes.name: LoadStage
nodes.summary: ETL Stage 4 implementation: lazily resolves the vector store, keyword search, and managed-run repository singletons, then persists each resolved file's chunks and symbols in parallel batches with per-file transactional writes and deadlock retry.

nodes.name: StructuralEtlParseError
nodes.summary: Error type raised when the native structural runtime fails to parse a file, carrying the relative path and structural diagnostics for the ETL pipeline to surface or mark the file stale.

nodes.name: ParseStage
nodes.summary: ETL Stage 2 implementation: parses each changed file through the native structural runtime for manifest-supported languages, smart-chunks content for embeddings, and falls back to regex-based symbol/import extraction for Python, Dart, and Kotlin.

nodes.name: session-bias.ts
nodes.summary: Applies Synapse agent-session state (buffer injection, workspace scoping) over a session-independent cached base search result, using injected session-registry and synapse-manager dependencies with lazy fallback factories and graceful degradation on lookup or processing failure.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a late-bound optional dependency record (`SessionBiasDeps`) instead of capturing a facade instance; factory fallbacks (`getSessionRegistry()`, `getSynapseManager()`) only resolve after the no-session early return, preserving byte-identical behavior extracted verbatim from a prior `rlm-synapse.ts` module.

nodes.name: applySynapseState
nodes.summary: Looks up the caller's Synapse session, runs the base search results through the SynapseManager's session-aware processing pipeline, and filters the output back down to results the caller is allowed to see, falling back to the unmodified base results on any lookup or processing failure.

nodes.name: embedding-evolution.ts
nodes.summary: Pure-math module that blends a memory's original embedding toward the centroid of the query embeddings that recently retrieved it, so frequently-relevant memories 'migrate' toward their real usage context, while skipping the blend when queries have drifted too far from the original meaning. Disabled by default (experimental).
nodes.languageNotes: Side-effect-free numeric functions operating on `number[] | Float32Array` unions; a cosine-similarity drift threshold gates the blend to avoid destabilizing memories used in genuinely different contexts.

nodes.name: cosine
nodes.summary: Computes cosine similarity between two equal-length numeric vectors, returning 0 for mismatched lengths or zero-magnitude vectors.

nodes.name: centroidOf
nodes.summary: Computes the element-wise mean (centroid) of a list of numeric vectors.

nodes.name: blend
nodes.summary: Produces a weighted linear combination of two equal-length vectors given per-vector weights.

nodes.name: evolveEmbeddings
nodes.summary: Batch-computes blended embedding updates for inputs with enough recent query samples, skipping any whose query-centroid drift falls below the configured threshold; returns an empty list when the feature is disabled.

nodes.name: session-registry.ts
nodes.summary: In-memory registry of live agent Synapse sessions keyed by sessionId, with lazy TTL eviction, sliding-expiry reads, task-context tokenization, LRU-bounded access history, and an optional write-through SessionStore for durability across process restarts.
nodes.languageNotes: Persistence is best-effort: every store operation (`save`, `load`, `delete`, `recordAccess`) is wrapped in try/catch so a backend outage degrades to in-memory-only rather than failing the caller. `getSessionRegistry()` uses `require()` instead of a static import specifically to avoid pulling in a legacy database module at module-evaluation time.

nodes.name: newSynapseSessionId
nodes.summary: Generates a collision-safe, CSPRNG-backed session id (`syn_<uuidv4>`), replacing a previous timestamp+Math.random() scheme flagged by CodeQL as insecure randomness that let an authenticated caller guess another agent's sessionId.

nodes.name: getSessionRegistry
nodes.summary: Lazily constructs the process-wide SessionRegistry singleton, wiring the durable PostgreSQL-backed SessionStore and falling back to an ephemeral MemorySessionStore if store initialization fails.

nodes.name: resetSessionRegistry
nodes.summary: Clears the process-wide SessionRegistry singleton reference; a test-only reset hook.

nodes.name: SessionRegistry
nodes.summary: Core session lifecycle manager: creates, reads (sync and async), updates, and expires AgentSession records, sliding each session's TTL on access, tracking a bounded LRU access history for agent-affinity scoring, and best-effort mirroring every mutation to an injected SessionStore backend.

nodes.name: session-store-pg.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL-backed implementation of SessionStore that exposes the registry's required synchronous read API over an async database by serving reads from an in-memory mirror hydrated from Postgres on first use, while writes persist fire-and-forget through a per-session write chain that preserves commit order.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses raw `$queryRaw`/`$executeRaw` SQL rather than the Prisma query builder to avoid a Prisma 7.7.0 + adapter-pg incompatibility, matching the sibling PgScheduledJobStore/MemoryRepositoryPg pattern. A failed-hydration timestamp rate-limits retries so a persistent PG outage does not turn every operation into a full-table `SELECT *` storm.

nodes.name: PgSynapseSessionStore
nodes.summary: Implements SessionStore against PostgreSQL: hydrates an in-memory mirror from the synapse_sessions/synapse_access_history tables on first use, serves all reads synchronously from that mirror, and serializes per-session writes (including working-memory buffer snapshot persistence) through a chained fire-and-forget queue so concurrent recordAccess calls commit in order.

nodes.name: index-job-store-pg.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL-backed implementation of the JobStore contract for indexing jobs; keeps a synchronous in-memory mirror hydrated from Postgres for fast reads, serializes per-job writes into commit-ordered fire-and-forget persists, and recovers stale `running` jobs to `failed` on process startup.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses raw SQL via Prisma's $executeRaw/$queryRaw instead of the model API to sidestep a Prisma 7.7.0 + adapter-pg incompatibility; a per-jobId promise chain enforces persist commit order despite fire-and-forget writes.

nodes.name: rowToJob
nodes.summary: Converts a raw Postgres row (with bigint timestamps) into the in-memory IndexJob shape used by the tracker and mirror.

nodes.name: PgJobStore
nodes.summary: JobStore implementation backed by PostgreSQL's index_jobs table; serves synchronous reads from an in-memory mirror hydrated on first use, chains per-job persists to guarantee commit order, and flips stale running jobs to failed on startup (crash recovery).

nodes.name: project-root-identity.ts
nodes.summary: Owns the request-root identity checks for index_project: canonicalizing a requested project path via realpath, and asserting that a reused projectId still points at the same canonical root before allowing indexing to proceed.

nodes.name: canonicalizeProjectRoot
nodes.summary: Resolves a project path to its canonical absolute form using realpath (injectable for tests).

nodes.name: assertProjectRootReuse
nodes.summary: Guards project re-indexing by throwing when a reused projectId's canonical stored path differs from the newly canonicalized request path, unless forceReindex is set.

nodes.name: diagnostics.ts
nodes.summary: Small helper module that builds bounded ParseDiagnostic records and classifies native tree-sitter load failures (ABI mismatch vs. missing grammar) for the structural parsing pipeline.

nodes.name: diagnostic
nodes.summary: Builds a frozen ParseDiagnostic with a code, severity, and a message truncated to 500 characters.

nodes.name: boundDiagnostics
nodes.summary: Freezes and truncates a diagnostics array to at most MAX_STRUCTURAL_DIAGNOSTIC_DETAILS entries.

nodes.name: classifyNativeFailure
nodes.summary: Classifies a caught native-loading error as an ABI mismatch or a grammar problem by matching known substrings in the error message.

nodes.name: grammar-loaders.ts
nodes.summary: Loads native tree-sitter grammar packages for every language in the manifest, serializing a process-wide Bun-version compatibility mask (native tree-sitter builds probe process.versions.bun) so concurrent loads cannot race on that mutation.
nodes.languageNotes: withMaskedBunVersion temporarily deletes process.versions.bun for the duration of a native require/import (some native tree-sitter bindings misdetect Bun as Node), serializing all callers through a promise-chain mutex and restoring the exact original property descriptor even on partial failure.

nodes.name: descriptorEquals
nodes.summary: Compares two PropertyDescriptor objects field-by-field for equality.

nodes.name: withMaskedBunVersion
nodes.summary: Serializes and executes a callback with process.versions.bun temporarily masked, restoring the original property descriptor afterward even if the callback or restoration throws.

nodes.name: grammarArtifactKey
nodes.summary: Builds a stable dedup key for a grammar artifact from its package name and export name.

nodes.name: assertRuntimeTarget
nodes.summary: Throws unless the current process is running on a supported OS/arch/Bun/ABI combination for native structural parsing.

nodes.name: loadArtifact
nodes.summary: Loads one native tree-sitter grammar package by name via a switch over every supported language and resolves its exported language object.

nodes.name: loadNativeGrammarSet
nodes.summary: Loads and deduplicates the full set of native grammar artifacts needed by the language manifest, masking the Bun version marker for the duration.

nodes.name: language-manifest.ts
nodes.summary: Central language manifest mapping every supported file extension to its Tree-sitter grammar artifact, dialect, capability tier (structure vs. flow), and versioning metadata; also resolves C/C++ header ambiguity and exposes the structural fingerprint inputs used for cache invalidation.
nodes.languageNotes: LANGUAGE_MANIFEST is asserted exhaustive against DEFAULT_ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS at module load time (assertLanguageManifestExhaustive() runs unconditionally at the bottom of the file), so a missing, duplicate, or misordered extension entry fails fast at import rather than at first use.

nodes.name: grammar
nodes.summary: Builds a frozen GrammarArtifact descriptor (package name, version, optional export name).

nodes.name: entry
nodes.summary: Builds one frozen LanguageManifestEntry, deriving its capability set from the requested capability tier (structure vs. flow).

nodes.name: inspectLanguageManifest
nodes.summary: Compares the manifest's extensions against an expected list, reporting missing, extra, duplicate, and out-of-order entries.

nodes.name: assertLanguageManifestExhaustive
nodes.summary: Throws with a JSON diagnostic if the language manifest is not exhaustive relative to the expected extension list.

nodes.name: getLanguageManifestEntry
