nodes.summary: Looks up a manifest entry by extension (case-insensitive).

nodes.name: resolveStructuralLanguage
nodes.summary: Resolves an extension to either a supported manifest entry or a semantic-only fallback resolution with a recovered diagnostic.

nodes.name: resolveStructuralParseLanguage
nodes.summary: Resolves the parse language for an extension, special-casing `.h` headers: defaults to C unless importer/build evidence unambiguously proves C++.

nodes.name: parser-readiness.ts
nodes.summary: Process-wide readiness gate for native structural parsing: validates every language manifest grammar by loading it and parsing a minimal fixture exactly once, caching the validated grammar set and exposing status/errors so indexing refuses to start until parsers are ready.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a monotonically increasing readinessGeneration counter so a concurrent resetParserReadinessForTests() during an in-flight validation correctly aborts the stale run instead of racing it.

nodes.name: ParserReadinessError
nodes.summary: Error subclass carrying a fixed PARSER_NOT_READY code and the readiness snapshot that caused it.

nodes.name: boundedDiagnostic
nodes.summary: Classifies a validation error into a readiness diagnostic code (incompatible ABI, missing grammar, or generic validation failure) with a truncated message.

nodes.name: runValidation
nodes.summary: Runs the full grammar-readiness validation flight: verifies grammar source integrity, loads every unique grammar artifact, and parses each language's minimal fixture to confirm a clean, fully-consumed parse tree.

nodes.name: validateAllGrammars
nodes.summary: Idempotently kicks off (or reuses) the single process-wide grammar validation flight, short-circuiting when already ready or failed.

nodes.name: getParserReadiness
nodes.summary: Returns the current readiness snapshot without triggering validation.

nodes.name: getValidatedNativeGrammarSet
nodes.summary: Returns the cached validated grammar set, throwing ParserReadinessError if not ready.

nodes.name: assertParserReadyForIndexing
nodes.summary: Awaits full grammar validation before indexing is allowed to proceed.

nodes.name: resetParserReadinessForTests
nodes.summary: Test-only seam that resets readiness state and swaps the grammar loader, bumping the generation counter to invalidate any in-flight validation.

nodes.name: query-pack-edges.ts
nodes.summary: Normalizes tree-sitter query captures into structural import records, call/event/http edges, and type-relation edges (type_ref, extend, implement) across roughly 20 languages — the polyglot edge-building core of the structural indexing pipeline.
nodes.languageNotes: buildImports alone handles per-language import syntax for Python, PHP, C/C++, Go, Rust, Scala, Java/Kotlin, Dart, C#/Swift, Elixir, Erlang, Clojure, OCaml, and Haskell in one large branch, in addition to ESM/CommonJS forms, each normalizing into a shared NormalizedStructuralImport shape.

nodes.name: buildImports
nodes.summary: Normalizes raw tree-sitter import/require/use captures for every supported language into a shared NormalizedStructuralImport list, handling per-language syntax (Python relative dots, Rust use-tree grouping, PHP namespace groups, Elixir import/alias/require/use forms, etc.).

nodes.name: unresolved
nodes.summary: Builds an unresolved StructuralTarget reference from a name and optional qualifier, pending later cross-file resolution.

nodes.name: callKind
nodes.summary: Classifies a call target as an emit, listen, http_call, or plain call based on known event/HTTP-client naming conventions and literal URL patterns.

nodes.name: buildCallEdges
nodes.summary: Builds call, emit/listen, http_call, and data_flow edges from `edge.call` captures, tagging each with target/metadata and gating call vs. data-flow edges on the pack's capability contract.

nodes.name: buildSyntaxEdges
nodes.summary: Builds type_ref, extend, and implement edges from type-relation captures, handling generic type containers, implement/extend lists, and nested type identifiers.

nodes.name: dedupeEdges
nodes.summary: Deduplicates structural edges by kind, span, target, and parameter index.

nodes.name: query-pack-registry.ts
nodes.summary: Central registry mapping every language dialect to its StructuralQueryPack (Tree-sitter query source set), aggregating the per-language-family query pack modules and exposing capability-gate and symbol-kind lookups used throughout structural parsing.

nodes.name: enabled
nodes.summary: Checks whether a structural capability is marked required in a capability contract.

nodes.name: queryPackFor
nodes.summary: Looks up the query pack for a language manifest entry's dialect, throwing if unavailable or version-mismatched.

nodes.name: structuralQueryPackForDialect
nodes.summary: Looks up a query pack directly by dialect string, returning undefined if absent.

nodes.name: query-pack.ts
nodes.summary: Orchestrates one structural query-pack execution against a parsed tree: runs the pack's Tree-sitter queries, normalizes captures, and assembles the final symbols/edges/imports structure, gated by the language's capability contract.

nodes.name: executeQueryPack
nodes.summary: Executes a structural query pack against a parsed tree: collects embedded-language children, normalizes and filters captures, then builds imports/symbols/edges according to the capability contract and returns the assembled NormalizedStructure.

nodes.name: executeStructuralQueryPack
nodes.summary: Capability-driven StructuralQueryExecutor entry point that resolves the query pack for a language and delegates to executeQueryPack.

nodes.name: source-span.ts
nodes.summary: Byte-addressed source index over one immutable UTF-8 source snapshot: converts between byte offsets and row/column points, validates spans, extracts snippet text, and remaps embedded-language child spans back into host-document coordinates.
nodes.languageNotes: Binary-searches a precomputed line-start table for O(log n) byte-offset-to-point conversion; validates UTF-8 well-formedness at construction and rejects byte offsets that split a multi-byte code point.

nodes.name: deriveLegacyLineRange
nodes.summary: Derives one-based inclusive lineStart/lineEnd fields from an end-exclusive SourceSpan for legacy line-range consumers.

nodes.name: SourceIndex
nodes.summary: Immutable byte-addressed index over one source buffer, providing byte-offset/point conversion, span validation and snippet extraction, and remapping of an embedded child parser's span into host-document byte coordinates.

nodes.name: structural-runtime.ts
nodes.summary: Top-level structural parsing runtime: acquires a pooled native Tree-sitter parser, parses one file's source, wraps native nodes with byte-accurate offsets (UTF-16 to UTF-8 mapping), runs the language's query executor, and recursively merges embedded-language sub-parses (e.g. Vue SFCs) with proper diagnostic/span remapping and native resource cleanup.
nodes.languageNotes: byteNodeAdapter builds a UTF-16-offset-to-UTF-8-byte-offset lookup table in one linear pass (handling surrogate pairs) instead of repeatedly re-encoding string prefixes, and wraps/caches native tree-sitter nodes lazily via WeakMaps so descendant traversal doesn't re-wrap on every access.

nodes.name: byteNodeAdapter
nodes.summary: Builds a UTF-16 to UTF-8 byte-offset table for one source buffer and returns wrap/unwrap functions that present native Tree-sitter nodes with byte-accurate startIndex/endIndex and cached child arrays.

nodes.name: executeBoundedNativeQuery
nodes.summary: Runs a compiled native query against a node with a match-limit guard, throwing if the limit is exceeded, and returns the flattened captures.

nodes.name: compiledQuery
nodes.summary: Returns a cached compiled native Query instance for a grammar+query-source pair, compiling and caching on first use via nested WeakMaps/Maps.

nodes.name: processPoolFor
nodes.summary: Returns (creating on first use) the process-wide StructuralParserPool for the validated Parser constructor, guarding against a changed constructor after creation.

nodes.name: failed
nodes.summary: Builds a failed StructuralParseOutcome from a failure kind and bounded diagnostics.

nodes.name: StructuralRuntime
nodes.summary: Owns the full lifecycle of one structural parse: acquires a pooled parser lease, parses the source, executes the language's query executor with a bounded-query/embedded-slice context, cleans up native cursors/tree/lease in all cases, and recursively merges embedded-language sub-parses up to depth 2.

nodes.name: symbol-signature.ts
nodes.summary: Builds normalized structural symbols (functions, classes, methods, exports, etc.) from tree-sitter query captures: derives symbol kind, qualified name via smallest-enclosing-parent containment, leading documentation, and a structural signature/typed-parameter fingerprint used for cross-file symbol matching.
nodes.languageNotes: Qualified-name resolution finds each symbol's smallest enclosing parent via a scan over precomputed byte ranges (containment is monotonic so this correctly identifies nesting); signatureMaterial extracts a language-agnostic arity/type-token/modifier fingerprint spanning roughly 15 language grammars' differing parameter/modifier syntax.

nodes.name: symbolKind
nodes.summary: Maps a `symbol.*` capture name to a StructuralSymbolKind, reclassifying edge cases like a constructor method, a class-nested function-as-method, a `module X` namespace, and arrow-function-valued variables as functions/constants.

nodes.name: leadingDocumentation
nodes.summary: Extracts a trailing block/line comment immediately preceding a byte offset as leading documentation.

nodes.name: declarationExportWrapper
nodes.summary: Finds the enclosing `export_statement` node for a declaration, if the declaration is directly (or via a lexical declaration) the exported value.

nodes.name: normalizedTypeToken
nodes.summary: Strips a leading colon and surrounding whitespace from a type annotation's source text.

nodes.name: signatureOwner
nodes.summary: Returns the arrow/function-expression node that actually owns a symbol's signature when the declaration is a variable initialized to one.

nodes.name: structuralSignature
nodes.summary: Extracts the normalized source text of a symbol's declaration up to its body/value, used as a stable structural signature for dedup/fingerprinting.

nodes.name: signatureMaterial
nodes.summary: Derives a language-agnostic signature fingerprint (arity, parameter/return type tokens, and modifiers like export/async/static/public) by walking each grammar's differing parameter-list and modifier-list shapes.

nodes.name: buildSymbols
nodes.summary: Builds the final list of normalized structural symbols from captures: resolves qualified names via smallest-enclosing-parent containment, attaches documentation and signatures, applies per-language qualification quirks (Erlang/Clojure/Haskell module prefixing, Markdown heading nesting), and deduplicates.

nodes.name: index_project.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool handler for `index_project`: validates parser readiness and project-root identity, creates a tracked index job, acquires the per-project indexing lease (returning 202/409 semantics), and kicks off the 4-stage ETL pipeline (discover, parse, resolve, load) in the background.

nodes.name: IndexProjectTool
nodes.summary: IToolHandler implementation for the `index_project` MCP tool: synchronously validates readiness/identity and acquires an indexing lease before returning a jobId, then runs indexing asynchronously in the background via executeIndexing.

nodes.name: logger.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the shared Logger class covering level filtering, message formatting, metric logging, child-logger context propagation, and graceful fallback when config is unavailable.

nodes.name: sanitizer.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the shared sanitizer utilities, covering HTML/control-character stripping, FTS5 query quoting, user-ID validation, path-traversal-safe file path sanitization, and JSON validation.

nodes.name: allowed-extensions-config.test.ts
nodes.summary: Subprocess-based regression test proving that a user-supplied security.allowedExtensions override in config.json actually reaches the assembled runtime config, guarding against the override being silently dropped on the floor.

nodes.name: api-key.test.ts
nodes.summary: Subprocess-isolated tests for resolveApiKey's precedence rules (env over config over generation) and its single-provisioner concurrency guarantee, ensuring the SEC-01 auto-provisioned Tools API key is never duplicated or lost under a concurrent first start.

nodes.name: config-loader-fs.test.ts
nodes.summary: Real-filesystem tests proving config-loader's atomic write-then-rename persistence never exposes a concurrent reader to a partially-written config.json, complementing the spy-based config-loader.test.ts which can only prove the mechanism, not the property.

nodes.name: config-loader.test.ts
nodes.summary: Spy-based unit tests for config-loader's full surface: directory/path resolution, config load/save with deep-merge defaults, legacy data-dir migration, and env-derived embedding config, driven over an in-memory virtual filesystem built from fs spies.

nodes.name: config-validators.test.ts
nodes.summary: Direct in-process unit tests for validateCapturePolicyConfig and validateAllowedExtensionsConfig, exercising every validation branch and error message that the subprocess-based allowed-extensions-config.test.ts cannot cover due to child-process coverage blindness.

nodes.name: isolated-config.ts
nodes.summary: Subprocess test harness that runs config-under-test code with an isolated XDG_CONFIG_HOME, preventing config tests from writing into the developer's real ~/.config/massa-ai because the loader's CONFIG_DIR constant freezes at first module import within the shared bun test process.

nodes.name: llm-env-prefix.test.ts
nodes.summary: AD-010 regression test asserting the ten MASSA_AI_LLM_* environment knobs are read and their retired RLM_LLM_* predecessors are completely inert, run per-case in a subprocess since defaultConfig is a module-level literal frozen at import.

nodes.name: api-key.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves and, on first start, generates and persists the Tools API auth key (SEC-01) with env > config.json > generated precedence, using an exclusive lock file to guarantee exactly one process provisions the key under concurrent startup.
nodes.languageNotes: Provisioning follows env > config.json > generated precedence and is designed to never run at import time -- only an explicit initAuth() call triggers it, so importing this module (and thus bun test) never writes a real key into a developer's or CI runner's home directory.

nodes.name: config-loader.ts
nodes.summary: Loads, saves, and migrates the on-disk massa-ai config.json (XDG-located), using atomic temp-file-then-rename writes and a one-time legacy data-directory migration, and derives an embedding-provider environment map for child processes.
nodes.languageNotes: saveConfig writes a uniquely-named temp file beside the target and rename(2)s it into place -- same-directory-plus-atomic-rename is what prevents a concurrent reader from ever observing a partially-written config.json.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Central runtime configuration module: defines the ServerConfig shape and its exhaustive defaults, the Config accessor class, load-time validators for capture-policy and allowed-extensions, and re-exports the config-loader, massa-ai-config, api-key, db-guard, and int-env modules as the package's single configuration entry point.
nodes.languageNotes: Precedence for every tunable is explicit env var > config.json value (via loadConfigSafe) > literal default; the module also re-exports several sibling config modules so the rest of the codebase imports configuration exclusively from this one file.

nodes.name: massa-ai-config.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the on-disk MassaAiConfig and SynapseConfig shapes (the config.json schema written by users and the installer) plus defaultMassaAiConfig, the literal defaults config-loader falls back to when no file exists or a key is unset.

nodes.name: env.ts
nodes.summary: First module imported by the process: loads the nearest .env file by walking up from cwd (monorepo-aware), then best-effort seeds DATABASE_URL, LLM/embedding API keys, and the Tools API key into process.env from config.json without overriding an explicit env var.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a deferred require() instead of a static import specifically to avoid a circular dependency (config-loader -> massa-ai-config -> this module's consumers) while still running the config.json seeding before any consumer reads process.env.

nodes.name: interfaces.ts
nodes.summary: Repository/Strategy-pattern service-layer contracts -- memory repository, cache manager, compressor, vector store, keyword search, embedding service, MCP tool/resource handlers, context optimizer, logger, and config -- that decouple business logic from concrete backend implementations.

nodes.name: logger.ts
nodes.summary: Structured stderr-only logger (DEBUG/INFO/WARN/ERROR) with lazy config initialization to avoid a circular dependency, JSON metadata support, opt-in metric logging, and a child() factory for context-scoped child loggers.
nodes.languageNotes: Writes every level to stderr on purpose, never stdout -- a stdio MCP server's stdout must carry only JSON-RPC, so a single stray console.log would break the protocol handshake.

nodes.name: sanitizer.ts
nodes.summary: Security-focused input sanitization utilities: HTML/control-character stripping with a configurable max length, FTS5 query term quoting for safe full-text search, user-ID format validation, segment-based path-traversal prevention, and JSON validity checks.

nodes.name: makeIsolatedConfigHome
nodes.summary: Creates a temp scratch directory and derives the XDG paths a subprocess-under-test must resolve to, without touching the real config home.

nodes.name: removeIsolatedConfigHome
nodes.summary: Tears down an isolated config home, restoring write permission first so a test that chmod'd the directory read-only doesn't fail cleanup.

nodes.name: runIsolated
nodes.summary: Writes a generated test script to the isolated scratch dir and runs it to completion via Bun.spawnSync with XDG_CONFIG_HOME pinned, returning exit code and captured stdout/stderr.

nodes.name: spawnIsolated
nodes.summary: Async variant of runIsolated that returns the live Bun.spawn subprocess handle so the calling test can observe the filesystem while the child is still running.

nodes.name: resolveWith
nodes.summary: Runs a probe script in an isolated config home with a given env map and returns the resolved LLM config field, used to assert MASSA_AI_LLM_* wins and RLM_LLM_* is inert.

nodes.name: ApiKeyProvisioningError
nodes.summary: Fatal error thrown when a Tools API key must be generated but config.json is not writable; carries the config path so the API can log a clear remediation message before exiting.

nodes.name: warnProvisioned
nodes.summary: Emits a single once-per-process stderr warning naming the config path when a Tools API key was auto-generated, deliberately never logging the key itself.

nodes.name: provisionApiKey
nodes.summary: Generates and persists a new Tools API key exactly once across racing processes, using an atomic exclusive-create lock file with a stale-lock timeout so a crashed provisioner cannot deadlock later starts.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses fs.openSync(path, 'wx') as a cross-process mutex -- the OS guarantees only one process wins the exclusive create -- with a timeout that clears a stale lock left by a crashed provisioner and retries rather than deadlocking.

nodes.name: resolveApiKey
nodes.summary: Resolves the runtime Tools API key by precedence -- MASSA_AI_API_KEY env var, then config.json, then generate-and-persist -- throwing ApiKeyProvisioningError only when generation is required and unwritable.

nodes.name: getConfigDir
nodes.summary: Returns the frozen XDG config directory path for massa-ai, computed once at module load.

nodes.name: getConfigPath
nodes.summary: Returns the frozen absolute path to config.json inside the XDG config directory.

nodes.name: configExists
nodes.summary: Checks whether config.json already exists on disk.

nodes.name: loadConfig
nodes.summary: Reads and JSON-parses config.json, deep-merging every top-level section over defaultMassaAiConfig so a partial user file never drops unspecified nested defaults; returns defaults outright on a missing file or parse error.

nodes.name: loadConfigSafe
nodes.summary: Never-throwing wrapper around loadConfig that returns the literal defaults on any error, used by env.ts and config/index.ts where config.json is a best-effort layer that must never abort startup.

nodes.name: migrateDataDirOnce
nodes.summary: One-time idempotent migration of the legacy ~/.massa-ai-data/ directory to the unified XDG data location via atomic rename, guarded so it never overwrites an existing target and never aborts startup on failure.

nodes.name: saveConfig
nodes.summary: Persists config.json atomically by writing a uniquely-named temp file beside the target and rename(2)-ing it over, so a concurrent reader -- or the API's key auto-provisioning racing on first start -- never observes a truncated file.

nodes.name: initConfig
nodes.summary: Writes the default config.json to disk if none exists yet, logging to stderr only so it never corrupts a stdio MCP server's stdout handshake.

nodes.name: getConfigForEnv
nodes.summary: Derives an environment-variable map (embedding provider vars, log level, metrics flag) from the loaded config, for seeding child-process environments.

nodes.name: validateCapturePolicyConfig
nodes.summary: Load-time validator for the capturePolicy config block -- rejects unknown fields, excess Drop rules, invalid dispositions, and a negative maxMatchWork -- mirroring the core pure module's validatePolicy without depending on @massa-ai/core.

nodes.name: validateAllowedExtensionsConfig
nodes.summary: Load-time validator for security.allowedExtensions that rejects a non-array, an empty array (which would silently index zero files), and any entry not shaped like a dot-prefixed extension.

nodes.name: getGlobalDataDir
nodes.summary: Resolves the global data directory by precedence -- MASSA_AI_DATA_DIR env var, then config.json's dataDir, then the XDG config dir's data/ subfolder.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.summary: Configuration accessor class that deep-merges caller overrides onto defaultConfig section-by-section (preserving nested defaults on partial overrides), validates invariants like compression-ratio bounds, and exposes get/getNested/getAll/set; instantiated once as the exported config singleton.
nodes.languageNotes: mergeConfig performs a manual per-section deep merge (cache, search.queryUnderstanding, memory.decay, synapse.inhibition.*, etc.) rather than a generic deep-merge utility, so a partial override at any nesting level still preserves its sibling defaults.

nodes.name: findEnvFile
nodes.summary: Walks up from the current working directory to the filesystem root looking for the nearest .env file, supporting monorepo layouts where a package runs from a subdirectory.

nodes.name: Logger
nodes.summary: Structured logger implementing ILogger: lazily reads its level and metrics flag from the shared config on first use (avoiding a circular import at construction), writes every level to stderr, and supports metric() and child(context) for scoped sub-loggers.

nodes.name: sanitizeInput
nodes.summary: Strips HTML angle brackets and control characters from user input and truncates to the configured max length, unless security.sanitizeInputs is disabled.

nodes.name: sanitizeFTS5Query
nodes.summary: Converts a free-text query into a quoted OR-joined PostgreSQL full-text-search expression, escaping internal quotes so special characters can't break the FTS5 syntax.

nodes.name: isValidUserId
nodes.summary: Validates that a user ID is alphanumeric/underscore/hyphen only and at most 64 characters.

nodes.name: sanitizeFilePath
nodes.summary: Prevents directory traversal by splitting a path into segments and dropping every literal '..' segment, closing a bypass that a single-pass string-replace sanitizer left open (CodeQL SEC-4 alert #21).

nodes.name: isValidJSON
nodes.summary: Checks whether a string parses as valid JSON.

nodes.name: context-controller-coverage.test.ts
nodes.summary: Exercises the real ContextController's getOptimizedContext method and its private helpers by mocking its full dependency chain (SearchController, MemoryController, compression service, SessionFileCache, symbolGraphService) via Bun's mock.module, since the sibling context-controller.test.ts only tests a hand-built fake and records zero coverage on the real module.
nodes.languageNotes: Must run in isolation (bun test <this-file>) because Bun's mock.module is process-global and cannot be reset between files, so its mocks bleed into any other file mocking the same modules differently in the same run.

nodes.name: makeCodeResult
nodes.summary: Test factory building a synthetic code search result with an id, score, file path, and content string for use across ContextController coverage assertions.

nodes.name: makeMemory
nodes.summary: Test factory building a synthetic memory record with sensible defaults, overridable per test case.

nodes.name: resetStubs
nodes.summary: Resets all mocked collaborator stubs (search, memory search, compressor, graph lookups, session cache) to their default behavior between test cases.

nodes.name: handoff-proposal-pg.test.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL parity suite comparing PgHandoffStore/PgProposalStore against their in-memory async-facade counterparts, gated behind a dedicated-database environment flag so it only runs against a real isolated Postgres instance.

nodes.name: handoff
nodes.summary: Builds a default HandoffRecord fixture with a fresh UUID and project id, allowing per-test field overrides.

nodes.name: proposal
nodes.summary: Builds a default ProposalRecord fixture with a fresh UUID and project id, allowing per-test field overrides.

nodes.name: handoff-store-fail-loud.test.ts
nodes.summary: Verifies that both MemoryHandoffStore and PgHandoffStore fail loudly with SearchServiceError on corrupt or unavailable backend state rather than silently swallowing errors, plus branch coverage for MemoryHandoffStore.

nodes.name: handoff
nodes.summary: Builds a default HandoffRecord fixture used to seed both the in-memory and Postgres-backed handoff store fail-loud scenarios.

nodes.name: row
nodes.summary: Builds a raw Postgres row shape (snake_case columns, JSON-string fields) simulating what PgHandoffStore reads back from the handoffs table, used to trigger corruption-detection paths.

nodes.name: proposal-store-fail-loud.test.ts
nodes.summary: Mirrors handoff-store-fail-loud.test.ts for the proposal stores: verifies MemoryProposalStore and PgProposalStore raise SearchServiceError on corrupt rows or backend outages instead of failing silently.

nodes.name: proposal
nodes.summary: Builds a default ProposalRecord fixture used to seed both the in-memory and Postgres-backed proposal store fail-loud scenarios.

nodes.name: row
nodes.summary: Builds a raw Postgres row shape simulating what PgProposalStore reads back from the proposals table, used to trigger corruption-detection paths.

nodes.name: redundancy-filter.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the Postgres-backed RedundancyFilter's duplicate-memory detection, merge, and cleanup logic, exercised against a mocked Prisma client and a stubbed TokenMetrics so no real database or metrics side effects occur.

nodes.name: makeRow
nodes.summary: Builds a mocked memory row with an embedding vector and metadata fields, shaped like the raw query result RedundancyFilter consumes for duplicate detection.

nodes.name: search-admission-preflight.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests the two-tier search admission gate (M10): a hard failure when a project has no index metadata at all (search must never run), and a warning-with-degraded-result path when the index exists but is stale.

nodes.name: createSearch
nodes.summary: Constructs a ContextualSearchRLM instance with its index manager, embedding, and vector store dependencies stubbed out, ready for admission-gate scenarios to attach further mocks.

nodes.name: attachIndexManagerMock
nodes.summary: Attaches a controllable index-manager mock to a search instance, recording calls to getIndexMetadata/isStale so tests can assert on the exact admission-tier path taken.

nodes.name: search-controller.test.ts
nodes.summary: Fills SearchController coverage gaps left by other suites: singleton/getSearchEngine access, handleAutoReindex, generatePreview edge cases, filterByPatterns, applyBoost, rerank, degradation/stale-warning propagation, and per-response-mode recommendation generation, all against mocked ContextualSearchRLM, reranker, and event bus.

nodes.name: search-dependency-outage.test.ts
nodes.summary: Verifies that partial backend outages surface transparently through ContextualSearchRLM, SearchController, and SearchProjectTool as structured degradation/stale metadata rather than opaque failures or silent data loss.

nodes.name: createSearch
nodes.summary: Constructs a ContextualSearchRLM with vector/keyword/graph backends individually configurable to simulate partial outages, feeding cache-write observations back to the test for assertions.

nodes.name: search-project-tool.characterization.test.ts
nodes.summary: Characterization tests (PR-C T9, GMS-02 AC-2) that pin SearchProjectTool's exact behavior — delegation, format resolution, tree format, fields projection, error handling, declared surface — before the search-controller module relocates from controllers/ to services/, to prove the move preserves observable behavior.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately written to be unmodifiable across the refactor it guards; the docblock explains why editing it to pass again would invalidate the proof it exists to provide.

nodes.name: search-tools-coverage.test.ts
nodes.summary: Coverage tests for the search_code, search_project, fetch_and_index, and get_optimized_context tool handlers, with SearchController and ContextController mocked so each tool's success, error, and formatting paths are tested in isolation.

nodes.name: security-ssrf-dns-pin.test.ts
nodes.summary: Security regression tests for a DNS-rebinding TOCTOU vulnerability in the SSRF guard: confirms fetchWithSsrfGuard pins the IP resolved by assertUrlSafe onto the literal fetch URL (with a Host header for virtual hosting), so an attacker cannot swap DNS answers between the safety check and the actual connection.

nodes.name: synapse-session-id.test.ts
nodes.summary: SEC-2 regression tests (CodeQL js/insecure-randomness) confirming newSynapseSessionId() produces CSPRNG-backed, syn_-prefixed UUIDv4 identifiers instead of the previous guessable timestamp-plus-Math.random scheme.

nodes.name: synapse-task-envelope.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests TaskEnvelopeService.begin/end for the Wave 5 partial-failure contract (AD-W5-019): a session is always created and returned even when priming or search sub-steps fail, with partial=true and a populated errors array in that case.

nodes.name: makeMockSearchController
nodes.summary: Builds a mock SearchController whose searchProject method returns configurable results or throws, used to drive TaskEnvelopeService.begin's search sub-step through success and failure paths.

nodes.name: web-fetch-extended.test.ts
nodes.summary: Extended coverage for the web fetcher service: no-stream body reads, empty bodies, index-chunk errors, JSON scalar values, empty/sliced markdown output, invalid-JSON-as-text fallback, and IP classification edge cases not covered by web-fetch.test.ts.

nodes.name: captureDeps
nodes.summary: Builds a WebIndexDeps stub that records every indexed chunk and backs a simple in-memory TTL cache, letting fetcher tests assert on what would have been indexed without a real vector/keyword store.

nodes.name: stubFetch
nodes.summary: Replaces globalThis.fetch with a recording stub that forwards each call to a caller-supplied responder function, capturing every request for later assertions.

nodes.name: web-fetch.test.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive suite for the web ingestion pipeline: SSRF guard (IP classification, DNS resolution, redirect-to-internal blocking), HTML-to-Markdown conversion, JSON key-path chunking, TTL-cached fetch-and-convert, and WebController's parallel-fetch-with-serial-index orchestration, all without real network calls.

nodes.name: captureDeps
nodes.summary: Builds a WebIndexDeps stub that records every indexed chunk and backs a simple in-memory TTL cache, used by the WebController orchestration tests.

nodes.name: stubFetch
nodes.summary: Replaces globalThis.fetch with a recording stub that forwards each call to a caller-supplied responder function, capturing every request URL made during a test.

nodes.name: handoff-repository-pg.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL-backed implementation of the async HandoffStore contract: hydrates an in-memory mirror from the handoffs table on first use, persists inserts and status transitions via raw SQL, and raises typed SearchServiceError/storeCorruption failures instead of returning malformed data.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a hydrate-once-then-mirror pattern with a shared in-flight promise so concurrent callers awaiting ensureHydrated() join the same hydration instead of issuing duplicate queries; also implements the HandoffStore interface from handoff-contract.ts.

nodes.name: jsonArray
nodes.summary: Parses a JSON-string column into a string array, raising storeCorruption if the stored value is not valid JSON or is not an array of strings.

nodes.name: toRecord
nodes.summary: Converts a raw Postgres handoffs row into a validated HandoffRecord, rejecting rows with an unrecognized status via storeCorruption.

nodes.name: PgHandoffStore
nodes.summary: Postgres-backed implementation of the HandoffStore contract that hydrates an in-memory mirror from the handoffs table on first access, then serves reads from that mirror while writing inserts and status transitions through raw SQL, translating query failures into SearchServiceError.

nodes.name: 08.search.test.ts
nodes.summary: E2E suite (T3) covering the search, optimized_context, compress, read_file, and symbol_snippet tools against the live Tools API, Ollama, and MCP subprocess, including HTTP/MCP transport-parity checks and documented product-limitation workarounds (F16-F36, E1-E29).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses describe.skipIf(!READY) two-stage gating (RUN_E2E + live API/Ollama) and reuses a single shared index across the whole E2E run to avoid repeated multi-minute embedding passes.

nodes.name: 09.symbol-graph.test.ts
nodes.summary: E2E suite (T4) validating the symbol-graph tool surface — list_projects, project_map, search_definitions, get_references, go_to_definition — against an owned PostgreSQL stack indexed with the 33-file polyglot fixture, asserting FQN identity/ambiguity contracts and HTTP/MCP parity (F37-F50).
nodes.languageNotes: Frozen to macOS arm64 / Linux glibc x64 and asserts exact structural-FQN identity shapes (qualified vs legacy-ambiguous) parsed via parseStructuralFqn from the kernel.

nodes.name: 10.synapse.test.ts
nodes.summary: E2E suite (T7) exercising the Synapse session lifecycle and working-memory buffer — session create/get/prime/access/patch/delete — over HTTP and MCP, including regression checks for four previously-fixed MCP proxy bugs (BUG-SYN-1..4) (F74-F80, E16-E20, E28).

nodes.name: 11.lifecycle.test.ts
nodes.summary: E2E suite (T8) covering bootstrap, hook ingest, handoff, and auto-improve proposal lifecycles against the live stack, scoping mutating tests to a per-file projectId and skipping shared-infra-destructive scenarios with printed reasons (F84-F97, E21-E24).

nodes.name: 13.cli.test.ts
nodes.summary: E2E smoke suite (T12) running the built massa-ai and massa-ai-config CLI binaries as child processes, verifying XDG_CONFIG_HOME isolation for mutating commands and correct exit codes for unknown flags.
nodes.languageNotes: Strips a dotenvx stdout banner line (marked by the ◇ glyph) before parsing CLI JSON output, since the banner can interleave asynchronously mid-stream.

nodes.name: 14.needles.test.ts
nodes.summary: Needle-in-haystack search-quality benchmark (T10) that runs the dogfood corpus from benchmarks/needles/fixtures/massa-ai.json sequentially against the shared live index, asserting hit@1/3/5/10 and MRR regression floors plus re-run ranking determinism.
nodes.languageNotes: Runs needles strictly sequentially (no Promise.all) because Ollama embedding is mutex-serialized on this host and parallel embeds risk OOM.

nodes.name: 15.nfr.test.ts
nodes.summary: Non-functional E2E suite (T9) covering indexing concurrency, PostgreSQL data integrity, and auth behavior on an owned macOS-arm64/Linux-x64 PostgreSQL+Ollama stack, using the tiny polyglot fixture to avoid OOM (concurrency N5-N8, PG integrity N14-N17, auth N18-N20).

nodes.name: 16.destructive.test.ts
nodes.summary: Dedicated-stack destructive E2E suite (T13) for scenarios that mutate global singletons or shared infra (Ollama outage, PG error injection, throughput/latency baselines, mid-index API restart, hook-queue saturation, disabling hooks). Every scenario is a static skip on the shared stack and only runs when RUN_E2E_DESTRUCTIVE=1 plus a disposable dedicated target stack are both set (N1, N3, N9, N12, N13, E25, F87, F88).

nodes.name: 17.cleanup-verify.test.ts
nodes.summary: Cleanup-verification E2E test (T14) that asserts no orphaned e2e-ai-* projects or leaked test memories remain on the live shared stack, treating orphan pollution as a warning rather than a hard failure.

nodes.name: 19.web-exec.test.ts
nodes.summary: E2E suite (T11c) covering web fetch_and_index with its SSRF guard (rejecting private/loopback/link-local literal IPs by construction) and the polyglot code executor (execute / execute_file / batch_execute), including deny-glob and batch-size-cap checks.
nodes.languageNotes: SSRF rejection is asserted by construction: a literal RFC1918/loopback/link-local IP is classified and blocked before any connect attempt, so no packet ever leaves the box during the test.

nodes.name: 20.new-features.test.ts
nodes.summary: E2E suite (T11c) covering post-baseline features without prior dedicated coverage — compaction snapshots, Synapse PG-backed session persistence, the opencode lifecycle hook_ingest observation bridge, and lexical-RRF (trigram/fuzzy + proximity) search quality — plus a documented coverage gap for offline embeddings.

nodes.name: 24.dashboard-architecture.test.ts
nodes.summary: E2E suite (T24) covering three previously-uncovered surfaces — dashboard routes (scheduler/hook-queue status), get_architecture (MCP tool + HTTP), and rename_project/merge_projects dry-run previews — read-only except for dryRun-only rename/merge checks (DB1-DB5, AR1-AR5, RN1-RN5).

nodes.name: _helpers.ts
nodes.summary: Shared E2E test infrastructure module providing environment gating, an HTTP client (GET/POST/raw), job polling, the once-per-run shared-index lifecycle (indexed and reused across every E2E file to avoid OOM), project reset, and HTTP-vs-MCP payload matrix-equivalence assertions — imported by nearly every file in the e2e suite.
nodes.languageNotes: Centralizes safety guards (assertE2ePrefix, assertSafeE2eEnvironment) that hard-refuse to operate outside e2e-prefixed projectIds or outside an explicitly-owned dedicated environment, preventing accidental mutation of real user data.

nodes.name: postLong
nodes.summary: Long-timeout POST helper (up to 180s) used by the search/context/read_file wrappers below it, applying an AbortController-based timeout around fetch to the live Tools API.

nodes.name: httpJson
nodes.summary: Raw HTTP JSON helper that returns status code, parsed body, and ok flag together so Synapse tests can assert on HTTP status for validation-failure paths, not just body content.

nodes.name: searchMemories
nodes.summary: Searches memories for a given projectId/query via the memory search endpoint, swallowing errors to an empty array for use in lifecycle assertions.

nodes.name: runBin
nodes.summary: Spawns a built CLI binary under bun with merged env overrides, buffering stdout/stderr and resolving with the exit code for CLI smoke assertions.

nodes.name: postLong
nodes.summary: Long-timeout POST helper used to call the search endpoint once per needle during the benchmark sweep.

nodes.name: runSweep
nodes.summary: Runs the needle-in-haystack benchmark sweep sequentially against a project — resolving each needle's expected span, searching, ranking hits, and aggregating hit@1/3/5/10 and MRR scoring stats.

nodes.name: printTable
nodes.summary: Pretty-prints the needle benchmark's per-needle ranks and aggregate hit@k/MRR summary table to the console.

nodes.name: postLong
nodes.summary: Long-timeout POST helper (JSON with a text-then-parse fallback) used by the concurrency and PG-integrity scenarios to call indexing/search endpoints.

nodes.name: getLong
nodes.summary: Long-timeout GET helper mirroring postLong for polling job-status and search endpoints during NFR scenarios.

nodes.name: pollSearchable
nodes.summary: Polls a throwaway project's search endpoint until a query returns at least one hit, used to detect when a freshly-indexed tiny fixture becomes searchable.

nodes.name: indexTinyAndWait
nodes.summary: Indexes the tiny polyglot fixture into a throwaway prefixed project, polls the index job to completion, and logs the final status for concurrency/throughput scenarios.

nodes.name: postLong
nodes.summary: Long-timeout POST helper (up to 150s) shared by the web fetch_and_index and polyglot executor endpoint wrappers below it.

nodes.name: resolveE2EProjectPath
nodes.summary: Resolves which filesystem path the E2E suite should index — an explicit MASSA_AI_E2E_PROJECT_PATH override only when running inside an owned dedicated environment, otherwise the given default (the repo root).

nodes.name: matchesDedicatedDatabaseUrl
nodes.summary: Checks whether a raw DATABASE_URL string points at the exact dedicated acceptance database (127.0.0.1:5433/massa_ai_test), used to attest that destructive tests are targeting an isolated PostgreSQL instance.

nodes.name: isOwnedDedicatedE2eEnvironment
nodes.summary: Determines whether the current process is fully pinned to the dedicated, disposable E2E stack (explicit fixture path, API origin 127.0.0.1:3334, and the dedicated database URL) — the precondition for allowing destructive operations.

nodes.name: assertSafeE2eEnvironment
nodes.summary: Hard-fails before any E2E network call when the environment declares partial dedicated-stack intent (e.g. MASSA_AI_DEDICATED=1) without satisfying every ownership pin, preventing a half-configured run from silently falling through to the shared default API.

nodes.name: deriveSharedProfileIdentity
nodes.summary: Derives a short, stable identity hash for the shared index fixture from the commit SHA plus the active embedding provider/model/dimensions, so a change to any of those forces a distinct shared projectId.

nodes.name: resolveSharedProfileIdentity
nodes.summary: Computes the shared fixture profile identity (commit + active embedding provider) on a dedicated stack only, reading the provider from the same config resolver the running server uses.

nodes.name: resolveBackendAttestation
nodes.summary: Resolves which database backend the E2E environment is attested to be running against — trusting either an explicit dedicated postgresql:// DATABASE_URL or the live API's self-reported backend type.

nodes.name: assertE2ePrefix
nodes.summary: Hard guard that throws unless a given projectId starts with the e2e-ai- prefix, protecting real user projects from being touched by mutating test helpers.

nodes.name: probeAvailability
nodes.summary: Cached, once-per-process probe that checks the built MCP binary, config file, Tools API /health, Ollama availability, database backend, and whether auth is enforced — the single source powering every suite's READY gate.

nodes.name: httpGet
nodes.summary: Typed GET client against the live Tools API with query-param serialization, auth headers, and a 60s timeout, gated by the safe-environment assertion.

nodes.name: httpPost
nodes.summary: Typed POST client against the live Tools API with JSON body serialization, auth headers, and a 120s timeout, gated by the safe-environment assertion.

nodes.name: httpRaw
nodes.summary: Returns the raw fetch Response (not parsed JSON) for tests that need to inspect status codes or headers directly.

nodes.name: pollUntil
nodes.summary: Generic async poller that retries a predicate function on an interval until it returns true or a deadline elapses, swallowing per-attempt errors so transient failures don't abort the poll.

nodes.name: indexAndAwait
nodes.summary: Kicks off a project index via POST /project/index and polls its job status to a terminal state (indexed/completed/failed), throwing if the job never settles within the timeout.

nodes.name: getJobStatus
nodes.summary: Fetches the current status of an index job by id.

nodes.name: decideSharedWorkspaceIdentity
nodes.summary: Decides whether the shared-index workspace should be freshly indexed, reused, or rebuilt by comparing the stored canonical project path against the expected one, refusing silent reuse across a path mismatch outside the dedicated fixture.

nodes.name: prepareSharedWorkspaceIdentity
nodes.summary: Looks up the shared workspace's stored path, runs it through decideSharedWorkspaceIdentity, and performs a guarded reset when a rebuild is required before the shared index is (re)built.

nodes.name: isSearchable
nodes.summary: Returns true when a probe search query against a project returns at least one hit above a low minScore threshold, used as a readiness signal for the shared index.

nodes.name: isSharedIndexWarm
nodes.summary: Strong multi-probe readiness gate that requires every query in SHARED_PROBE_QUERIES to return a hit before declaring the shared index genuinely warm, preventing a single borderline file from passing the gate prematurely.

nodes.name: ensureSharedIndex
nodes.summary: Coalescing entry point that ensures the shared repo index exists and is richly searchable, deduplicating concurrent calls into a single in-flight promise so parallel test files don't trigger redundant full-repo re-indexing.

nodes.name: doSharedIndex
nodes.summary: Performs the actual shared-index build: decides reuse vs. rebuild, short-circuits when already warm, otherwise triggers a forced reindex and blocks until both the job-status tracker settles (best-effort) and every probe query in SHARED_PROBE_QUERIES confirms the store is richly searchable.

nodes.name: resetProject
nodes.summary: Resets a project's vectors, symbols, and memories via POST /project/reset, guarded by assertE2ePrefix so only e2e-scoped projects can be wiped.

nodes.name: normalize
nodes.summary: Recursively deep-clones a value while dropping volatile keys (timestamps, ids, access counts) and bucketing floating-point numbers to a tolerance, so HTTP and MCP payloads can be compared for structural equivalence.

nodes.name: assertMatrix
nodes.summary: Asserts that an HTTP response payload and an MCP response payload are structurally equivalent after normalization, throwing a descriptive AssertionError with truncated previews of both sides on mismatch.

nodes.name: proposal-repository-pg.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL implementation of the durable `ProposalStore` contract; lazily hydrates an in-memory mirror of the `proposals` table, validates payload/status/date invariants on read, and resolves the canonical project id before every insert.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Prisma tagged-template `$queryRaw`/`$executeRaw` rather than the generated client API, with a hand-rolled runtime validator (`parsePayload`/`toRecord`) standing in for schema validation on read.

nodes.name: parsePayload
nodes.summary: Parses and validates a proposal's JSON payload against an allow-listed key/type schema that varies by proposal kind (memory.create, memory.update, or tag-only), throwing a store-corruption error on any invalid shape.

nodes.name: toRecord
nodes.summary: Converts a raw PostgreSQL proposal row into a validated `ProposalRecord`, enforcing enum membership for kind/status and a consistency invariant between `status === "pending"` and a null `decided_at`.

nodes.name: PgProposalStore
nodes.summary: Implements `ProposalStore` against PostgreSQL by hydrating a full in-memory `Map` mirror of the `proposals` table on first access; reads are served from the mirror while inserts/status updates go through Prisma raw SQL and keep the mirror in sync.

nodes.name: search-diagnostics.ts
nodes.summary: Cross-cutting kernel module defining the `SearchServiceError` type and a bounded in-memory ring buffer of search degradation/failure diagnostics, consumed by health checks and multiple search/proposal/handoff stores.
nodes.languageNotes: A `WeakSet<SearchServiceError>` deduplicates failure recording so the same thrown error is never logged twice as it propagates through nested catch blocks.

nodes.name: SearchServiceError
nodes.summary: Typed error for unavailable search backends or corrupted stored data, carrying a stable failure code and an HTTP-style status code (503 default, 500 for corruption) so transports can distinguish outages from ordinary tool failures.

nodes.name: searchBackendUnavailable
nodes.summary: Factory that wraps a caught error into a `SearchServiceError` with code `SEARCH_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE`, passing through an already-typed error unchanged.

nodes.name: storeCorruption
nodes.summary: Factory that wraps a caught error into a `SearchServiceError` with code `STORE_CORRUPTION` and a 500 status, used by repositories when persisted data fails runtime validation.

nodes.name: recordSearchDegradation
nodes.summary: Appends a non-fatal search degradation event (e.g. trigram or synapse enrichment unavailable) to the shared diagnostics buffer, trimming it to the most recent 100 entries.

nodes.name: recordSearchFailure
nodes.summary: Records a `SearchServiceError` into the shared diagnostics buffer exactly once per error instance (via a `WeakSet` guard), trimming the buffer to the most recent 100 entries.

nodes.name: getSearchDiagnostics
nodes.summary: Returns a shallow-cloned snapshot of the current diagnostics buffer for health-check and status endpoints to consume.

nodes.name: resetSearchDiagnosticsForTests
nodes.summary: Test-only helper that clears the shared diagnostics buffer between test runs.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel module re-exporting `CodeCompressor`, `compressWithMetrics`, and their associated strategy/metrics types from the compression service's internal files.

nodes.name: context-controller.ts
nodes.summary: Orchestration layer for the "optimized context" use case, composing symbol-graph prefiltering, hybrid search, memory search, session-file-cache delivery planning, and compression into a single token-budgeted context string for agents.
nodes.languageNotes: Two-phase ranking pipeline — a fast PostgreSQL symbol-graph prefilter (Phase 1) that boosts files for the subsequent hybrid vector+FTS search (Phase 2) — plus a three-tier delivery plan (full/ref/diff) driven by the session file cache to avoid re-sending unchanged content.

nodes.name: formatGraphContext
nodes.summary: Formats Symbol Graph definitions and grouped references into a compact Markdown section, truncated to a rough character budget derived from the caller's token budget.

nodes.name: ContextController
nodes.summary: Singleton controller that runs the symbol-graph prefilter, parallel code+memory search, session-cache-aware delivery planning, and conditional compression to produce `OptimizedContextResult` for the `get_optimized_context` tool.

nodes.name: run-pool.ts
nodes.summary: Standalone, dependency-free concurrency primitive providing an order-preserving, allSettled-shaped, CPU-capped worker pool reused across batch execution and web fetch/index features.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately imports only `node:os` so it stays reusable outside the executor/service layers; workers pull indices from a shared counter and write only their claimed slot, making the output naturally order-preserving without a final sort.

nodes.name: runPool
nodes.summary: Runs an array of jobs with bounded concurrency (optionally CPU-capped), returning one order-preserving `PromiseSettledResult` per job so no single failure strands its siblings.

nodes.name: fulfilledValues
nodes.summary: Convenience helper that extracts only the fulfilled values from a `RunPoolResult`, preserving input order and dropping rejected entries.

nodes.name: local-health-checker.ts
nodes.summary: Aggregates PostgreSQL/pgvector, Ollama, and data-directory health checks into a single `LocalHealthReport`, attaching recent search diagnostics and generating remediation recommendations.

nodes.name: LocalHealthChecker
nodes.summary: Runs parallel checks against Ollama's `/api/tags` endpoint, the local data directory's writability, and PostgreSQL/pgvector availability, then rolls the results up into an overall healthy/degraded/unhealthy status with recommendations.

nodes.name: getHealthChecker
nodes.summary: Lazily constructs and returns the process-wide `LocalHealthChecker` singleton.

nodes.name: redundancy-filter.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL-backed duplicate-memory detector and consolidator that groups memories by type, compares embedding cosine similarity against a threshold, and merges matched pairs' graph edges and access counts inside a transaction.
nodes.languageNotes: Cosine similarity is computed manually from raw `Float32Array` embedding bytes rather than via a pgvector operator, since candidate pairs are already narrowed to a scanned in-process batch.

nodes.name: RedundancyFilter
nodes.summary: Singleton service that finds near-duplicate memories via embedding cosine similarity, then merges duplicate pairs in a single transaction — transferring memory-graph edges to the kept record, boosting its access count, and deleting the removed one.

nodes.name: search-controller.ts
nodes.summary: Orchestration layer for `search_project`, composing admission preflight, optional auto-reindex, hybrid retrieval, glob filtering, symbol-graph boosting, and optional LLM-judge reranking into the final search response.
nodes.languageNotes: `results_total`/`results_shown`/`results_omitted` expose the pre-clamp reachable count versus the post-`maxResults`-slice displayed page, and `filter_downgrades` surfaces server-side reconciliation when a client passes contradictory include/exclude glob patterns.

nodes.name: SearchController
nodes.summary: Singleton controller for `searchProject`, running a two-tier admission gate, optional auto-reindex, `ContextualSearchRLM` retrieval, glob include/exclude filtering, symbol-graph score boosting, and an optional LLM-judge rerank pass before formatting results per response mode.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel module re-exporting the Synapse `SessionRegistry` class and its session-id/creation-input helpers from `session-registry.ts`.

nodes.name: task-envelope.ts
nodes.summary: Collapses the five-step Synapse task-start sequence (create session, prime buffer, run first search, prefetch first hit, record access) into a single `begin` call, and provides `end` to compute a session summary and delete the session.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements a partial-failure contract — the session is always created and returned even if later sub-steps fail, with failures accumulated into a `partial`/`errors` pair rather than aborting the whole call.

nodes.name: TaskEnvelopeService
nodes.summary: Implements `synapse_task_begin`'s five independent sub-steps (session creation, buffer priming, search, prefetch, access recording) with per-step error isolation, and `synapse_task_end`'s duration/access-count/top-files summary plus session deletion.

nodes.name: web-controller.ts
nodes.summary: Orchestration for `fetch_and_index` — builds a `PoolJob` per requested URL, fetches them in parallel via `runPool` while each URL's own indexing stays serial, and maintains an LRU-capped in-memory TTL cache of already-indexed URLs.
nodes.languageNotes: Cross-URL fetch concurrency is intentional and safe for PostgreSQL row locks, while each URL's internal index drain stays serial to avoid self-contention; the singleton requires explicit `instantiate(deps)` rather than lazy construction since it wires in real vector/keyword stores.

nodes.name: WebController
nodes.summary: Singleton (explicitly instantiated with injected vector/keyword-search deps) that runs `fetchAndIndex` over a batch of URLs through `runPool`, indexing each fetched chunk into both stores and tracking a capped LRU cache of last-indexed timestamps.

nodes.name: get_optimized_context.ts
nodes.summary: Thin MCP tool handler that validates `get_optimized_context` input, delegates to `ContextController.getOptimizedContext`, and serializes the trimmed result plus token/compression metadata.

nodes.name: GetOptimizedContextTool
nodes.summary: `IToolHandler` implementation exposing `get_optimized_context` — declares its JSON-schema input contract, calls `ContextController.getOptimizedContext`, and returns a serialized response with tokensSaved/compressionRatio metadata or a structured failure.

nodes.name: search_project.ts
nodes.summary: Thin MCP tool handler that validates `search_project` input, delegates to `SearchController.searchProject`, and serializes the result (including a file-grouped "tree" output mode) while rethrowing `SearchServiceError` so transports can distinguish outages from ordinary failures.

nodes.name: SearchProjectTool
nodes.summary: `IToolHandler` implementation exposing `search_project` — declares its JSON-schema input contract, calls `SearchController.searchProject`, and serializes the result in json/toon/tree format, rethrowing typed `SearchServiceError`s instead of swallowing them.

nodes.name: project-identity-alias-resolver.test.ts
nodes.summary: T4 unit tests for ProjectIdentityAliasResolver, pinning the client-side canonical-ID resolution contract: passthrough for live IDs, TTL-cached mapping for retired IDs, and fail-open behavior when the resolver's lookup errors.

nodes.name: project-identity-apply-coverage.test.ts
nodes.summary: Targeted coverage tests filling gaps in apply.ts — the pg-backed transaction runner, nested-array identity rewriting, and the apply-service factory — driven through an in-memory FakeClient that answers queries by matching SQL text patterns.

nodes.name: project-identity-guard-invalidator.test.ts
nodes.summary: T4 tests covering PostgreSQL identity-guard trigger installation, the post-commit invalidator registry's isolated parallel fan-out/sanitization behavior, and the production wiring that composes both plus the alias-resolver cache invalidator.

nodes.name: project-identity-pg-acceptance.test.ts
nodes.summary: T6 PostgreSQL acceptance suite proving transactional project-identity rename/merge end-to-end against a real database: idempotent replay, conflict/collision rejection, byte-equivalent rollback on an injected mid-apply failure, zero stray source references, and dual-ID cache invalidation. Gated by IDENTITY_ACCEPTANCE_DATABASE_URL and skipped otherwise.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a recursive canon()/snapshot() pair to serialize whole-table contents into a deterministic string so a rolled-back transaction can be asserted byte-equivalent to the pre-apply state.

nodes.name: project-identity-service.test.ts
nodes.summary: T5 tests pinning the composition of createProjectIdentityService — preview acquires and releases a read-only client while apply delegates to the transactional apply service — independent of the full apply semantics covered elsewhere.

nodes.name: registry.ts
nodes.summary: Kernel-level static catalog of every table/column in the database that stores a project or workspace identity value, split into direct (column-level) and payload (nested-JSON) stores; the single source of truth shared by discovery, apply, and the identity-guard installer.

nodes.name: apply.ts
nodes.summary: Transactional apply engine for project-identity rename/merge: acquires ordered advisory locks, recomputes the plan inside the transaction, rewrites every direct and payload store in FK-safe order, repairs the graph active/pending pointers on merge, records one idempotent operation row, then runs post-commit cache invalidation and event publishing that can never fail an already-committed result.
nodes.languageNotes: Documents its own failure boundaries inline (FIRST MUTATION BOUNDARY, PRE-COMMIT BOUNDARY) so the exact point where a throw stops rolling back the transaction and starts becoming a non-cancelable post-commit side effect is explicit in the code, not just in comments elsewhere.

nodes.name: discovery.ts
nodes.summary: Runtime schema-introspection layer that queries information_schema to discover which tables actually hold project/workspace identity columns and nested-payload references, cross-checks them against the kernel registry, and flags anything unregistered as unknown storage.
nodes.languageNotes: Every dynamically-discovered table/column name is validated against a strict lowercase-identifier regex before being interpolated into SQL, guarding the whole apply/discovery pipeline against identifier injection from an unexpected schema shape.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Public barrel for the project-identity subsystem, re-exporting contracts, hashing, the PG-array codec, error types, discovery, planner, apply service, kernel registry, guard installer, invalidator registry, production wiring, service factory, and the alias resolver as one import surface.

nodes.name: invalidator-registry.ts
nodes.summary: Registry of process-local cache invalidators invoked for both source and target project IDs after a committed rename/merge; isolates each invalidator's failure and returns a sanitized report that can never flip a committed operation to failure.
nodes.languageNotes: Wraps each registrant call in Promise.resolve().then(...) before Promise.allSettled, which converts a synchronous throw from a bad invalidator into a rejection so one broken cell cannot abort collection of the other cells' results.

nodes.name: production-wiring.ts
nodes.summary: Composition root wiring the production cache invalidators (query-understanding, file-filter, index-manager, symbol-graph, alias-resolver) and the EventBus-backed change publisher into the project-identity apply service, resolving serving-layer singletons lazily.
nodes.languageNotes: The default target resolver dynamic-imports the search-controller and symbol-graph modules only on first invalidation, so importing project-identity never pulls the search/controller graph into a cold process that never renames anything.

nodes.name: service.ts
nodes.summary: Production factory for the Core ProjectIdentityService: adapts a pooled pg client to real BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK, wires preview onto a short-lived read-only client and apply onto the transactional apply service with the production invalidator registry and event publisher.

nodes.name: baselineClient
nodes.summary: Test helper that builds a FakeClient pre-seeded with the project-identity schema's columns and primary keys, used as the shared starting point for coverage scenarios.

nodes.name: withSource
nodes.summary: Test helper that overlays request/plan metadata (mode, source/target ids) onto a FakeClient snapshot to stage a specific apply scenario.

nodes.name: previewHash
nodes.summary: Computes the plan hash a test scenario expects by running the real planner (computeIdentityPlan) against the FakeClient and hashing its result, so assertions compare against the authoritative hash rather than a hardcoded value.

nodes.name: FakeClient
nodes.summary: In-memory PostgreSQL double implementing ProjectIdentityTransactionClient — parses SQL text by regex to answer information_schema, workspaces, aliases, and operations queries, and applies UPDATE/DELETE/INSERT statements against staged in-memory tables.

nodes.name: recorderTargets
nodes.summary: Builds a ProductionInvalidatorTargets double whose four cache methods record their invocations into a shared calls array, used to assert the composed invalidator registry fans out to every production cache for both project IDs.

nodes.name: FakeInstallerClient
nodes.summary: In-memory IdentityGuardInstallerClient double that answers pg_tables discovery and project_identity_install_guard calls, letting tests simulate per-target install failures and a discovery-probe failure.

nodes.name: serviceFor
nodes.summary: Builds a live createProjectIdentityService instance wired to intercept every acquired pool client's query calls, letting acceptance tests observe or fault-inject individual SQL statements during apply.

nodes.name: seedSource
nodes.summary: Seeds a complete source-project fixture across projects, workspaces, memories, and operation_log tables directly in PostgreSQL for the rename/merge acceptance scenarios.

nodes.name: seedTarget
nodes.summary: Seeds the target-project row fixtures (projects, workspaces) that a rename/merge apply is expected to land on.

nodes.name: seedGraphSource
nodes.summary: Seeds graph_generations rows for the source project to exercise the merge-mode graph active/pending pointer repair logic.

nodes.name: seedGraphTarget
nodes.summary: Seeds graph_generations rows for the target project so merge-mode winner-selection between source and target generations can be asserted.

nodes.name: clearAll
nodes.summary: Truncates every project-identity-relevant table and drops any fault-injection trigger/function left over from a previous test run, keeping acceptance scenarios isolated.

nodes.name: canon
nodes.summary: Recursively canonicalizes a row value (dates, buffers, arrays, objects with sorted keys) into a deterministic string so table snapshots can be compared for byte-equivalence before and after a rolled-back apply.

nodes.name: applyRename
nodes.summary: Drives a full preview-then-apply rename cycle against the live service for a given operation id and target, returning the committed result.

nodes.name: plannerClient
nodes.summary: Minimal ProjectIdentityTransactionClient double satisfying just enough of the planner's SQL surface (advisory lock, information_schema, workspaces/aliases/operations selects) to exercise service composition without a real database.

nodes.name: directStorePolicy
nodes.summary: Looks up the direct-store policy for a table/column pair, matching sharded vector_documents tables by pattern and falling back to the static registry.

nodes.name: payloadStorePolicies
nodes.summary: Returns the payload-store policies (nested-JSON identity columns) registered for a table, adding the sharded vector_documents metadata column dynamically.

nodes.name: isKnownRegistryTable
nodes.summary: Reports whether a table name is a recognized identity store (direct, payload, sharded vector, or the aliases table), used by discovery to flag genuinely unknown project/workspace-like tables.

nodes.name: rewriteIdentityInValue
nodes.summary: Rewrites a single payload value's embedded project/workspace identity references from source to target, handling the json, json-text, and text-array wire encodings so the UPDATE round-trips the original representation.

nodes.name: rewriteIdentityObject
nodes.summary: Recursively walks an object's keys, replacing any recognized identity key (projectId/project_id/workspaceId/workspace_id) whose value equals the source id, descending into nested arrays and objects.

nodes.name: rewriteIdentityArray
nodes.summary: Recursively walks an array's elements, delegating to the object or array rewriter for nested structures so identity references anywhere in a payload tree get rewritten.

nodes.name: createProjectIdentityApplyService
nodes.summary: Factory that builds a ProjectIdentityApplyService backed by a PgPoolTransactionRunner from caller-supplied acquire/release callbacks, defaulting invalidators, publisher, and schema so existing callers stay unaffected.

nodes.name: PgPoolTransactionRunner
nodes.summary: Transaction runner that acquires a pooled client, issues BEGIN, runs the caller's body, COMMITs on success, and best-effort ROLLBACKs on any throw before releasing the client.

nodes.name: ProjectIdentityApplyService
nodes.summary: Core transactional apply engine: locks source/target, re-verifies the plan hash and idempotency inside the transaction, rewrites payload then direct stores in FK-safe order, repairs the graph pointer on merge, writes one audit operation row, and runs post-commit invalidation/event publishing that can never fail the committed result.
nodes.languageNotes: Rewrites payload stores before direct stores so nested identity references are moved while the row's own project_id column still points at source; identity-root tables (projects, workspaces) are rewritten before their FK-dependent tables to avoid violating non-deferred foreign keys.

nodes.name: quoteDiscoveredIdentifier
nodes.summary: Safely double-quotes a runtime-discovered SQL identifier after validating it against a strict lowercase-identifier pattern, guarding every dynamically built query in apply/discovery against injection.

nodes.name: materialColumnsFor
nodes.summary: Filters a table's columns down to the safe, non-heavy set (excluding the identity column and bytea/vector types) used for merge-mode row-material comparison.

nodes.name: discoverProjectIdentityStorage
nodes.summary: Queries information_schema for every table/column in the schema, classifies each project/workspace identity column as a known direct or payload store via the kernel registry, and flags anything project/workspace-shaped that isn't registered as unknown storage.

nodes.name: countIdentityReferences
nodes.summary: Recursively counts how many times a project id appears under a recognized identity key inside an arbitrary JSON value, used to verify zero stray references survive an apply.

nodes.name: inspectIdentityPayload
nodes.summary: Decodes a raw payload column value per its wire encoding and reports how many source-id references it contains plus a canonical form, tolerating malformed data instead of throwing.

nodes.name: fingerprintProjectIdentityRows
nodes.summary: Produces a stable SHA-256 fingerprint over a set of rows by canonicalizing and sorting each one, used to compare table snapshots for byte-equivalence.

nodes.name: ProjectIdentityInvalidatorRegistry
nodes.summary: Registry of process-local cache invalidators; invalidateBoth fans out to every registrant for both source and target project IDs in parallel via Promise.allSettled, isolating each cell's failure into a sanitized report instead of ever throwing.

nodes.name: resolveServingTargets
nodes.summary: Default target resolver that lazily dynamic-imports the search controller and symbol graph service to obtain the live serving-layer cache instances, so a cold process that never renames pays no import cost.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a dynamic import() inside an async function to defer pulling the search/controller module graph in until the first invalidation actually runs.

nodes.name: createProductionProjectIdentityInvalidatorRegistry
nodes.summary: Composes the production ProjectIdentityInvalidatorRegistry by registering five invalidators — query-understanding cache, file-filter cache, index-manager metadata, symbol-graph project-root cache, and the alias-resolver cache — each resolving serving targets lazily.

nodes.name: createEventBusProjectIdentityChangedPublisher
nodes.summary: Builds a ProjectIdentityChangedPublisher backed by the shared EventBus singleton, publishing project-identity:changed as a best-effort, listener-swallowed notification after commit.

nodes.name: wrapPgClient
nodes.summary: Adapts a raw pg PoolClient to the ProjectIdentityTransactionClient contract by issuing real BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK statements through the client's own query method.

nodes.name: createProjectIdentityService
nodes.summary: Production factory for the Core ProjectIdentityService: wires preview to a short-lived pooled client and apply to the transactional apply service, defaulting to the shared pg pool, production invalidator registry, and EventBus publisher.

nodes.name: embedding-cache-pg.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit/integration tests for the PostgreSQL-backed embedding cache (EmbeddingCachePg), covering get/set round-trips, batch operations, hit-rate stats, cleanup, and Float32 serialization against a shared test database.

nodes.name: embedding-service.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for EmbeddingService covering initialization success/fallback, embed/embedBatch behavior (including the no-provider throw path), dimension/provider-info accessors, and cosine similarity, using a mocked provider factory.

nodes.name: embeddings-local-transformers.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the local transformers.js (ONNX) embedding provider, mocking the dynamic @huggingface/transformers import to verify embedding shape, NaN/garbage rejection, cache composition, and config/registration wiring without loading a real model.

nodes.name: metrics-collector.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for MetricsCollector covering embedding/compression/context-optimization recording, summary aggregation, persistence, and singleton reset behavior, isolated via a per-test temp working directory.

nodes.name: rate-limiter.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for EmbeddingRateLimiter covering RPM/TPM/RPD sliding-window request limiting and status reporting scenarios.

nodes.name: embedding-cache-pg.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL-backed embedding cache that keys entries by SHA-256 content hash within a provider+model namespace, supporting single and batch get/set, hit-rate stats, and stale-entry cleanup via Prisma.
nodes.languageNotes: Serializes embeddings into compact binary blobs using a DataView of Float32 values (4 bytes/dimension) instead of storing JSON arrays, trading float precision for storage size and round-trip speed.

nodes.name: embedding-service.ts
nodes.summary: High-level embedding service facade that lazily initializes an auto-fallback provider chain and exposes embed/embedBatch/getSimilarity, throwing rather than fabricating vectors when no provider is available.
nodes.languageNotes: Historical BUG-01 fix: an earlier version silently returned 384 pseudo-random numbers when no provider was configured outside NODE_ENV=production, poisoning the search index with fabricated vectors indistinguishable from real ones; the fallback is now deleted entirely rather than narrowed.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Embedding provider factory that auto-selects and health-checks providers by priority, wraps the result in an optional SHA-256 content cache, and re-exports the public embeddings API (types, config helpers, EmbeddingService).

nodes.name: provider.ts
nodes.summary: Vercel AI SDK-based embedding provider (AISDKEmbeddingProvider) unifying OpenAI, Google, Cohere, Mistral, Ollama, gateway, and LiteLLM/custom backends behind one EmbeddingProvider interface, with retry/timeout wrapping, Ollama request queuing, and health checks; also hosts the createProvider factory that dispatches to the local transformers provider.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a static Promise-chained mutex (ollamaMutex) to serialize Ollama requests across all instances, preventing the local server from being overwhelmed by concurrent embed calls — a pattern distinct from the per-instance rate limiter used for hosted providers.

nodes.name: local-transformers.ts
nodes.summary: Fully offline embedding provider using transformers.js (ONNX) with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 by default, lazily loading and memoizing the model pipeline so it composes with the priority-ordered fallback chain and caching layer without requiring an API key or external server.
nodes.languageNotes: Imports @huggingface/transformers via a dynamic import() inside ensureModel() rather than a static import, keeping the multi-megabyte ONNX runtime out of every other provider's load path; the load itself is memoized as a single shared promise so concurrent embed calls await one model load instead of racing to load it multiple times.

nodes.name: makeProvider
nodes.summary: Test helper that builds a mock EmbeddingProvider object with overridable embedQuery/embedBatch/isAvailable/getConfig implementations for exercising EmbeddingService.

nodes.name: mockTransformers
nodes.summary: Installs a mock.module for @huggingface/transformers whose fake pipeline extractor returns deterministic per-text vectors, optionally simulating a first-load failure to exercise the provider's memoization-recovery path.

nodes.name: freshInstance
nodes.summary: Test helper that creates an isolated temp working directory, chdirs into it, and resets the MetricsCollector singleton's static instance so each test gets an independent, filesystem-isolated collector.

nodes.name: tryCreateProvider
nodes.summary: Attempts to construct and health-check a single provider from its config, returning null (instead of throwing) when the API key is missing or the health check fails so the caller can continue the fallback chain.

nodes.name: createEmbeddingProvider
nodes.summary: Public factory that either auto-selects the first healthy provider by priority or constructs a specific requested provider, then optionally wraps the result in a content-hash cache before returning it.

nodes.name: createAllProviders
nodes.summary: Builds every provider that passes its health check, optionally cache-wrapped, for benchmarking or comparing multiple embedding providers side by side.

nodes.name: checkProviderAvailability
nodes.summary: Diagnostic helper that reports availability (and failure reason, e.g. missing API key or failed health check) for every configured provider without keeping long-lived instances.

nodes.name: withRetry
nodes.summary: Generic exponential-backoff retry wrapper that re-invokes an async function up to maxRetries times, logging each failed attempt before throwing a wrapped error once retries are exhausted.

nodes.name: withTimeout
nodes.summary: Races an async function against a timeout promise via Promise.race, rejecting with a contextual timeout error if the function does not resolve within timeoutMs.

nodes.name: createProvider
nodes.summary: Factory that dispatches to LocalTransformersEmbeddingProvider when config.provider is "transformers", otherwise constructs an AISDKEmbeddingProvider for every other provider type.

nodes.name: EmbeddingCachePg
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL implementation of EmbeddingCacheStore; SHA-256-hashes content within a provider+model namespace, serializes embeddings to compact Float32 binary blobs via Prisma, tracks hit/miss stats, and supports batched get/set plus stale-entry cleanup.

nodes.name: EmbeddingService
nodes.summary: Facade over the embedding provider factory exposing embed/embedBatch/getDimensions/getProviderInfo/getSimilarity, lazily initializing with auto-fallback and throwing when no provider is configured instead of returning fabricated vectors.

nodes.name: AISDKEmbeddingProvider
