nodes.summary: EmbeddingProvider implementation covering OpenAI, Google, Cohere, Mistral, Ollama, gateway, and custom/LiteLLM endpoints via the Vercel AI SDK, with text sanitization/truncation, retry/timeout wrapping, an Ollama request queue, and NaN/garbage vector rejection on every embed call.

nodes.name: LocalTransformersEmbeddingProvider
nodes.summary: EmbeddingProvider implementation that lazily loads a transformers.js ONNX pipeline (memoized across concurrent calls), truncates input text to a max character budget, and produces mean-pooled, normalized embeddings entirely offline.

nodes.name: checkpoint-pg.test.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL-backed integration test suite (skipped without a live DB) covering PgCheckpointStore CRUD/list/purge/stats, CheckpointManager singleton and restore flows, and AutoCheckpointer's interval/error/milestone triggering.

nodes.name: checkpoint-schema-guard.test.ts
nodes.summary: DB-free unit test that exercises PgCheckpointStore's private rowToCheckpoint method directly with synthetic rows to verify the schema-ahead guard rejects only strictly-newer stored state versions.

nodes.name: fqn-codec-schema-guard.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests verifying that structural FQN canonical signatures embed a decodable schema version and that assertCanonicalSignatureSupported throws SchemaAheadError only for a future-versioned signature, passing legacy and malformed signatures through.

nodes.name: schema-version.test.ts
nodes.summary: Table-driven unit tests for assertSchemaSupported covering the strictly-newer-throws case and the equal/older/malformed/missing-passes case across a range of version pairs.

nodes.name: tools-coverage.test.ts
nodes.summary: Coverage test suite for the get_index_status, list_projects, create_checkpoint, restore_checkpoint, and list_checkpoints MCP tool handlers, mocking the workspace manager and gating the DB-backed checkpoint suites on DATABASE_URL availability.

nodes.name: schema-version.ts
nodes.summary: Cross-cutting schema-ahead guard shared by structural FQN encoding and checkpoint persistence: defines SchemaAheadError and a strict semver comparison that throws only when persisted data was written by newer code than is currently running.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately asymmetric guard: only a strictly-newer stored version throws; equal, older, legacy pre-version, and malformed stamps all pass through unchanged for forward compatibility.

nodes.name: auto-checkpointer.ts
nodes.summary: Singleton service that agents call after each significant action to automatically create task checkpoints via CheckpointManager, based on an operation-count interval, immediate error triggers, or explicit milestone markers.

nodes.name: checkpoint-store-pg.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL implementation of the checkpoint storage contract, providing PG parity for task/index execution-state checkpoints via an in-memory mirror hydrated from and fire-and-forget persisted to the task_checkpoints table.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses an in-memory mirror plus fire-and-forget writes with per-key write chaining (chainWrite) to preserve synchronous read semantics while PG I/O is inherently async — the same discipline as PgSynapseSessionStore and PgScheduledJobStore elsewhere in the codebase.

nodes.name: checkpoint-store.ts
nodes.summary: Storage-backend contract (ICheckpointStore) and supporting types that decouple CheckpointManager from its persistence backend, documenting the mostly-synchronous discipline any backend implementation must honor.
nodes.languageNotes: Interface mandates a mostly-synchronous contract (create/get/list return immediately) while countExistingMemoryIds and ensureReady are Promise-based, letting a PostgreSQL-backed implementation do real async I/O only where the single production caller already awaits.

nodes.name: create_checkpoint.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool for creating manual or milestone task checkpoints; validates enum parameters and thin-delegates to CheckpointManager, serializing the response via the shared tool-response serializer.

nodes.name: makeState
nodes.summary: Test fixture builder that constructs a default TaskState object with sensible defaults, allowing individual fields to be overridden per test case.

nodes.name: makeRow
nodes.summary: Test fixture builder that constructs a synthetic compressed CheckpointRow (as returned by raw SQL) for exercising rowToCheckpoint's schema-ahead branch without a live database.

nodes.name: SchemaAheadError
nodes.summary: Typed error thrown when persisted data carries a schema version strictly newer than the version the running code supports, carrying kind/stored/supported context for logging and diagnostics.

nodes.name: parseSemver
nodes.summary: Parses a strict major.minor.patch semver string into a numeric tuple, returning null for any legacy, unknown, or malformed version stamp so callers never gate on unparseable input.

nodes.name: isStrictlyNewer
nodes.summary: Strict greater-than semver comparison used by the schema-ahead guard; returns false whenever either version fails to parse so equal, older, or malformed stamps never count as ahead.

nodes.name: assertSchemaSupported
nodes.summary: Public entry point of the schema-ahead guard: throws SchemaAheadError only when a stored version is strictly newer than the supported version, otherwise passes through silently for forward compatibility.

nodes.name: AutoCheckpointer
nodes.summary: Singleton coordination layer that tracks per-agent operation counts and automatically triggers CheckpointManager checkpoints on an interval, on errors, or on explicit milestones.

nodes.name: PgCheckpointStore
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL-backed implementation of ICheckpointStore that serves reads from an in-memory mirror hydrated from Postgres on first use, and persists creates/deletes fire-and-forget via chained per-key writes for durability across process restarts.

nodes.name: CreateCheckpointTool
nodes.summary: MCP tool handler that validates checkpoint creation parameters and delegates to CheckpointManager to persist a versioned snapshot of task progress for later resumption or rollback.

nodes.name: code-compressor.test.ts
nodes.summary: Characterization tests for CodeCompressor's regex-based structure extraction and the Phase-7d LLM-assisted compression branch, covering strategy selection, decompression, and fallback behavior when the LLM is disabled, errors, returns an over-long response, or throws.

nodes.name: dart-support.test.ts
nodes.summary: Regression tests for Dart language detection: verifies the smart chunker treats .dart files as code, and that the code compressor's regex-based language detector correctly identifies Dart while not misclassifying a JS side-effect-import-with-class file as Dart.
nodes.languageNotes: Injects a no-op LLM-complete seam so language detection (a pure regex path) is tested independently of the real network-backed llmComplete, which the file's own comments note cost 42s cold vs 690ms warm against a 5s test budget before this seam was added.

nodes.name: llm-client.test.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive unit suite for the shared LLM client covering the default-off gate, silent degradation on provider failure, per-task model routing (instruct vs code), Ollama json_schema constrained-decoding detection, thinking-model reasoning-channel recovery on both the success and thrown-error paths, and the think:false fetch-wrapping helper.
nodes.languageNotes: Mocks only the network layer (`ai`, `@ai-sdk/openai`) rather than `@massa-ai/shared`, deliberately avoiding bun's process-wide mock.module collision with sibling test files that mock shared config for other purposes.

nodes.name: llm-judge.benchmark.test.ts
nodes.summary: Gated non-regression benchmark that drives the real local Ollama model (when reachable) through small subsets of the consolidator merge-decision, LLM reranker, and salience-judge paths, asserting results stay above committed baseline floors; skips cleanly when Ollama or the required model is unreachable.

nodes.name: query-understanding.test.ts
nodes.summary: Spec-derived tests for query rewriting, HyDE embedding generation, QueryUnderstandingService's TTL/size-bounded cache, silent degradation on LLM failure, project-scoped cache invalidation, and a reciprocal-rank-fusion proof that rewrite-augmented retrieval ranks a needle document at least as well as the vector+keyword baseline.
nodes.languageNotes: Tests inject a fake QueryLlmSurface and embed function rather than mocking shared config, and the RRF quality tests reimplement ContextualSearchRLM's fusion math in-memory to prove a retrieval-quality property deterministically without a live index.

nodes.name: code-compressor.ts
nodes.summary: Implements CodeCompressor, the ICompressor strategy that extracts and preserves code structure (imports, interfaces, classes, functions) via regex while removing implementation bodies, with an optional LLM-assisted compression path that falls back to the regex output on any failure, over-length, or empty response; also detects source language across 8+ languages including TypeScript, Dart, and Kotlin.
nodes.languageNotes: Language detection uses ordered regex heuristics (Kotlin checked before Dart, before generic TS/JS/Python/Rust/Go) because several languages share surface syntax such as bare `import` statements; the per-instance language cache is keyed by the first 100 characters of content.

nodes.name: compress-with-metrics.ts
nodes.summary: Wraps a caller-supplied CodeCompressor's compress() call with before/after token accounting (via estimateTokens) and structured logging, returning a CompressionMetrics summary; extracted from CompressContextTool.handle so the tool and any other caller share identical compression-plus-metrics behavior.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately re-derives compressionRatio and tokensSaved from estimateTokens rather than reading CompressedContent's own character-based ratio, preserving prior handler behavior verbatim after extraction.

nodes.name: llm-client.ts
nodes.summary: Shared local-first LLM client wrapping the Vercel AI SDK over an OpenAI-compatible Ollama endpoint; exposes llmComplete/llmObject with default-off gating, per-call timeouts, per-task model routing (instruct vs code), Ollama json_schema constrained-decoding detection, and reasoning-channel recovery for thinking models that return empty content — every failure mode degrades to {ok:false} rather than throwing.
nodes.languageNotes: The reasoning-channel recovery logic handles multiple AI SDK response shapes (array parts, raw string, providerMetadata, and the Responses-API output[] shape) so both a successful-but-empty result and a thrown AI_NoObjectGeneratedError can still yield a usable answer.

nodes.name: compress_context.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool handler (compress_context) that validates the requested compression strategy against the shared enum-validation kernel and delegates to compressWithMetrics/CodeCompressor, returning compressed content plus token-savings metadata or a structured error envelope on failure.

nodes.name: ollamaUp
nodes.summary: Probes the local Ollama /api/tags endpoint with a 3s timeout to confirm the required qwen2.5:7b-instruct model is loaded, used to gate the benchmark suite so it skips cleanly when Ollama is down.

nodes.name: probeMerge
nodes.summary: Builds a duplicate-detection prompt from a set of memory-entry contents and asks the LLM judge (via llmObject) whether they encode the same underlying fact, returning a boolean verdict for the consolidator merge-decision benchmark.

nodes.name: fakeSurface
nodes.summary: Builds a fake QueryLlmSurface test double mirroring the real llm-client contract (never throws, returns {ok:false} on failure) so rewriteQuery/hyde tests can simulate success, disablement, and thrown-equivalent errors without touching config or network.

nodes.name: fakeEmbed
nodes.summary: Builds a fake embedding function test double that records every call and can simulate a throwing embed provider, used to verify HyDE degrades gracefully when embeddings are unavailable.

nodes.name: rrfFuse
nodes.summary: In-memory reimplementation of ContextualSearchRLM's reciprocal-rank-fusion math (RRF_K=60, max-normalized scores) used to prove that fusing rewritten-keyword and HyDE streams promotes a needle document at least as well as the baseline two-stream fusion.

nodes.name: CodeCompressor
nodes.summary: ICompressor implementation that extracts and preserves code structure (imports, interfaces, classes, functions, exports) via ordered regex heuristics, optionally refining the result through an injectable LLM-complete function gated by isLlmEnabled(), with automatic fallback to the regex output and a language-detection cache bounded to 100 entries.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the strategy pattern via the CompressionStrategy enum (CODE_STRUCTURE, SEMANTIC_DEDUP); the LLM branch is dependency-injected through the constructor's default parameter so tests never touch the network.

nodes.name: buildLlmCompressPrompt
nodes.summary: Builds the prompt sent to the code-oriented LLM for compression, capping content at 6000 characters and listing the regex-extracted signatures as must-preserve constraints so the LLM output keeps the same load-bearing structure as the regex path.

nodes.name: compressWithMetrics
nodes.summary: Runs a caller-supplied CodeCompressor's compress() and computes before/after token counts via estimateTokens, deliberately re-deriving the compression ratio from token counts rather than reading CompressedContent's character-based ratio, to preserve prior handler behavior after extraction from CompressContextTool.

nodes.name: _checkJsonSchemaSupport
nodes.summary: Detects whether the configured Ollama instance is version >=0.5.0 (and therefore supports json_schema constrained decoding) by querying /api/version, caching the boolean result for the process lifetime and defaulting to false on any error.

nodes.name: _setJsonSchemaSupportedForTesting
nodes.summary: Test seam that force-sets (or clears, via null) the cached json_schema-support flag so tests can exercise both the constrained-decoding and json_object fallback paths deterministically.

nodes.name: isLlmEnabled
nodes.summary: Cheap, side-effect-free check of whether the LLM is enabled, honoring a test override before falling back to config.get('llm').enabled; called by every LLM-gated code path across the codebase (compression, query understanding, consolidation, bootstrap).

nodes.name: _setLlmEnabledForTesting
nodes.summary: Test seam that overrides the LLM-enabled flag without touching @massa-ai/shared config, avoiding process-wide mock.module collisions with sibling test files that mock shared config for other purposes.

nodes.name: getLlmConfig
nodes.summary: Reads the llm config block with defensive defaults and resolves the per-call model by role — instruct calls use config.llm.model, code calls use config.llm.codeModel — falling back to the shared DEFAULT_LLM_MODEL constant when neither is configured.

nodes.name: _wrapFetchDisableThink
nodes.summary: Wraps a fetch implementation to inject a top-level think:false into JSON request bodies, a best-effort mitigation asking Ollama's qwen3-class thinking models to skip the reasoning phase; leaves non-JSON or already-flagged bodies untouched.

nodes.name: buildProvider
nodes.summary: Constructs the OpenAI-compatible provider instance for the configured model, optionally wrapping fetch with the disable-think mitigation when llm.disableThink is set.

nodes.name: _reasoningToText
nodes.summary: Normalizes the AI SDK's reasoning channel — array parts, raw string, providerMetadata.openai.reasoningText, or the Responses-API output[] error shape — into a single trimmed string, load-bearing for recovering answers when a thinking model returns empty content.

nodes.name: _extractJsonObject
nodes.summary: Best-effort extraction of the first balanced JSON object from free-text (typically the reasoning channel), stripping ```json fences and brace-matching with string/escape awareness; returns undefined on any parse failure.

nodes.name: llmComplete
nodes.summary: Public entry point for free-text LLM completion: returns {ok:false} immediately when disabled, otherwise calls generateText with an abort signal and falls back to the reasoning channel when content is empty, swallowing every error into an {ok:false} result rather than throwing.

nodes.name: llmObject
nodes.summary: Public entry point for schema-validated structured LLM output: uses json_schema constrained decoding when Ollama supports it, else falls back to json_object plus manual zod validation, with two layers of reasoning-channel JSON recovery (on failed validation and on thrown errors) before degrading to {ok:false}.

nodes.name: CompressContextTool
nodes.summary: IToolHandler implementation exposing the compress_context MCP tool; validates the requested strategy via the shared enum-validation kernel, delegates to compressWithMetrics, and returns a ToolResponse envelope with compressed content and token-savings metadata, or a structured failure on error.

nodes.name: executor-controller.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for ExecutorController covering the paths not exercised by executor.test.ts — intent-based output trimming, singleton reset, execute/executeFile error handling, and batch_execute bounds/error paths — using a fake PolyglotExecutor to avoid spawning real processes.

nodes.name: executor-extra.test.ts
nodes.summary: Extra PolyglotExecutor coverage tests for getter behavior, spawn-ENOENT error handling, background-mode timeout detachment, and Rust compile-and-run (including a no-rustc injected-runtime path).

nodes.name: executor-sandbox-mode.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests that the executor never runs unsandboxed silently (SEC-03) — verifies the one-shot warning when auto mode degrades to no isolation, silence on an explicit 'none' setting, and that sandboxMode is reported on every execute/executeFile/batchExecute result.

nodes.name: executor.test.ts
nodes.summary: Core test suite for the polyglot executor, run-pool, and intent progressive disclosure — covers mocked runtime detection, process-group timeout kills, execute_file boundary/deny-glob blocking, batch order preservation, and run-pool concurrency capping.

nodes.name: runtime-extra.test.ts
nodes.summary: Extra coverage tests for the runtime-detection module — exercises getRuntimeSummary formatting for every language, buildCommand's error path for each unavailable runtime, and commandExists/runnableExists/getVersion edge cases via an injectable dependency seam.

nodes.name: sandbox.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the OS-level sandbox wrapper — mocks node:child_process to control tool-availability checks and verifies getSandboxMode's mode selection plus wrapSpawn's seatbelt/docker command construction for each mode.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses bun:test's mock.module to replace node:child_process before importing the subject module, isolating tool-availability probes from the real host.

nodes.name: security-executor-symlink.test.ts
nodes.summary: Security regression tests for the execute_file symlink-escape fix — verifies realpath-based boundary and deny-glob checks reject symlinks (direct, chained, or mid-path) that escape the project root or resolve to deny-listed files, while still permitting legitimate internal symlinks.

nodes.name: executor-controller.ts
nodes.summary: Singleton orchestration layer for execute/execute_file/batch_execute that owns the PolyglotExecutor instance, validates the language enum, applies intent-based output trimming, and runs batched shell commands through a concurrency-capped pool.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a private static singleton with a test-only resetInstance() seam rather than dependency injection, so tests must explicitly reset state between cases.

nodes.name: executor.ts
nodes.summary: Core PolyglotExecutor engine that spawns user-supplied code in a detected language runtime with best-effort host containment — enforced timeouts that kill the whole process group, an env denylist against known injection vectors, an output byte cap, and execute_file's realpath-based project-boundary plus deny-glob guard.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses ES2022 private class fields (# prefix) for internal executor state, and per-language code-wrapping templates (Go/PHP/Rust/Perl/R/etc.) baked into #writeScript and #wrapWithFileContent.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file re-exporting the executor service's full public surface — PolyglotExecutor and its result/option types, sandbox-mode helpers, the run-pool concurrency primitive, runtime detection, and intent-search progressive disclosure.

nodes.name: params.ts
nodes.summary: Declares the ExecuteParams/ExecuteFileParams/BatchExecuteParams request-shape interfaces shared by the ExecutorController and the three MCP tool handlers (execute, execute_file, batch_execute).

nodes.name: sandbox.ts
nodes.summary: OS-level sandbox wrapper that detects Docker/seatbelt tool availability and wraps spawned commands in platform-specific isolation — a macOS sandbox-exec seatbelt profile or a locked-down Linux Docker container — falling back to best-effort containment with a one-shot warning when no sandbox tool is present.
nodes.languageNotes: Module-level mutable caches (_dockerAvailable, _warnedAboutNoSandbox) paired with dedicated test-reset exports are the seam pattern used to make process-lifetime-scoped state testable.

nodes.name: batch_execute.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool handler (batch_execute) declaring the schema for running N shell commands in parallel and delegating to an injected run function backed by the ExecutorController.

nodes.name: execute.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool handler (execute) declaring the schema for running code in a detected polyglot sandbox runtime and delegating to an injected run function backed by the ExecutorController.

nodes.name: execute_file.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool handler (execute_file) declaring the schema for reading a file into a sandboxed FILE_CONTENT variable and running code over it, delegating to an injected run function backed by the ExecutorController.

nodes.name: makeExecResult
nodes.summary: Builds a default ExecResult fixture with override support for constructing fake executor responses in ExecutorController tests.

nodes.name: makeFakeExecutor
nodes.summary: Constructs a minimal fake PolyglotExecutor stub (execute/executeFile/runtimes/cleanupBackgrounded) so controller tests can avoid spawning real processes.

nodes.name: makeProject
nodes.summary: Creates a throwaway project-root and sibling outside-project temp directory pair, used to exercise the execute_file symlink-escape security tests.

nodes.name: applyIntent
nodes.summary: Applies intent-based progressive disclosure to an ExecResult's stdout, replacing large output with a trimmed intent summary plus a raw tail when a matching intent query is supplied.

nodes.name: ExecutorController
nodes.summary: Singleton orchestrator for execute/execute_file/batch_execute that wraps a single PolyglotExecutor instance, validates language enums, applies intent trimming, and runs batched shell commands through the concurrency pool.

nodes.name: matchesDenyPattern
nodes.summary: Tests whether a lowercased path matches one of the deny-listed secret/credential patterns, using substring matching for directory patterns and boundary-anchored matching for filename patterns.

nodes.name: cleanupTmpDir
nodes.summary: Best-effort recursive removal of a sandbox temp directory that never throws, relying on OS reclamation as a fallback.

nodes.name: killTree
nodes.summary: Kills an entire spawned process tree/group, using taskkill on Windows and a negative-PID SIGKILL on POSIX so orphaned children cannot outlive a killed parent.

nodes.name: buildSafeEnv
nodes.summary: Builds a sanitized child-process environment that strips known code-injection vectors (NODE_OPTIONS, LD_PRELOAD, shell startup hooks, compiler overrides) before spawning user code.

nodes.name: PolyglotExecutor
nodes.summary: Core sandboxed code-execution engine that writes user-supplied code to a temp script, resolves the right language runtime, spawns it with a byte-capped/timeout-bounded process, and enforces execute_file's realpath-based project-boundary and deny-glob checks.

nodes.name: isDockerAvailable
nodes.summary: Checks (and caches) whether the docker CLI is available on the host, used to decide Linux sandbox eligibility.

nodes.name: isSeatbeltAvailable
nodes.summary: Checks (and caches) whether macOS sandbox-exec is available, used to decide seatbelt sandbox eligibility.

nodes.name: warnSandboxUnavailable
nodes.summary: Emits a single process-lifetime warning naming the missing sandbox tool when auto mode silently falls back to best-effort containment (SEC-03).

nodes.name: getSandboxMode
nodes.summary: Resolves the effective sandbox mode from the MASSA_AI_EXECUTOR_SANDBOX env var, platform, and tool availability — forcing, disabling, or auto-falling-back to best-effort isolation.

nodes.name: _buildSeatbeltProfile
nodes.summary: Builds a macOS seatbelt (sandbox-exec) profile string that denies network and restricts writes to the sandbox tmp dir while allowing reads under the realpath-resolved project root.

nodes.name: wrapSpawn
nodes.summary: Wraps a command array with the platform-specific sandbox launcher — sandbox-exec with a seatbelt profile on macOS, a locked-down docker run on Linux, or the command unchanged when no sandbox applies.

nodes.name: BatchExecuteTool
nodes.summary: MCP tool handler exposing batch_execute — declares the input schema for running N shell commands in parallel and delegates to an injected run function (the ExecutorController).

nodes.name: ExecuteTool
nodes.summary: MCP tool handler exposing execute — declares the input schema for running code in a detected polyglot runtime and delegates to an injected run function (the ExecutorController).

nodes.name: ExecuteFileTool
nodes.summary: MCP tool handler exposing execute_file — declares the input schema for reading a file into a sandboxed variable and running code over it, delegating to an injected run function.

nodes.name: scheduler-catchup.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the Scheduler's boot-time catchUpMissedJobs recovery and the FR-13 success/failure split fields, verifying missed jobs fire exactly once per job (not backfilled), per-jobKind non-overlap, disabled-job/disabled-scheduler no-ops, nextRunAt advancement, and correct last_success_at/last_failure_at/consecutive_failures/last_error updates, using an in-memory store double.

nodes.name: makeInMemoryStore
nodes.summary: Builds an in-memory ScheduledJobStore test double backed by a Map, exposing _dump/_load helpers for direct state inspection and seeding across the catch-up test suite.

nodes.name: makeJob
nodes.summary: Factory producing a default ScheduledJob fixture (interval schedule, enabled, due now) that individual tests override via a partial-overrides argument.

nodes.name: scheduler-store-pg.test.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL parity and async-ordering integration tests for PgScheduledJobStore: verifies full field persistence and hydration for interval and cron jobs, per-ID write serialization under rapid same-ID saves, save/delete invocation ordering, and best-effort recovery after an injected write or hydration failure; uses an instance-scoped listAll filter seam to isolate assertions on a shared database.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses an instance-scoped monkey-patch seam (installScheduledFilterSeam/restoreSeam) to filter out production scheduled-* rows from a shared test database without mutating the PgScheduledJobStore class itself, then proves the seam is reversible in a follow-up test.

nodes.name: job
nodes.summary: Factory producing a default ScheduledJob fixture with an alias-resolvable payload ({ projectId }) for the PostgreSQL parity suite, overridable per test case.

nodes.name: scheduler.test.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive unit test suite for the in-process Scheduler: covers cron expression parsing and nextCronRun computation, computeNextRun for interval and cron schedules, handler dispatch, the concurrent-execution guard, the missed-run skip policy, enable/disable and persistence across a simulated restart, lifecycle start/stop and status reporting, env-based construction, job (de)registration, catchUpMissedJobs, isJobRunning, and the getScheduler singleton.

nodes.name: makeInMemoryStore
nodes.summary: Builds an in-memory ScheduledJobStore test double backed by a Map, exposing _dump/_load helpers for direct state inspection, shared across the full scheduler test suite.

nodes.name: makeJob
nodes.summary: Factory producing a default ScheduledJob fixture (interval schedule, enabled, due now) that individual tests override via a partial-overrides argument.

nodes.name: scheduler-store-pg.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL-backed implementation of ScheduledJobStore that presents the same synchronous save/get/listAll/listEnabled/delete API the in-memory store offers: writes are fire-and-forget and serialized per job ID, reads are served from an in-memory mirror lazily hydrated from the scheduled_jobs table via raw SQL through the shared Prisma client.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses raw $executeRaw/$queryRaw SQL rather than Prisma's typed query builder to avoid a Prisma 7.7.0 + adapter-pg incompatibility, the same workaround pattern used by PgJobStore and MemoryRepositoryPg elsewhere in the codebase.

nodes.name: rowToJob
nodes.summary: Maps a raw scheduled_jobs SQL row into a ScheduledJob domain object, reconstructing the interval/cron ScheduleSpec union from separate columns and best-effort parsing the JSON payload column.

nodes.name: PgScheduledJobStore
nodes.summary: Implements ScheduledJobStore against PostgreSQL: save/get/listAll/listEnabled/delete are synchronous and backed by an in-memory mirror, while persistence runs fire-and-forget through a per-job-ID mutation queue (enqueueMutation) that preserves call order; the mirror is lazily hydrated from the scheduled_jobs table on first use, with local mutations taking precedence over the DB snapshot.
nodes.languageNotes: Presents a synchronous public API over async PostgreSQL persistence — the same sync-facade pattern used by PgJobStore — so the Scheduler's synchronous store calls work unchanged whether backed by the in-memory store or PostgreSQL.

nodes.name: chunker-code-security.test.ts
nodes.summary: Security regression suite (CodeQL SEC-3, alert #27) pinning netBraceDelta's ReDoS-safe behavior against block comments, adversarial many-opener/escaped-slash inputs, and string/template/regex literal edge cases, with elapsed-time budgets that fail on any reintroduced quadratic scan.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses wall-clock assertions (elapsed < 500ms against 33k/50k-repetition adversarial strings) as the falsifiable check for linear-time behavior, a 50x margin over the expected runtime and far below the old quadratic path's cost.

nodes.name: chunker-coverage.test.ts
nodes.summary: Edge-case coverage tests for the chunker submodules — chunkJSON, chunkYAML, postProcess, splitOversizedChunk, splitLineByChars, chunkFixed, findCodeBoundaries, netBraceDelta, and extractFileImports — targeting branches the broader smart-chunker.* test suites don't reach, plus a smartChunk .mdx dispatch check.

nodes.name: smart-chunker.characterization.test.ts
nodes.summary: Byte-identical characterization tests pinning smartChunk's exact Chunk[] output (line ranges, types, labels, content) per source format — markdown, JSON, YAML, code, and fixed fallback — as a strict mutation-killer ahead of the Phase 3 chunker facade split.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately kept alongside a coarser-grained smart-chunker.test.ts as a dual-pinning strategy: both files must be updated intentionally on any chunking behavior change, never silently.

nodes.name: intent-search.ts
nodes.summary: Implements intent-driven progressive disclosure for execute/execute_file output: chunks large output via smartChunk, builds an in-memory term-frequency index, and returns only the sections matching the caller's intent plus distinctive vocabulary hints, avoiding both context-window flooding and any touch of the persistent FTS/PG store.
nodes.languageNotes: Self-contained in-memory TF + label-boost ranking mirrors the persistent context-mode intentSearch in server.ts but is intentionally decoupled so it can never OOM the shared e2e index or trigger a full-repo index.

nodes.name: chunker-code.ts
nodes.summary: Code-aware chunker that splits source files into chunks aligned to class/function/method boundaries via regex-based declaration detection and brace-depth tracking, including the ReDoS-hardened single-pass netBraceDelta scanner (SEC-3 fix) and file-extension/import-line utilities.
nodes.languageNotes: netBraceDelta replaced a five-regex strip-then-count chain that CodeQL flagged as polynomial-time (js/polynomial-redos, alert #27 plus three PR-time alerts); it now performs one left-to-right character scan tracking comment/string/template/regex state without backtracking.

nodes.name: chunker-json-yaml.ts
nodes.summary: JSON- and YAML-aware chunkers: chunkJSON splits well-formed objects into one chunk per top-level key (or a single labeled chunk under 5 keys), and chunkYAML splits on document separators or top-level keys, both falling back to fixed-size chunking when parsing fails or no structure is found.

nodes.name: chunker-markdown.ts
nodes.summary: Markdown-aware chunker that splits content at heading boundaries (H1-H6), building hierarchical breadcrumb labels via a heading stack (e.g. 'Title > Section A') while treating fenced code blocks as opaque, falling back to fixed chunking when no headings are present.

nodes.name: summary
nodes.summary: Test helper that projects a Chunk[] array down to {lineStart, lineEnd, type, label} for compact, byte-identical assertion comparisons.

nodes.name: firstContentLine
nodes.summary: Returns the first non-header content line of a chunk, skipping smart-chunker's injected '// File:' / '// Section:' metadata lines so previews show real content.

nodes.name: searchSections
nodes.summary: Chunks output text via smartChunk, builds a per-section term-frequency index, and scores/ranks sections against tokenized intent-query terms (with a label-match boost) to find the most relevant sections.

nodes.name: distinctiveTerms
nodes.summary: Computes the most distinctive vocabulary terms across indexed sections using a total-occurrence-over-document-frequency score, approximating IDF-weighted term significance.

nodes.name: intentSearch
nodes.summary: Public entry point that runs intent search over output when it exceeds INTENT_SEARCH_THRESHOLD and an intent string is supplied, returning matched sections with previews and vocabulary hints, or a searched:false result so callers fall back to returning output verbatim.

nodes.name: renderIntentResult
nodes.summary: Renders an IntentSearchResult into a human-readable summary string listing matched sections with line ranges and previews plus searchable vocabulary hints, for agent-facing output.

nodes.name: chunkCode
nodes.summary: Splits source code into chunks by locating declaration boundaries via findCodeBoundaries, extending each boundary upward over attached doc comments, and slicing the file into labeled code_block chunks with configurable overlap; falls back to fixed chunking when no boundaries are found.

nodes.name: findCodeBoundaries
nodes.summary: Scans source lines to detect top-level container declarations (class/interface/enum/etc.), top-level functions/consts, and methods nested one level inside a container, tracking brace depth via netBraceDelta and a container stack to disambiguate nesting.

nodes.name: netBraceDelta
nodes.summary: Security-hardened, single-pass O(n) character scanner that counts net brace delta ({ minus }) on one line while correctly skipping line/block comments, string/template literals, and regex literals — replacing a regex-chain CodeQL flagged as polynomial-time (SEC-3, alert #27).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a regex-vs-division heuristic (REGEX_PREFIX_KEYWORDS) based on the preceding significant token to decide whether a '/' opens a regex literal, matching the old naive-strip behavior on well-formed code while staying linear-time on adversarial input.

nodes.name: extractFileImports
nodes.summary: Extracts the leading import/require lines (or Python import/from lines) from file content for use as chunk metadata context, stopping at the first blank line for non-Python files.

nodes.name: isCodeFile
nodes.summary: Checks whether a file extension is in the recognized CODE_EXTENSIONS set, used to route files to the code-aware chunker versus other chunkers.

nodes.name: chunkJSON
nodes.summary: Parses JSON content and splits well-formed objects into one chunk per top-level key (locating each key's original line via regex) when there are 5+ keys, or a single labeled chunk otherwise; non-object/array/invalid JSON falls back to fixed chunking.

nodes.name: chunkYAML
nodes.summary: Splits YAML content on '---' document separators when multiple documents are present, or on top-level key boundaries within a single document, skipping empty segments and falling back to fixed chunking if nothing splits.

nodes.name: chunkMarkdown
nodes.summary: Entry point that dispatches markdown content to heading-based chunking when at least one heading is present, otherwise falls back to fixed-size chunking.

nodes.name: chunkMarkdownByHeadings
nodes.summary: Splits markdown content into sections at heading boundaries (H1-H6), building hierarchical breadcrumb labels via a heading stack (e.g. 'Title > Section A') while treating fenced code-block contents as opaque so embedded '#' characters don't trigger false splits.

nodes.name: index.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit test suite for the OpenCode plugin entry point (MassaAiPlugin), exercising every registered tool's execute() call, the session/tool/compaction/shell-env lifecycle hooks, the unified event handler, and the massaAiFetch/massaAiGet error paths against a mocked fetch and a stubbed host client.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of a globalThis.fetch capture stub plus per-test fake PluginInput objects instead of module mocks, so the whole plugin factory runs for real against fake network/host boundaries.

nodes.name: makePluginInput
nodes.summary: Builds a fake OpenCode PluginInput (project/directory/worktree plus stub client.app.log and client.tui.showToast) that records log and toast calls for assertions in MassaAiPlugin tests.

nodes.name: mockFetchCapture
nodes.summary: Replaces globalThis.fetch with a request-capturing stub, returning either a caller-supplied Response or a default success JSON body, so tests can assert on outgoing request URLs and bodies.

nodes.name: observation-emitter.test.ts
nodes.summary: Isolated unit tests for ObservationEmitter and its snake_case payload builders, verifying batching/debounce collapse, the POST /api/v1/hook/batch wire contract, non-blocking failure isolation, and makeDefaultDeps' real fetch-and-timer wiring, all without touching the network or a live massa-ai server.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a fully faked EmitterDeps (in-memory posts/logs/timers) rather than module mocks, keeping tests deterministic and network-free while still exercising the real ObservationEmitter batching/debounce logic.

nodes.name: makeFakeDeps
nodes.summary: Builds a fake EmitterDeps implementation backed by an in-memory FakeState (posts/logs/timers/enabled flag), letting tests assert on ObservationEmitter's network and timer interactions without any real I/O.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: OpenCode plugin entry point exporting MassaAiPlugin, which wires 13 tools (search, remember, recall, index, compress, optimized_context, read, index_status, analytics, list_projects, search_definitions, get_references, go_to_definition) to the massa-ai REST API and implements host lifecycle hooks for health checks, tool-use/session/prompt observation emission, compaction memory injection, and debounced incremental reindexing on file edits.
nodes.languageNotes: Follows the OpenCode Plugin contract as a single large async factory function (not a class) that closes over per-instance mutable state (editedFiles, reindexTimer, apiAvailable) and returns an object of tool/hook handlers.

nodes.name: ensureConfig
nodes.summary: Initializes the default massa-ai config on first run and prints a one-time console banner explaining where the config lives and how to switch providers.

nodes.name: massaAiFetch
nodes.summary: POSTs a JSON body to the massa-ai API with an AbortController-based timeout, throwing a descriptive error on a non-OK response and always clearing the timer.

nodes.name: massaAiGet
nodes.summary: GETs from the massa-ai API with the same AbortController timeout and error-handling behavior as massaAiFetch, for read-only endpoints.

nodes.name: massaAiGetWithQuery
nodes.summary: Serializes a params object into a URLSearchParams query string, skipping undefined/null values, and delegates to massaAiGet.

nodes.name: MassaAiPlugin
nodes.summary: The exported OpenCode Plugin factory: sets up per-session project-id pinning via SessionProjectPin, wires an ObservationEmitter for lifecycle telemetry, registers 13 tools that proxy to the massa-ai REST API, and implements session.created/tool.execute.after/experimental.session.compacting/shell.env/event/dispose host hooks, including debounced incremental reindexing on file edits.
nodes.languageNotes: Tool argument schemas use a fluent zod-like builder (tool.schema.string().optional().default(...).describe(...)); each chained call is a distinct call expression, which is why the extracted call graph shows dozens of tool.schema.* callees for a handful of tool definitions.

nodes.name: app.js
nodes.summary: Browser-side controller for the read-only massa-ai Web UI: renders the projects, memory browser, search, handoffs, proposals, and checkpoints views as HTML strings, wires DOM event handlers, and bootstraps the SPA via startApp(), which fetches data from the REST API, hands dashboard rendering off to dashboard.js, and subscribes to SSE for live updates. Enforces a hard read-only invariant (FORBIDDEN_MUTATING_PATHS) that a companion test suite verifies against.
nodes.languageNotes: Guarded dual-environment module: pure render/helper functions are always defined and exported for bun:test import without a DOM, while the browser bootstrap block only runs when `typeof document !== "undefined"`. Uses hash-based client-side routing and a hand-rolled markdown fallback for environments without the CDN-loaded marked/DOMPurify libraries.

nodes.name: isWriteModeEnabled
nodes.summary: Checks whether write-mode UI actions (edit/delete/approve/reject) are enabled, via a globalThis.MASSA_AI_WEB_WRITE_MODE flag or a localStorage override; defaults to disabled and never throws.

nodes.name: escapeHtml
nodes.summary: Escapes HTML special characters (&, <, >, ", ') in a string to prevent injection when interpolating untrusted content into rendered HTML.

nodes.name: markdownToHtml
nodes.summary: Renders markdown to sanitized HTML using the CDN-loaded marked parser plus DOMPurify sanitizer when available, falling back to the built-in _minimalMarkdownToHtml renderer in DOM-less test environments or on parse failure.

nodes.name: _minimalMarkdownToHtml
nodes.summary: Hand-rolled fallback markdown-to-HTML renderer supporting headings, bold/italic, inline code, fenced code blocks, lists, links, and paragraphs; escapes all raw text first so no injected markup can execute.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements a line-oriented state machine with list/paragraph flush helpers (flushLists, flushPara) and a code-token stash (inline) that protects inline code spans from subsequent formatting passes.

nodes.name: renderProjects
nodes.summary: Renders the indexed-projects list view as an HTML unordered list, showing each project id with an optional document count.

nodes.name: renderMemoryBrowser
nodes.summary: Renders the memory browser view: type/level/importance filter controls, a paginated table of memory rows with markdown-rendered content and edit/delete actions gated by write mode, and a prev/next pager.

nodes.name: renderSearch
nodes.summary: Renders the search view: a query input plus a results list built from extractSearchResults, showing markdown-formatted content and an optional relevance score per result.

nodes.name: renderHandoffs
nodes.summary: Renders pending agent handoffs for the selected project as cards showing target agent, status, and a markdown-rendered summary.

nodes.name: renderProposals
nodes.summary: Renders pending auto-improvement proposals for the selected project as cards, exposing approve/reject actions only when write mode is enabled.

nodes.name: renderCheckpoints
nodes.summary: Renders the checkpoints table from normalized rows, surfacing an explicit error when the checkpoints route returns an unreadable TOON-formatted response instead of JSON.

nodes.name: initTheme
nodes.summary: Initializes the light/dark theme by reading a stored preference from localStorage and applying it as a data-theme attribute on the document root.

nodes.name: toggleTheme
nodes.summary: Flips the current light/dark theme, applies it to the document root, and persists the choice to localStorage.

nodes.name: readInjectedApiKey
nodes.summary: Reads the API key the server stamps into a meta[name=massa-ai-api-key] tag for trusted requests, returning null when the tag is absent so unauthenticated callers fail closed and the server answers 401.

nodes.name: createApiClient
nodes.summary: Factory that builds a minimal fetch-based API client, attaching the x-api-key header from an explicit option or the injected meta tag and auto-parsing JSON vs. text responses.

nodes.name: startApp
nodes.summary: Bootstraps the single-page app: builds the API client, wires hash-based view routing, theme toggle, and project select; defines the render() dispatcher that fetches data per view (including the dashboard via dashboard.js) and re-renders the DOM; wires write-mode edit/delete/approve/reject handlers; and subscribes to /api/v1/events (SSE) to auto-refresh on index/observation events.

nodes.name: cache-entry.test.ts
nodes.summary: Direct unit tests for the CacheEntry model, exercising constructor defaults, TTL-based expiration math, access tracking, promotion/eviction heuristics, update semantics, and toJSON/fromJSON round-tripping without any database or mocks.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses bun:test directly against the CacheEntry class with no mocks or database; TTL- and age-based behavior is exercised by backdating entry.createdAt/lastAccessed via Date arithmetic rather than mocking the clock.

nodes.name: api-key-config-seeded.test.ts
nodes.summary: Integration test (SEC-06) that spawns the MCP ApiClient in a real child process against a live Bun.serve HTTP server to verify the x-api-key header is resolved from config.json's seeded key, overridden by an explicit env var, and never sent when either source is blank or unset.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Bun.spawn (never spawnSync) to launch the child process, because spawnSync would block the same thread Bun.serve needs to answer the child's request on, deadlocking until the test times out.

nodes.name: config-cli.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the MCP client's massa-ai-config CLI, covering parseOptions flag parsing and every runCli subcommand (init, path, show, set, use, recover, unknown) via captured console output and exit codes.

nodes.name: config-cli.ts
nodes.summary: CLI entry point for massa-ai-config in the MCP client app, managing the local embedding-provider config (init/show/set/use) and dispatching project-path recovery through a lazily-imported recover-project module.
nodes.languageNotes: The recover subcommand dynamically imports ./recover-project.js only when invoked, keeping the Prisma/DB dependency chain out of every other CLI path.

nodes.name: agents-install.test.ts
nodes.summary: Integration tests that spawn the OpenCode plugin's config-cli.ts agents install/uninstall subcommand as a real bun run subprocess, verifying the 17 subagent specialist .md files are written with the ownership marker and correct edit permissions, and are removed without touching user-owned agents.

nodes.name: config-cli.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the OpenCode plugin's massa-ai-config CLI, exercising parseOptions, provider init/show/set/use flows, and the agents install/uninstall subcommand via direct in-process function calls.

nodes.name: config-cli.ts
nodes.summary: CLI entry point for the OpenCode plugin's massa-ai-config, managing embedding-provider configuration and an agents install|uninstall subcommand that copies or removes the 17 bundled subagent specialist Markdown files between the package and OpenCode's user/project agents directory.
nodes.languageNotes: Resolves its bundled agents/ source directory relative to import.meta.url via fileURLToPath so path resolution works identically from source (bun run) and from the built dist/ bundle.

nodes.name: web-ui-errors.test.ts
nodes.summary: Mocks fs/promises to drive the Web UI route handler through error and edge-case paths -- disabled flag, static-dir resolution failure, missing index.html, path traversal, asset read failure, and SPA fallback -- not covered by the happy-path suite.

nodes.name: api-key-header.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests the browser client's half of SEC-05: readInjectedApiKey extracts the server-stamped API key from a meta tag, and createApiClient attaches it as the x-api-key header while sending nothing when the tag is absent.

nodes.name: app-renderers.test.ts
nodes.summary: Large test suite for the Web UI's client-side rendering functions (markdown, projects, search, handoffs, checkpoints, proposals, memory browser), theme toggling, the createApiClient fetch wrapper, and startApp's full DOM wiring and SSE subscription, driven through a hand-built fake DOM.
nodes.languageNotes: Documents a real hang: app.js's write-mode handlers call prompt()/confirm()/alert(), which Bun implements as stdin readers, so an inherited live stdin blocks the suite indefinitely unless these globals are stubbed.

nodes.name: write-mode.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests the markdown-to-HTML fallback renderer, including the optional marked/DOMPurify path and XSS sanitization, and write-mode gating that shows or hides edit/delete/approve/reject action buttons based on the MASSA_AI_WEB_WRITE_MODE flag.

nodes.name: context-controller.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for ContextController's budget allocation, working-set selection, and memory formatting, run against a hand-built object that mirrors the private method logic rather than the real class, avoiding its heavy SearchController/MemoryController/KeywordSearch dependency chain.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately never imports the production ContextController class; selectWorkingSet, formatMemorySection, and getOptimizedContext are reimplemented inline, so this suite verifies a hand-maintained copy of the algorithm rather than the shipped module directly.

nodes.name: seedConfigHome
nodes.summary: Creates an isolated temporary XDG config home containing a config.json seeded with the given security section, used to test config-derived API key resolution.

nodes.name: capturedApiKeyHeader
nodes.summary: Boots a real Bun.serve HTTP server, spawns the MCP ApiClient in a child process with the given environment, and returns the x-api-key header value the client actually sent on the wire.

nodes.name: captureConsole
nodes.summary: Redirects console.log/console.error into strings while running a CLI action, restoring the originals afterward, so assertions can inspect the CLI's captured stdout/stderr.

nodes.name: help
nodes.summary: Prints the massa-ai-config CLI's usage text, listing every subcommand, its options, and example invocations.

nodes.name: parseOptions
nodes.summary: Parses a --flag value / --flag style argv array into a key-value options record, treating a following non-flag token as the value and otherwise as a boolean.

nodes.name: runCli
nodes.summary: Dispatches the massa-ai-config subcommands (init, path, show, set, use, recover) against the shared config module, handling embedding-provider setup and a lazily-imported project-path recovery flow.

nodes.name: runCli
nodes.summary: Test helper that spawns the OpenCode plugin's config-cli.ts as a real bun run subprocess with overridden HOME/XDG_CONFIG_HOME and returns its exit code plus captured stdout/stderr.

nodes.name: captureConsole
nodes.summary: Redirects console.log/console.error into strings while running a CLI action, restoring the originals afterward, for asserting on captured CLI output.

nodes.name: help
nodes.summary: Prints the OpenCode plugin's massa-ai-config CLI usage text, including the agents install|uninstall subcommand and examples.

nodes.name: parseOptions
nodes.summary: Parses argv flags into a key-value options record; the same flag-parsing shape as the mcp-client CLI's parser.

nodes.name: runCli
nodes.summary: Dispatches the OpenCode plugin CLI's subcommands, including agents install|uninstall, which copies or removes the 17 bundled subagent specialist Markdown files between the package's agents/ directory and OpenCode's user or project agents directory, gated by an ownership marker.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Test helper that issues a GET request through the Elysia app under test and returns status, raw text, parsed JSON (when present), and content-type for assertions.

nodes.name: recordingFetch
nodes.summary: Builds a fake fetch implementation that records every call's URL and init options and returns a canned JSON response, used to assert on outgoing request headers.

nodes.name: makeFakeDom
nodes.summary: Constructs a hand-built fake document with stable, stateful mock elements -- event listener registration, dataset, classList -- so startApp's DOM wiring and event handlers can be exercised without a real browser.

nodes.name: buildFakeController
nodes.summary: Builds a plain object mirroring ContextController's selectWorkingSet, formatMemorySection, searchMemoriesSafe, and getOptimizedContext logic with injectable search/memory/compressor dependencies, sidestepping the real class's constructor and singleton chain.

nodes.name: embedding-failure-propagation.test.ts
nodes.summary: Regression test for BUG-01 AC2 verifying that when no embedding provider is available, StoreMemoryTool.handle returns a failed ToolResponse naming the embedding provider as the cause, instead of silently storing a memory with a fabricated random vector.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `await import()` plus `mock.module()` to replace only the `createEmbeddingProvider` export while spreading through every other export of the real barrel, so unrelated importers of the module don't break with a missing-export error unrelated to the behavior under test.

nodes.name: graph-generation-migration.test.ts
nodes.summary: Migration sensor and PG-gated integration test for the graph-generations schema migration: statically asserts the migration SQL is atomic with required locks and guards and that the symbol repository writes use the active composite key, then, when opted in, provisions a disposable PostgreSQL database to verify backfill, generation isolation, and SymbolRepositoryPg's read/write paths end-to-end.
nodes.languageNotes: Reads the migration SQL and two repository source files as raw text via readFileSync for substring-based pattern assertions rather than executing them, while the PG-gated half provisions and tears down a real disposable PostgreSQL database per run.

nodes.name: real-api.test.ts
nodes.summary: Black-box integration suite that drives the live massa-ai tools-api HTTP server end-to-end: indexing, semantic search, symbol graph lookups, memory store/recall, context compression, and analytics endpoints, using the massa-ai repository itself as the fixture project; the whole suite is skipped when the API isn't reachable.

nodes.name: pollUntil
nodes.summary: Polls an async predicate on a fixed interval until it resolves true or a timeout elapses, used to wait for the asynchronous project-indexing job to finish before assertions run.

nodes.name: operation-log-repository.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests OperationLogRepositoryPg's fail-safe contract that a broken audit-log database layer never bubbles an error back to the destructive-operation caller, plus a PG-gated round-trip check that recordOperation writes are readable back via listByProject.

nodes.name: project-root-cache.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for ProjectRootCache, the 512-entry LRU cache mapping projectId to workspace root path that was extracted out of ReadFileTool, covering lookup/cache-fill, hit promotion, failure fallbacks, eviction at both call sites, the indexing:started event subscription, and a pinned assertion that the unused ROOT_CACHE_TTL field remains dead code by design.
nodes.languageNotes: Reaches the cache's private Map and its MAX_ENTRIES constant via an `as unknown as` cast to assert eviction and cap behavior directly, the same white-box-cast idiom used by this repo's other characterization tests.

nodes.name: search-memories-tool.characterization.test.ts
nodes.summary: Characterization tests pinning SearchMemoriesTool's exact request/response shape: the ten fields forwarded to its controller, the nine-field memory DTO with ISO-8601 createdAt, the relatedContext graft, TOON vs JSON format resolution, and error enveloping, using module mocks registered before a dynamic import so the real controller graph and its live embedding-provider selection never construct.
nodes.languageNotes: Registers mock.module() calls before a dynamic await import() of the subject tool; a static import would evaluate first and eagerly construct the real controller graph (Prisma, MemoryRepositoryPg, live embedding-provider selection), turning a roughly 60 ms test into the project's documented 5001 ms / 42 s cold-model hang.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Root barrel for @massa-ai/core: re-exports the package's entire public surface (tools, services, data repositories, and kernel types) as a single transport-independent business-logic entry point consumed by the tools-api and mcp-client apps.
nodes.languageNotes: Every export here is a re-export (export ... from / export * from) rather than an import statement, so the deterministic import-map, which parses import declarations, reports zero project-internal imports for this file even though it structurally depends on roughly fifty modules across all four architecture layers.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file for the memory-relation graph service, re-exporting the Postgres-backed graph store (GraphStorePg), the relation extractor, graph query helpers, the MemoryGraphService orchestrator, the getGraphStore/resetGraphStore factory pair, and the core graph type definitions (MemoryRow, EdgeCreateInput, EdgeFilter, IGraphStore, and related types).
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the memory-relation graph (relationships between stored memories), a distinct concept from the project's separate symbol graph under services/symbol/ — a naming collision the project's own architecture notes call out explicitly.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Central barrel aggregating every MCP tool implementation in @massa-ai/core: indexing and search, memory CRUD, checkpoints, session-continuity snapshots, symbol-graph navigation and traversal, file reading, the polyglot code executor, and the SSRF-guarded web fetch/index tool, giving transports a single import surface for the whole tool set.
nodes.languageNotes: Section comments preserve the incremental delivery labels each tool group shipped under (e.g. 'Phase 3 C1', 'Phase 4 D2/D3', 'Wave 5 FR-01/FR-02'), tracing the MCP tool surface's build history directly in the source.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Public root barrel for the @massa-ai/shared package: re-exports the environment-loader side effect, all shared types and interfaces, the utils barrel, and the full configuration module (Config, defaults, XDG paths, and API-key resolution) consumed by core, tools-api, and mcp-client.
nodes.languageNotes: The file header comment is written in Portuguese ('Tipos, utilitários e configuração compartilhados' — types, utilities and shared configuration), a holdover from the project's original authorship that predates its otherwise English-only convention.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel for @massa-ai/shared's utility layer: re-exports the structured logger, input/FTS5/path sanitizers, token estimation and truncation helpers, the Benchmark and MetricsCollector/PerformanceTracker instrumentation classes, and the RateLimiter/SmartRateLimiter pair with its shared rateLimiter singleton.

nodes.name: cycle-detection.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the iterative Tarjan SCC cycle detector (detectCycles), covering the FR-23/AC-25 mandated fixtures (self-loop, shared-node cycles, K5, disconnected cycles, DAG), edge-budget truncation, and cross-run determinism. Also enforces RSS memory-growth guards under large synthetic graphs (350k-500k edges) to confirm the iterative implementation avoids call-stack blowup.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses bun:test's describe/test/expect API. Memory-growth assertions measure process.memoryUsage.rss() deltas via the shared rssDeltaOver helper rather than heap snapshots, keeping the guard cheap and fast under CI.

nodes.name: rss-delta.ts
nodes.summary: Shared RSS-delta memory measurement helper (rssNow, rssDeltaOver, median) reused by native-heavy subsystem tests such as cycle-detection and structural-runtime.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately not re-exported from packages/core/src/index.ts — a test-only idiom, confirmed absent from the package's public surface.

nodes.name: rssNow
nodes.summary: Returns the current resident set size in bytes via the cheaper process.memoryUsage.rss() accessor, avoiding allocation of the full memory-usage object.

nodes.name: rssDeltaOver
nodes.summary: Measures RSS memory growth caused by running a callback, forcing a GC pass first when exposed to reduce measurement noise, and returns the after-minus-baseline delta in bytes.

nodes.name: median
nodes.summary: Computes the median of a numeric array by sorting a copy and averaging the two middle values for even-length inputs.

nodes.name: auto-improve-job.characterization.test.ts
nodes.summary: Characterization tests pinning AutoImproveJob's detectPatterns output and its approve/reject proposal state machine ahead of a planned facade split, using DB-free fakes for the observation, proposal, and memory stores.
nodes.languageNotes: Fakes are hand-rolled in-memory implementations of AutoImproveJob's dependency seams (ObservationStore, MemoryApplySeam, LlmSurface) rather than mock.module, keeping the suite process-isolated per this repo's test-isolation convention. A doc comment prescribes a discrimination spot-check (flip a signalKey, swap the approve/reject terminal status, drop the pinned-memory guard) that each mutation must fail.

nodes.name: makeObs
nodes.summary: Builds a fake InsertableObservation for tests, routing the payload through scrubCredentials so the fixture exercises the same sanitization boundary as production observation inserts.

nodes.name: makeFakeMemoryRepo
nodes.summary: Creates an in-memory fake implementing the MemoryApplySeam contract (insert/update/getById) with tracking collections and a pinned-memory set, used to assert on AutoImproveJob's memory-apply side effects and the pinned-memory approval guard.

nodes.name: makeJob
nodes.summary: Factory that wires a fresh AutoImproveJob instance from injected observation/proposal stores and a disabled LLM surface, the standard DB-free construction seam used across this test file.

nodes.name: auto-improve-job.test.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive Phase 5 test suite for AutoImproveJob covering pattern detection, review-gated vs. auto-approved proposal application, LLM enrichment degrade paths, the approve/reject state machine, maybeRun throttling, and MCP tool/route registration checks.
nodes.languageNotes: Models four distinct LLM surface states (enabled+success, enabled+ok:false, enabled+throw, disabled) as separate fake factories to characterize AutoImproveJob's graceful-degradation behavior when enrichment fails, and asserts canonical SearchServiceError failures propagate unchanged from approve/reject/runOnce.

nodes.name: makeObs
nodes.summary: Builds a fake InsertableObservation for tests, routing the payload through scrubCredentials so the fixture exercises the same sanitization boundary as production observation inserts.

nodes.name: makeFakeMemoryRepo
nodes.summary: Creates an in-memory fake MemoryApplySeam (insert/update) with an injectable failNext flag used to simulate apply failures during approve().

nodes.name: makeJob
nodes.summary: Factory wiring a fresh AutoImproveJob from a pre-seeded observation store, fake proposal/memory stores, a deterministic id factory, and a configurable LLM surface for degrade-path testing.

nodes.name: hotFileObservations
nodes.summary: Builds a deterministic observation set representing a file edited 4 times plus two unrelated prompts, used as the standard above-threshold fixture for pattern-detection and runOnce tests.

nodes.name: compact-snapshot-attribution.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests that CompactSnapshotTool routes its independent persistence seam through the attribution resolver (project id remapping, cwd handling, sticky pins) and that its own credential-scrub boundary redacts secrets even though it bypasses HookService entirely.
nodes.languageNotes: compact_snapshot.ts persists independently of HookService (M45/HAR-01), so this suite deliberately duplicates the credential-scrub boundary check already covered for HookService in hook-service.test.ts, proving the redaction guarantee holds at both persistence seams even for a pre-existing unsanitized row.

nodes.name: FakeResolver
nodes.summary: Test double implementing AttributionResolverLike that records every resolve() call and pinSession() call so tests can assert on the arguments CompactSnapshotTool passes to the attribution boundary.

nodes.name: seededStore
nodes.summary: Builds a MemoryObservationStore pre-seeded with one sanitized observation row, used as the baseline fixture for attribution and redaction assertions.

nodes.name: credential-scrub.test.ts
nodes.summary: Exhaustive per-rule test suite for the kernel credential scrubber, pairing a redact case with a near-miss pass-through case for each of 7 secret shapes (PEM, JWT, AWS key, OpenAI key, GitHub token, Slack token, Bearer token), plus non-growth, purity, escaped-newline PEM, and adversarial 64 KiB timing invariants.
nodes.languageNotes: Each of the 7 rule ids gets a paired redact/near-miss case to pin exact match boundaries, plus a byte-length non-growth invariant, a determinism (purity) check, an escaped-\n PEM case matching the JSON.stringify boundary hook-service.ts actually sends, and a 64 KiB adversarial-input timing budget guarding against ReDoS-style hangs.

nodes.name: hook-service.test.ts
nodes.summary: Test suite for HookService covering event validation/normalization, ingestOne/ingestBatch persistence with event-bus emission, credential redaction at the insert seam (XP-02), WriterQueue backpressure/saturation, and the M45 attribution-resolver wiring (project id remapping, sticky sessions, cwd extraction, pin admission ordering).
nodes.languageNotes: Contains a genuine duplicate import of AttributionResolverLike (top of file and again near line 391) that tsc misses because tsconfig excludes src/__tests__ from type-checking; oxlint's semantic analysis is what actually catches it, illustrating why the project runs oxlint as an independent gate over tsc.

nodes.name: validEvent
nodes.summary: Builds a valid IncomingEvent fixture with sensible defaults, overridable per test, for HookService validation and ingestion tests.

nodes.name: makeService
nodes.summary: Factory constructing a HookService wired with an injected observation store, fake bridge, and a verbatim attribution resolver by default, isolating tests from the production PG-backed resolver.

nodes.name: FakeResolver
nodes.summary: Scriptable test double implementing AttributionResolverLike that returns a queued sequence of AttributionResult values per resolve() call, falling back to a verbatim result, while recording every call and pin for assertions on the M45 attribution wiring.

nodes.name: makeAttributedService
nodes.summary: Factory constructing a HookService with a caller-supplied attribution resolver, used by the M45 attribution wiring tests to script resolve()/pinSession() sequences.

nodes.name: observation-consolidation-job.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for ObservationConsolidationJob's LLM-driven consolidation bridge, using injected fake LLM surfaces, a fake memory repository, and an in-memory observation store to verify consolidation triggering, event-bus notifications, and silent degradation when the LLM surface is disabled or failing.

nodes.name: observation-repository-pg-coverage.test.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL-backed coverage test suite for PgObservationStore, exercising the synchronous in-memory mirror plus the asynchronous durable-write path against a dedicated test database, including alias-resolver rename races (BUG-06) and hydration/drain test helpers.

nodes.name: observation-contract.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the ObservationStore contract — lifecycle event kinds, observation categories, attribution sources, the Observation/InsertableObservation/ObservationRow shapes — and an in-memory MemoryObservationStore reference implementation used by tests and as the default non-persistent store.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a branded `SanitizedPayloadJson` type on `InsertableObservation.payloadJson` so only `scrubCredentials()`'s output can satisfy the insert contract — a compile-time guard against ever persisting an unscrubbed payload. The dense single-line formatting (the whole class and several interfaces each collapsed to one line) understates the file's structural richness relative to its raw line count.

nodes.name: observation-repository-pg.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL implementation of ObservationStore (PgObservationStore) that keeps a synchronous in-memory mirror hydrated from Postgres for fast reads while persisting writes fire-and-forget, including rate-limited hydration retries and mid-flight project-id alias reconciliation (BUG-06).
nodes.languageNotes: Implements a 'sync read / async durable write' split — an inherently async Prisma-backed store exposes a synchronous interface by serving reads from an in-memory Map mirror, hydrated lazily and reconciled on insert. This mirrors the same discipline used by PgScheduledJobStore / PgSynapseSessionStore elsewhere in the codebase.

nodes.name: credential-scrub.ts
nodes.summary: Kernel-level credential redaction utility that regex-scrubs PEM private keys, JWTs, AWS access keys, OpenAI-style sk- keys, GitHub tokens, Slack tokens, and Bearer tokens from hook-ingested payloads before they are persisted, producing a branded SanitizedPayloadJson value as proof of sanitization.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a TypeScript branded/nominal type (`SanitizedPayloadJson`, backed by a unique symbol) with deliberately no 'assert' escape hatch, so the type system enforces that a payload can only be marked sanitized by actually running the scrubber.

nodes.name: hook-service.ts
nodes.summary: Core hook-ingestion service that validates and normalizes incoming lifecycle events, resolves project attribution, scrubs credentials, enqueues persistence through a single-writer queue, publishes an observation:ingested event, and triggers the memory-consolidation bridge — with fire-and-forget admission, 429-on-saturation, and 400/413 validation semantics.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the project's canonical get*()/reset*() singleton accessor pattern (getHookService/resetHookService) for a cached production instance with test-isolation resets, and a dependency-injectable BridgeTrigger interface (NoopBridge default, ObservationConsolidationJob in production) to keep the LLM-touching consolidation stage optional and decoupled.

nodes.name: makeFakeMemoryRepo
nodes.summary: Test helper that builds a fake memory repository object capturing every insert() call for later assertions.

nodes.name: enabledSurface
nodes.summary: Test helper producing a fake LlmSurface that reports itself enabled and always returns a fixed, valid ConsolidatedBatch-shaped object.

nodes.name: makeStoreWith
nodes.summary: Test helper that seeds a MemoryObservationStore with n scrubbed synthetic observations spaced one second apart, for exercising the consolidation window logic.

nodes.name: makeObservation
nodes.summary: Test factory that builds an InsertableObservation with sensible defaults (new id, default payload, current timestamp), always routing payloadJson through scrubCredentials to satisfy the branded-type insert contract.

nodes.name: renamingResolver
nodes.summary: Test double for ProjectIdentityAliasResolver that maps known source project ids to a canonical target id, with a warmCache flag modeling whether the resolver's cache is cold or already populated — used to test the BUG-06 mirror-reconciliation race.

nodes.name: newObservationId
nodes.summary: Generates a new observation id string prefixed with 'obs_' using crypto.randomUUID().

nodes.name: MemoryObservationStore
nodes.summary: In-memory reference implementation of ObservationStore, supporting insert, recency/session listing, and per-project counting with deep-cloned reads; used as the default non-persistent store and by tests.

nodes.name: pgRowToObservation
nodes.summary: Maps a raw PgObservationRow (snake_case DB columns) into the camelCase Observation domain shape, normalizing bigint created_at values via toNum.

nodes.name: PgObservationStore
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL-backed ObservationStore that serves synchronous reads from an in-memory mirror (lazily hydrated from Postgres with rate-limited retry backoff) while persisting inserts fire-and-forget, reconciling the mirror's project id once alias resolution completes.
nodes.languageNotes: Rate-limits hydration retries to once per 30s after a failure, so a persistent PG outage cannot turn every read/write into a full-table retry storm. Test helpers `__hydrate()`/`__drain()` exist purely to make the fire-and-forget async work deterministic for assertions.

nodes.name: fullMatchRule
nodes.summary: Factory that builds a Rule whose entire regex match is replaced by a fixed `[REDACTED:<id>]` marker, counting the number of replacements made.

nodes.name: scrubCredentials
nodes.summary: Pure function that runs every credential-shape rule (PEM, JWT, AWS key, sk- key, GitHub token, Slack token, Bearer token) against a JSON payload string in a fixed order, returning the sanitized text branded as SanitizedPayloadJson plus per-rule and total redaction counts.
nodes.languageNotes: Each rule's `[REDACTED:<id>]` marker is deliberately sized shorter than that credential shape's minimum possible match, so scrubbing never increases payload length — keeping the pre-scrub `HOOKS_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES` cap valid post-scrub.

nodes.name: validateEvent
nodes.summary: Validates and normalizes a raw IncomingEvent — checks event kind (case-insensitive), non-empty projectId, a non-empty serializable payload under the size cap, and clamps/defaults importance, sessionId, agentId, and timestamp — returning a discriminated ValidationResult with 400/413 error codes on failure.

nodes.name: resolveDefaultBridge
nodes.summary: Resolves the production default BridgeTrigger for the HookService singleton — returns the real ObservationConsolidationJob when its maybeRun entrypoint is available, otherwise falls back to a no-op bridge so hook ingestion never crashes.

nodes.name: getHookService
nodes.summary: Returns the cached production HookService singleton, constructing it on first call with the resolved default consolidation bridge.

nodes.name: resetHookService
nodes.summary: Test hook that clears the cached HookService singleton so the next getHookService() call constructs a fresh instance.

nodes.name: HookService
nodes.summary: Ingests lifecycle events end-to-end — validating/normalizing input, resolving attribution, enqueuing scrubbed observations onto a single-writer queue, persisting them, publishing observation:ingested, and triggering the consolidation bridge, with 429-on-saturation and fail-open semantics.
nodes.languageNotes: Attribution resolution runs pre-enqueue so single and batch ingestion share one seam; the resolver's sticky session pin is recorded only after admission survives (no pin on a rejected/saturated enqueue).

nodes.name: ValidationError
nodes.summary: Typed error carrying an HTTP-ish status code (400 or 413), thrown by HookService validation and mapped to the corresponding HTTP response by the route layer.

nodes.name: structural-runtime.test.ts
nodes.summary: Test suite for the native tree-sitter structural parsing runtime, covering the bounded StructuralParserPool (capacity/timeout limits, FIFO fairness, idle-parser reuse and eviction, injected-timer timeouts) and StructuralRuntime's parse lifecycle (diagnostic classification, cursor/tree cleanup ordering, ABI and grammar failure handling, shared production capacity, and RSS stability across 100 forced-GC native parse cycles).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Bun-specific APIs (Bun.gc, Bun.sleep) and a describeNative gate to separate pure-JS pool tests from tests requiring the real native tree-sitter grammar; the memory test drives forced GC cycles with median RSS sampling to deterministically catch native handle leaks rather than asserting on a single noisy reading.

nodes.name: fakeTree
nodes.summary: Builds a fake NativeTree test double whose root node's walk() method tracks cursor-creation/deletion order in an events array, with optional flags to simulate a syntax error, a shared event log, or a throwing tree.delete() — used to assert StructuralRuntime's cursor/tree cleanup ordering.

nodes.name: fakeGrammarSet
nodes.summary: Builds a fake LoadedNativeGrammarSet whose minimal Parser class delegates setLanguage/parse to an injected parser factory, paired with a single TypeScript grammar map entry, used to stub native grammar loading in StructuralRuntime tests.

nodes.name: compact_snapshot.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool handler that builds a bounded, reference-based compaction snapshot (table-of-contents with runnable search/recall pointers, not inlined data) of a session's observations, resolves project attribution, scrubs credentials, and optionally persists the snapshot as an observation for cross-session continuity — distinct from checkpoints, which version task state.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses constructor-injected optional overrides (storeOverride, resolverOverride) with `??` fallback to the shared get*() singletons — the codebase's standard dependency-injection-for-testing pattern paired with matching reset*() functions in the collaborator modules.

nodes.name: CompactSnapshotTool
nodes.summary: Implements the `compact_snapshot` MCP tool: delegates snapshot construction to CompactionSnapshotService, resolves caller attribution, scrubs credentials from the payload before persisting, and optionally records the snapshot as a 'compaction-snapshots' observation.
